izzyondroid:com.haseeb.quranapp.name: Quran Majeed (قرآن مجید)
izzyondroid:com.haseeb.quranapp.summary: An elegant, privacy-respecting Open Source Quran App for Android.
izzyondroid:com.haseeb.quranapp.description:
We are incredibly proud to present Quran Majeed (قرآن مجید) !
 This application was built entirely from the ground up prioritizing privacy, elegance, and offline-first capabilities. Unlike many other apps, Quran Majeed contains zero tracking , zero ads , and relies on zero proprietary services (like Google Play Services).
 ✨ Key Features
 Distraction-Free Reading: A beautiful, infinite-scrolling Surah reader with authentic Indo-Pak style Arabic typography.
 Smart Audio Player: Interleaved Ayah-by-Ayah audio playback that automatically scrolls the screen as you listen.
 Premium Offline Capabilities: Once you open a Surah, its Arabic text, Urdu/English Translations, and Tafsir are cached locally for offline reading.
 Daily Hadith Widget: A stunning, native Android homescreen widget that delivers a new Hadith every day, running entirely on local background workers.
 Multiple Localizations: Includes renowned translations like Urdu (Jalandhry) , Urdu (Tahir ul Qadri) , English (Saheeh International) , and Tafsirs like Tafsir Ibn Kathir .
 World-Renowned Reciters: Listen to beautiful recitations from Saud Ash-Shuraym , Mishari Rashid Al-Afasy , AbdulBaset AbdulSamad , and more.
 Juz/Parah Support: Navigate the Quran easily by Surah or by Juz using intuitive swipeable tabs.

izzyondroid:com.monuk7735.nope.remote.name: Nope Remote
izzyondroid:com.monuk7735.nope.remote.summary: Universal IR & Android TV remote control with custom remotes, buttons & macros.
izzyondroid:com.monuk7735.nope.remote.description:
Nope-Remote is an open-source Android application that turns your smartphone into a powerful, universal remote control for both Infrared (IR) devices and Android TV / Google TV.
 Built with modern Android technologies, it offers a sleek Material You interface and advanced features like Custom Remote Creation and Custom Macros to automate your home entertainment system. Even if your phone lacks a built-in IR blaster, you can seamlessly discover and control Android TV devices over Wi-Fi.
 Key Features:
 Android TV & Google TV Control: Seamlessly discover (mDNS) or manually connect (by IP/hostname across VLANs) and control Android TVs with saved remotes, secure pairing, directional pad, media playback, text input, and quick app launch shortcuts.
 Universal IR Compatibility: Control TVs, Set-Top Boxes, ACs, and more using your phone's built-in IR blaster.
 Custom Remote Creation: Build fully customized remotes from scratch tailored specifically to your home setup.
 Custom Buttons: Add, customize, and configure buttons on any remote with custom icons, labels, IR codes, and protocols.
 Hardware Volume Button Control: Optionally adjust TV volume directly using your phone's physical volume buttons.
 Custom Macros: Create "Macros" to chain multiple commands together (e.g., Turn on TV, STB, and Soundbar with one tap).
 Offline IR Database: Direct database downloads for seamless offline access without reliance on third-party CDNs.
 Enhanced Repository Support: Expanded support for multiple community repositories and improved setup process.
 Performance: Optimized internal architecture for smoother operation and better maintainability.
 Material You Design: Beautiful, modern UI that adapts to your wallpaper's colors.
 Dark/Light Mode: Fully supports system-wide themes.
 Haptic Feedback: Tactile confirmation for button presses with customizable vibration preferences.

fdroid:app.wocheneinkauf.name: Wocheneinkauf
fdroid:app.wocheneinkauf.summary: Shared shopping list for family and flatmates, synced live - no account
fdroid:app.wocheneinkauf.description:
Wocheneinkauf is a simple shared shopping list for families and flatmates. Create a list, share the link – everyone who opens it is in. No account, no tracking, no ads.
 Features 
 Add, edit, check off and remove items – changes show up on all open phones immediately
 Bulk mode: "tomatoes, cheese, milk" becomes three items
 Automatic emojis for groceries (German and English item names), tolerant of typos; an emoji you type or pick yourself always wins
 Word suggestions while typing; a tap adds the item
 Emoji picker with search (English and German) for keyboards without emojis
 Drag items into your own order, e.g. along the route through the shop – shared with everyone on the list
 Photos instead of text ("this brand"), tap to enlarge; remembered photos are suggested again when you add items
 Shows who added an item
 Share a list by link, QR code or code; anyone can rename it
 Material You design, dark mode, English and German
 Server 
 The app needs a Wocheneinkauf server – there is no public default server. The server is part of the same open source project (FastAPI + SQLite, Docker image) and runs on a home server or a small VPS; enter its URL on first start, or open a share link, which brings the server along. Anyone who has a list's link or code can read and change that list; lists that are not used for a while are deleted automatically.

fdroid:at.techbee.jtx.name: jtx Board journals|notes|tasks
fdroid:at.techbee.jtx.summary: Keep track of journals, notes & tasks - iCalendar compliant and syncable with yo
fdroid:at.techbee.jtx.description:
Elevate the power of the iCalendar standard to the next level, use the potential of the combination of journals (VJournal), notes (VJournal) and tasks (VTodo) out of one app and use DAVx5 to synchronize your entries with a CalDAV-server of your choice!
 iCal standard compliant 
Using the iCal standard ensures compatibility and interoperability with other apps and services independent of a dedicated provider or infrastructure. Journals and Notes are compliant with the definition of the VJOURNAL component, Tasks are compliant with the VTODO component. You can also import and export your entries as .ics files.
 Combine journals, notes & tasks 
Instead of using separate apps for journals, notes & tasks you can use them out of one hand, combine and link them to each other, e.g. create meeting minutes and link your tasks to them.
 Sync with DAVx5 
Synchronize your entries with any compatible CalDAV server by using DAVx5. By using DAVx5 you are free to choose your preferred provider for CalDAV, you can even use your local server to store and synchronize your data.
Note: DAVx5 is an independent app and must be acquired separately.
 Open Source 
Your data can contain private and sensitive data by their nature. We believe that individuals and companies should be able to be in full control of their own data. This means the freedom to choose where and how the data are stored, and freedom in choice of software. That is why we chose DAVx5 as a Sync Adapter to synchronise your data between your phone and any compatible CalDAV-server. The source code for jtx Board is publically available - find out more on https://jtx.techbee.at !
 What does VJournal and VTodo mean? 
VJournal and VTodo are calendar components defined in the international standard RFC-5545, the Internet Calendaring and Scheduling Core Object Specification (iCalendar), see https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5545 . This standard also defines the VEvent component, which is the standard definition for calendar event entries. jtx Board is using the VJournal component according to this iCalendar standard for journal entries and tasks. VJournals can have a defined start date, but they cannot have a duration or an end date. VJournals with a defined start date are considered journals entries in jtx Board, VJournals without start date are interpreted as notes. The VTodo component as defined in the iCalendar standard defines the technical specification of tasks, which can have a scheduled start, due and completed date as well as a progress and a completed status (amongst others).
The VEvent definition is widely used, the VTodo component also found some implementations in Apps, but the VJournal component remained in the dark almost not being implemented at all by other apps and services. With jtx Board we would like to revive the usage of this standard and empower it with the possibilities to link and combine VTodos with VJournals - and in the future also VEvents! :-)
Find out more on https://jtx.techbee.at

fdroid:com.quietgrid.app.name: Quiet Grid: Logic Puzzles
fdroid:com.quietgrid.app.summary: Sudoku, Nonogram, Minesweeper, Word Search & more. Calm puzzles, fully offline.
fdroid:com.quietgrid.app.description:
Quiet Grid is a calm collection of logic puzzles and word games: Sudoku, Nonogram, Takuzu, Minesweeper, Star Battle, Word Search, 2048 and more. No ads, no account, no internet. Everything stays on your device.
 A FRESH PUZZLE EVERY DAY 
Choose which games give you a new puzzle every day, in every difficulty. Share your result when you're done, and get an optional reminder if you haven't played yet.
 JOURNEY 
Work your way through chapters of puzzles that slowly get harder, and earn up to three stars at every stop. In 12 games.
 PUZZLES THAT PLAY FAIR 
 Four levels, Easy to Expert, graded by the logic each puzzle needs, not by how many squares are empty.
 Stuck? A hint shows you the next step.
 Challenger mode: solve as many puzzles as you can before the clock runs out.
 Build Mixes of your favorite games and difficulties and play them back to back.
 Track wins, streaks and scores for every game and difficulty, with a full history of every puzzle you play.
 LOGIC PUZZLES 
 Sudoku — Place digits 1–9 so every row, column and 3×3 box contains each digit once.
 Killer Sudoku — No starting digits: the sums in each dashed cage tell you what goes where.
 Mini Sudoku — Quick 4×4 and 6×6 Sudoku for a short break.
 Takuzu (Binairo) — Fill the grid with 0s and 1s. Equal counts, no three in a row, no identical rows.
 Nonogram (Hanjie) — Reveal a hidden picture using the number clues on each row and column.
 Minesweeper — Uncover every safe cell without hitting a mine. Classic boards never need a guess, and there's an Endless mode.
 Star Battle — Place stars in every row, column and region, with no two touching.
 Animal Doku — One animal per row, column and colored region, never touching, not even diagonally.
 Links — Join every pair of dots and fill the grid.
 Circuit — Turn the tiles until every wire is live.
 WORD GAMES 
 Word Search — Find hidden words in themed grids.
 Word Guess — Guess the hidden word in six tries.
 Guess by Numbers — Guess the word in ten tries; two numbers show how close you are.
 Theme Clear — Spell words from one theme until every letter is used.
 Word Swap — Swap letter tiles until every line spells a word.
 MEMORY, NUMBERS AND BLOCKS 
 Chimp Test — Tap the numbers in order before they disappear.
 Sequence Memory — Watch the pads light up, then tap the growing sequence back.
 2048 — Slide and merge tiles to reach 2048.
 Block Fill — Drag pieces onto the board and clear full rows and columns. Includes an Endless mode.
 Arrow Escape — Tap an arrow to send it off the board. It only gets out if nothing blocks its path.
 Block Escape — Slide the blocks aside and set the coral block free.
 MAKE IT YOURS 
Seven color themes, including Pencil, a paper-like grayscale theme that works well for colorblind players. Star your favorite games, set hints, timer and layout per game, and continue a puzzle from a home screen widget. Play in 8 languages, and pick the language for word puzzles separately.
 CALM, PRIVATE AND OPEN SOURCE 
Made for calm puzzle time: time pressure only comes when you start Challenger mode yourself. No ads, no tracking, no account, and no internet permission. The only permission it asks for is notifications, for optional daily reminders. Open source under GPLv3.

fdroid:com.seca.messages.name: Seca Messages
fdroid:com.seca.messages.summary: Private SMS, and end-to-end encrypted messages between Seca phones
fdroid:com.seca.messages.description:
Ordinary texts, and end-to-end encrypted messages between Seca phones.
With Seca Link off, the app does not use the Internet at all. Turn it on and messages between two Seca phones travel encrypted with the Signal protocol, through public relays that see neither who writes nor what is written. No account, no server of ours.
One of three apps — Contacts, Phone and Messages — sharing one Material 3 Expressive design. Android 12 or newer, with or without Google, at its best on GrapheneOS. In English, French, German, Spanish and Polish.
 Seca Link: end-to-end encrypted 
 Between two Seca phones, messages travel encrypted with the Signal protocol (libsignal, post-quantum PQXDH), bypassing the carrier.
 No account, no Seca server: encrypted messages travel through public Nostr relays, which see neither who writes nor what is written.
 Two contacts connect through an invisible SMS; everything then goes over the Internet.
 Read receipts and typing indicator, each of which can be turned off.
 Safety number to compare, or to scan as a QR code.
 Encrypted photos and voice messages; the microphone is asked for only when you record one.
 Four public relays are set by default (relay.damus.io, nos.lol, relay.primal.net, nostr.mom) and the list is yours to change.
 Off by default: without Seca Link, the app does not use the Internet.
 SMS 
 MMS, both ways. A picture message sent to you arrives and is shown in the conversation. Sending one works too, through your carrier, so it reaches any phone: a picture, a video, a file, a contact card or a voice message, with no account at either end. Pictures are shrunk to what a network will carry. Group conversations over MMS are still being worked on.
 Conversations with your contacts' photos and profiles, search across every message.
 Reply from the notification, scheduled messages.
 Verification codes copied in one tap and erased automatically after a while.
 Advertising texts filed as spam.
 Pinned and archived conversations.
 Also 
 Password-encrypted backup.
 App lock, and a hidden preview in recent apps.
 Wallpaper colours or Seca palettes, dark theme.
No ads, no trackers, no account. Open source.

Gitalchemy is a free and open source GitLab client for Android phones and tablets. Review merge requests, triage issues and follow pipelines without opening a browser.

fdroid:foss.cnugteren.nlweer.name: NLWeer
fdroid:foss.cnugteren.nlweer.summary: Dutch weather and rain radar app
fdroid:foss.cnugteren.nlweer.description:
NLWeer is a simple open-source and privacy-friendly Dutch weather app for Android (5.0 or newer). It is free both as in free lunch and as in freedom. Weather information is provided by KNMI or optionally by Buienradar, see the about screen in the app for more information.

* It does not nor never will display commercial advertisements
* It does not require any permissions (except for GPS if explicitly requested)

Features of NLWeer:
* Includes weather maps as well as a written weather report
* Includes weather information from multiple sources
* Three options for localisation: manual lon/lat coordinates, mobile service provider, or GPS
* Includes a precipitation prediction graph on your current location

fdroid:org.schabi.newpipe.localserver.name: LocalTube
fdroid:org.schabi.newpipe.localserver.summary: Self-hosted streaming server solution built on top of NewPipe Extractor
fdroid:org.schabi.newpipe.localserver.description:
LocalTube is an enhanced, self-hosted streaming server solution built on top of a specialized fork of NewPipe Extractor. By bundling a lightweight and concurrent Java HTTP server inside an Android application, LocalTube enables you to browse, search, and stream content from major streaming platforms directly from any device in your local network using a standard web browser.
Key Features:
- Decentralized Local Server: Runs a lightweight, concurrent Java HTTP server directly on your Android device (default port 8080), serving a modern, responsive web interface.
- Cross-Device Playback: Connect seamlessly to the server from any device on your local network (PC, laptop, smart TV, tablet) by visiting your device's local IP.
- Video.js Media Player: High-performance HTML5 player using Video.js for quality switching, adaptive playback speed, gesture controls, and smooth seeking.
- Enhanced Gestures & Shortcuts: Double-tap or double-click to seek 10s forward/backward (with chevron ripples), swipe vertically to adjust volume (with volume HUD), and use keyboard/remote D-pad shortcuts (Space, J, L, M, Arrows).
- Autoplay Queue: Seamless "Up Next" autoplay timer countdown at the end of video playback with Cancel and Play Now actions.
- Picture-in-Picture & Subtitles: Native floating Picture-in-Picture window support, and fully fixed WebVTT captions/subtitles rendering.
- Remote Playback Control: Remotely control other active clients on your network (play, pause, fast-forward, rewind) from the web interface.
- Database Backup Import/Export: Back up and restore your settings and SQLite watch history as JSON files.
- YouTube Interests & Subscriptions Importer: Log in securely via WebView to scrape and import subscription lists, as well as personalize followed interest keywords using unique homepage recommendation tags.
- Dedicated Reels Player Integration: Open YouTube Reels directly in a specialized vertical scrolling Reels player (supporting swipe controls) from your Watch Later, History, or Search feeds.
- Custom Quality Preferences: Easily manage preferred video streaming resolutions directly inside the client and server settings.
- Theme Customization: Toggle between modern Dark, Light, and Pure Black (OLED) themes with custom accent color palette selection.
- Material 3 User Interface: Beautifully updated UI with cohesive Material Design 3 tokens, color harmonies, and responsive layouts.
- Private Watch History: Tracks your watched videos locally on the host device using a secure SQLite database, maintaining privacy with zero external telemetry or tracking.

fdroid:org.sherpr.app.name: Sherpr
fdroid:org.sherpr.app.summary: Drive your Herdr AI-agent fleet from your phone, over SSH — no cloud
fdroid:org.sherpr.app.description:
Sherpr is the mobile companion for Herdr , the terminal agent multiplexer. Herdr runs each coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, …) in its own real terminal and shows at a glance who is blocked , working , done , or idle . Sherpr brings that glance — and the ability to unblock, steer, and monitor agents — to your pocket.
 What it does 
 Connect securely to a Herdr instance on your workstation, homelab box, or VPS — over SSH, with pinned host keys and on-device Ed25519 keys.
 Fleet dashboard — a live overview of every workspace, tab, and pane with Herdr's semantic status colors, sorted so what needs you floats to the top.

flathub:io.conduktor.Conduktor.description:
Conduktor gathers all necessary information and metrics about your clusters into a single application, that makes it easy to use, understand, and act upon.
 Easy to install: in a few seconds, connect Conduktor to your clusters without hassle
 A beautiful UI and UX to help developers and ops quickly find what they need
 Light and Dark themes because as developers, we know how important it is to save our eyes
 Personalizable interface (panels, columns)
 You can work with multiple clusters, connect Conduktor to any clusters and to all the different technologies gravitating around Apache Kafka.
 Compatible with all Apache Kafka and its extensions (Schema Registry, Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, ksqlDB)
 Works with on-premise Kafka clusters, Confluent Cloud, AWS MSK, Aiven, etc.
 Works with any Kafka security: SASL, SSL, Kerberos, everything is supported.
 Multi-clusters management. Switch between multiple clusters easily. Distinguish them with colors to not make mistakes in Production!
 Spot problems early, understand root causes fast, and take action on them immediately. Our goal is to provide users with insights into their data flows.
 Instant aware of failures (Kafka, Topics, Connectors, Streams…)
 Activity of the topics, are they used or not? (throughput)
 Plug your monitoring system into Conduktor to get more specialized insights.
 Conduktor provides many features for quick data analysis in a specialized beautiful UI. Quickly verify if there are any defects in your streaming process and if your application produce correct data. It takes 5sec to configure our Consumer and get your answers.
 Consume from the past or in real-time. Use more advanced strategies like from specific offsets, or from an existing consumer group to see where your application crashed
 Filter the messages by key, value, or header values, or size. Use simple expressions or more complex ones like regular expressions
 Project your JSON or Avro data into simplified payload for quick insights
 Export your results to CSV or JSON for further processing
 It’s common to work with many formats inside Apache Kafka: CSV, JSON, the Schema Registry, the popular Apache Avro from the Big Data ecosystem, Protobuf, Google’s language-neutral data interchange format… We’re keep adding more formats, but everything you need should be already here!
 Format Auto-detection
 All basics: strings, numbers, CSV, bytes
 Apache Avro, widely used. Using the Schema Registry or not.
 Google Protobuf: a rising star in the ecosystem
 JSON Schema
 For Developers and QA Engineers, we provide ways to send data into your topics to test your applications and see how your system reacts and scales.
 Perfect to send custom payload
 Save your different messages as template inside Conduktor, to replay them anytime
 Build scenarios, send different messages into different topics and see how your applications reacts
 Replay messages from DLQ topics
 Send random data following your data schemas to test your services resiliency
 Use our Flow feature to continuously send data into topics to test your performances
 Import CSV directly into a topic
 We have a complete integration for Kafka Connect, which is an extension of Apache Kafka to reliably stream data between Apache Kafka and other data systems. We make it simple to quickly define connectors that move large data sets into and out of Kafka.
 Create and Update through a powerful wizard, no mistake possible
 Monitor the state of your integrations, restart on error
 Reset the state of your Kafka Connect to start fresh, without complexity
 We support all connectors: Debezium, JDBC, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, etc. and transformations

flathub:io.github.heidefinnischen.cuneo.name: Cuneo
flathub:io.github.heidefinnischen.cuneo.description:
Cuneo is a simple and straightforward app that lets you calculate and convert anything you might encounter in your daily life. Being designed like a widget, Cuneo gets out of the way and is best used floating over a maximized window so you can focus on your actual tasks and not managing a calculation app covering half your screen.
 Cuneo's name is inspired by the ancient writing system cuneiform. It is the earliest known wiritng system that's been originally used by the Sumer civilization. One use case for cuneiform was on numerical tablets likely to keep track of taxes, inventory, calculations and many other things people encountered in their daily lives. This is what Cuneo basically is. Cuneo is meant to be used "on-site". For when you need to get something done or look something up really quick. Designed like a tool that lives in your pocket which you get out when you need to crunch some numbers or conversions. 
 Cuneo features two distinct modes: a regular calculation mode and a conversion mode. To help you stay focused and avoid wasting any of your precious screen space, Cuneo skips the usual skeuomorphic calculator buttons. You just use the numbers on your keyboard, they're right there after all. For anything a little more complicated than your keyboard can handle theres an operator menu right at your disposal. Power users can also just type the operators like "sqrt()" for square root. 
 Conversion mode is a powerful conversion multi-tool that offers many different units to convert to and from. Unit types range from Area to Volume and Units inside these categories are grouped by common affiliation like metric and imperial. 
 For both modes Cuneo offers a history window that displays previous entries of your current session.

Obsidian is a powerful knowledge base that works on top of a local folder of plain text Markdown
 files. In Obsidian, making and following connections is frictionless, and with the connections

 CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM), along with other useful notetaking features such
 as tags, LaTeX mathematical expressions, mermaid diagrams, footnotes, internal links and embedding
 Obsidian notes or external files. Obsidian also has a plugin system with 20+ supported plugins
 to expand its capabilities.
 The documentation can be accessed by opening the demo vault that is shipped in Obsidian.
 Obsidian is free for all purposes, including personal, commercial, and non-profit use. No account
 or license is required for qualifying use cases described in the End User License Agreement. Users
 have the option to purchase a Catalyst license to get early access to insider builds and support
 the development. Additionally, Obsidian offers optional paid services for publishing and synchronizing
 your notes. Details about these optional hosted services can be found on the Obsidian website.
 This distribution is verified by the Obsidian team but isn't supported
 GPU acceleration can be disabled if necessary by setting OBSIDIAN_DISABLE_GPU=1 in Flatseal
 Pdflatex support in pandoc currently requires installing the org.freedesktop.Sdk.Extension.texlive
 SDK
 Note: Regular users should disable "Automatic Updates" within Obsidian as public release updates
 are handled by Flatpak itself. Insiders should keep this enabled to receive insider builds, as
 those will not be made available on Flathub.
 This flatpak goes into great lengths to provide a nice experience for end users. In order for
 the Git plugin to work it requires permission to the ssh-auth socket (--socket=ssh-auth). It also
 exposes the home directory in the sandbox (required for Drag and Drop operations). If you don't
 use the Git plugin you can disable the ssh-auth socket permission, e.g. using Flatseal. You can
 also remove access to the home directory if you want and the flatpak will continue to work, albeit
 with reduced functionality. In case you do remove access to the homedir, note that in order for
 things to not break for the Git plugin, --persist=.ssh flag has been passed and a bind mount to
 ~/.var/app/md.obsidian.Obsidian/ is created by flatpak, allowing that location to be used for persistent
 data (but your home directory's .ssh remains unaccessible)

fedora-packages:gcc/cpp.name: cpp
fedora-packages:gcc/cpp.description: Cpp is the GNU C-Compatible Compiler Preprocessor. Cpp is a macro processor which is used automatically by the C compiler to transform your program before actual compilation. It is called a macro processor because it allows you to define macros, abbreviations for longer constructs. The C preprocessor provides four separate functionalities: the inclusion of header files (files of declarations that can be substituted into your program); macro expansion (you can define macros, and the C preprocessor will replace the macros with their definitions throughout the program); conditional compilation (using special preprocessing directives, you can include or exclude parts of the program according to various conditions); and line control (if you use a program to combine or rearrange source files into an intermediate file which is then compiled, you can use line control to inform the compiler about where each source line originated). You should install this package if you are a C programmer and you use macros.

fedora-packages:golang-github-burntsushi.description: Toml-test is a higher-order program that tests other TOML decoders or encoders. The goal is to make it comprehensive. Tests are divided into two groups: invalid TOML data and valid TOML data. Decoders that reject invalid TOML data pass invalid TOML tests. Decoders that accept valid TOML data and output precisely what is expected pass valid tests. The output format is JSON, described below. Both decoders and encoders share valid tests, except an encoder accepts JSON and outputs TOML. The TOML representations are read with a blessed decoder and compared. Note though that encoders have their own set of invalid tests in the invalid-encoder directory. The JSON given to a TOML encoder is in the same format as the JSON that a TOML decoder should output.

By streamlining website layouts and providing options for simplified reading modes, Isharat empowers users to stay focused and engaged.
Moreover, Isharat caters to the needs of those with hearing impairments and the deaf community by offering innovative solutions such as real-time captioning and a unique tool for translating website text into sign language videos. These features break down communication barriers and facilitate seamless interaction with online content for individuals who rely on sign language as their primary mode of communication.
With Isharat, web accessibility is not just an afterthought but a core principle embedded into every aspect of the browsing experience. By leveraging cutting-edge technology and a user-centric approach, Isharat transforms the digital landscape into a more inclusive and equitable space for all.

bluejetty:00171074:ios.description:
Australia's official weather app from the Bureau of Meteorology (BOM).
Download the BOM Weather app for access to hourly and 7-day forecasts, radar, rain notifications and warnings – wherever you are. 
BOM Weather is free and ad free on mobile and tablet devices. 
The app has widgets so you can see the weather at a glance.
It also features offline mode for moments when you don't have internet.
The BOM Weather app includes:
Current weather
- Temperature and icon
- 'Feels like' temperature
- Rain
- Wind speed, direction and gust (in knots and km/h)
- Humidity
- Rainfall since 9 am
- Local text forecast
Forecasts
- Hourly forecast temperature, UV, wind, gust, humidity, dew point and rain for the next 72 hours
- 7-day forecast
- Total wave height and direction (for relevant locations)
- Sunrise and sunset times, moon phases
- Fire danger rating
- Waters forecast and summary for the coming days, including tides (for relevant locations)
Map
- See rain 90 minutes into the past and future
- View active warnings and access warning details
- Pan and zoom to anywhere in Australia
- Your location is marked on the map
- See optimal radar coverage areas while viewing rain
Rain and warning notifications
- Rain and warning notifications for up to 3 locations around Australia
- Warning notifications includes coastal hazards, fire weather, flood, heatwave, marine wind, severe thunderstorm, severe weather, tropical cyclone, and tsunami
Past weather
- Latest highs and lows, including highest and lowest temperature, highest wind gust and total rain 
- 72 hours of temperature, wind and rain
Locations

bluejetty:00089086:ios.description:
It's 7:40. One sock on, breakfast going cold, and you've said "shoes" three times.
The first time was cheerful. The second had their name in it. The third sounded like someone you never planned to be.
Your child is not being difficult. They know every step of this morning and could recite it back to you. Knowing it has never been the problem.
The problem is that the order lives in your head. You hold the sequence, you call the next step, you supply the urgency. You are not reminding your child. You are being the routine.
Star Reward Charts is a reward chart with the order built in. Something you point at together, instead of something you recite.
Your child's morning becomes a short path on the screen. Make bed, breakfast, teeth, shoes, in your family's order. The step they are on is lit up, the rest wait behind it, and they press and hold to collect their own star as each one is done.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Start with the part you dread
Pick a routine, use the guided suggestions or add your own steps, then put them in your family's order.
2. Choose how each child sees it
A rainbow path suits a six-year-old and insults a twelve-year-old, who still needs the routine. So there are five views of the same routine, from the winding path to a plain list, saved per child. The look ages out years before the need does.
3. They collect their own stars
Your child presses and holds to collect a star for a finished step. The path brightens and the next step becomes current. No approval queue, no waiting on you. And if real life happens out of order, they can still collect a later star.
4. Finish and celebrate
Completing the routine opens the treasure chest and earns gems for monster items. Stars build towards a real reward your family chose together: ice cream, the park, a toy, picking the film on Friday. That part is entirely yours.
YOU STAY IN CHARGE
- Give each routine its own steps, days, and optional reminder
- Anytime tasks keep extra jobs separate from the routine itself
- Adjust a balance, or undo a star or a reward claim, from history
- Share one iPhone, or use the same account on separate parent iPhones
- Child Mode hides parent screens and sets what each child can do
- No ads
THE ROUTINE COMES FIRST
The monster, the chest, and the gems celebrate progress. They are not the point. There is no pet to feed, no world to maintain, nothing that keeps your child in the app once the real routine is done. The chest opens because the bed got made. Then the app gets out of the way.
WHEN GETTING STARTED IS THE HARD PART
Some children stall at the start of a step, lose the thread halfway, or finish one thing with no idea what follows. Visible, ordered sequences are a familiar tool in those households, including families supporting autistic children.
If ADHD is part of your picture, the useful thing is not another reminder. It is the routine living on the screen instead of in your voice.
That is the whole design.
WHY I BUILT IT
I'm Paul, and I have ADHD. The part of me that was supposed to keep my daughter's chore chart going is the same part that loses the car keys.
I made her a paper chart. It lasted one school week. In week two I forgot to print a fresh one, and it sat on the fridge out of date while I gave the same instructions I'd always given.
What I wanted was the real routine on a screen, in order, with stars my daughters could collect themselves, because I am not reliable enough to be a dependency in my own family's morning.
And I'm still here. If something breaks, or you can't work out how to do something, you get me, not a ticketing system.

bluejetty:00122945:ios.description:
Midinero App sigue evolucionando para darte más soluciones.
Pedí tu tarjeta Midinero Internacional desde la app, sin trámites y sin molestias. Retirala en el local Redpagos que elijas en cualquier localidad del Uruguay.
Usá la app para consultar tu saldo y movimientos. También podés transferir a cuentas Midinero u otras instituciones, ser notificado cuando recibas ingresos o realices pagos, bloquear tu tarjeta ante robo o extravío, entre otras funciones.
Midinero App es la forma más segura de controlar todo lo que sucede con tu dinero.
Aquí te contamos un poco más sobre todo lo que podés hacer:
REGISTRO EN MIDINERO APP
• Registrate en Midinero App ahora es más sencillo. Solo necesitarás tu documento, tu tarjeta y un email.
• Si no tenés tarjeta, podés solicitar la Midinero Internacioinal desde la app y retirarla en el local Redpagos que elijas. 
• También podés retirar tu tarjeta Midinero Local en el momento en cualquier Redpagos del Uruguay, presentando tu documento de identidad. 
CONSULTA DE SALDO
• Entrá a ver el saldo todas las veces que necesites.
• Obtené tu número de cuenta para compartirlo.
DETALLE DE MOVIMIENTOS
• Consultá la información detallada de cada consumo, recarga, transferencia, retiro, conversión, ajuste o devolución.
• Accedé al comprobante y compartilo.
• Filtrá tus movimientos y elegí cómo querés verlos.
• Te notificamos cuando recibís dinero o cuando realizás algún consumo.
TRANSFERIR
• Transferí a otra cuenta Midinero al instante y sin costo.
• Transferí a cualquier banco de plaza.
• Utilizá la agenda de contactos para guardar tus destinatarios frecuentes.
• Utilizá tu cuenta para recibir dinero desde cualquier institución.
CONTROL DE CUENTAS
• Decidí como querés gastar tu dinero.
• Configurá alertas que te avisen cuando tu saldo es bajo.
• Ante robo o extravío, bloqueá tu tarjeta temporalmente.
• Determiná montos límites diarios en pesos y dólares.
SEGURIDAD
• Utilizá la huella o reconocimiento facial para entrar más fácil y seguro a Midinero.
• Asociá tu teléfono para tener un doble factor de verificación al momento de realizar transferencias.
• Te instruimos en como utilizar las herramientas de seguridad.
• Configurá avisos de viaje para que puedas usar tu tarjeta con tranquilidad en cualquier parte del mundo.

bluejetty:00162091:ios.description:

Aqui você tem linha direta para solucionar seus problemas, basta nos ligar!

Aqui você não é mais um cliente em muitos, aqui você é o cliente do nosso bairro.

bluejetty:00116522:ios.name: Wood Blast Escape
bluejetty:00116522:ios.summary: Get ready for Wood Blast Escape, the most engaging and satisfying wood block jam puzzle experience! Dive into a world of beautiful wooden blocks, challenging color block jams, and strategic escapes. If you love classic wood block puzzle gam
bluejetty:00116522:ios.description:
Get ready for Wood Blast Escape, the most engaging and satisfying wood block jam puzzle experience! Dive into a world of beautiful wooden blocks, challenging color block jams, and strategic escapes. If you love classic wood block puzzle games but are looking for a fresh, plot-twist, your search ends here. Sharpen your mind and enjoy a calming, yet stimulating, puzzle adventure with Wood Blast Escape!
How To Play:
- The premise of this block jam game is simple, yet mastering it is a delightful challenge. Your goal is to clear the path and free the special block.
- Analyze the Jam: Look at the tangled mess of wood block puzzle pieces.
- Slide and Solve: Tap and slide the regular wood block jam pieces vertically or horizontally to create an opening.
- The Escape: Strategically maneuver the special block until it can escape the board.
It’s a perfect blend of shape puzzle solving and clever maneuvering! This is classic blockjam fun reimagined.
Features You'll Love:
- Brain-Sharpening Puzzles: Hundreds of uniquely challenging levels that will test your spatial reasoning and problem-solving skills, making it one of the best color block puzzle games around.
- Relaxing Gameplay: Enjoy a truly stress-free experience! This is a color block game, allowing you to relax and strategize at your own pace.
- Beautiful Graphics: Immerse yourself in the gorgeous, tactile feel of the wooden blocks. The wood block sort color mechanics are visually satisfying.
- Progressive Difficulty: Start easy and gradually tackle mind-bending wood escape colour block levels that truly earn the name wood block puzzle escape!
Why Choose Wood Blast Escape?
Unlike other block puzzle games, Wood Blast Escape offers a serene yet deeply engaging experience. It perfectly combines the simplicity of shape sorting with the strategic depth of a great block jam game. Choose Wood Blast Escape for a premium, satisfying, and endlessly replayable puzzle experience.
Wood Blast Escape is perfect for:
- Fans of classic wood block puzzle games and block puzzle mechanics.
- Anyone looking for a relaxing experience.
- Players who enjoy shape puzzles and shape games that require strategy.
- Commuters or anyone needing a quick, satisfying brain boost.
- Puzzle enthusiasts seeking a fresh take on the wood block jam concept.
Download Wood Blast Escape today and start your journey to mastering the wood block puzzle escape! Slide, strategize, and solve your way through hundreds of delightful color block jams. Get ready to blast those blocks and find the escape!

bluejetty:00013822:ios.description:
Audio Memos is a professionally made audio recorder. It has an amazingly intuitive interface, which is easy to use and full of powerful features. Use it in interviews, lectures, music session, briefings, ... and simplify your recording tasks.
The New York Times - "A really useful feature is that the app can automatically start recording the moment it is started"
LifeHacker - "The best voice recording app"
TUAW - "Powerful, inexpensive, and useful"
Apple - "What's hot" section
TOP FEATURES
• Best quality - adjustable to fit your needs.
• Amazingly loud - hear your recordings.
• Background recording - multitask at will*.
• iCloud - access your memos everywhere.
• Transcription - transform your memos into text.
MORE FEATURES
• Email your recordings.
• USB file transfers.
• Append audio to existing recordings.
• Search / Sort / Filter your recordings.
• Variable speed scrubbing.
• Send recordings to a computer using WiFi.
• Records when your device is in sleep mode.
• Pauses automatically on incoming phone calls.
• No time limit on recording length.
• Application lock code.
SUBSCRIPTION
All features listed above can be used without an in app purchase. Some advanced features require an active subscription. These include:
• Voice activated rec. - stop recording silence.
• Upload to Dropbox, Google Drive, Box, Evernote, FTP or WebDAV.
• Insert audio - insert comments easily.
• Position markers - easy navigation.
• Memo alert dates / reminders.
• Adjustable reading speed.
• Add pictures to a memo.
• Send or delete multiple recordings at a time.
• Stereo recording using the builtin microphones (requires a compatible device and an active «Pro +» subscription).
Duration and price of each subscription are displayed in our storefront. All subscription costs will be charged to your Apple ID account, starting at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. It is not possible to cancel a subscription period once you have been charged for it. Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited as soon as a subscription is purchased. You can manage subscriptions and disable auto renewal by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Terms of Service: https://imesart.com/legal/terms-of-service.php
* recording will stop if another app uses the audio system.

bluejetty:00098076:ios.description:
What if a few quiet minutes could change how your day feels?
Beloved by hundreds of thousands of artists and coloring enthusiasts around the world, Artasy is your cozy space to slow down, breathe, and create — without pressure, rules, or expectations. Open the app, pick a page, and let colors guide you into a calmer state of mind. From warm interiors and peaceful cottages to soft, comforting scenes, every illustration is designed to help you unwind and reconnect with yourself.
No rush. No noise. Just you and color.
WHAT YOU'LL FIND IN ARTASY
• 2,000+ hand-crafted artworks inspired by cozy spaces, everyday moments, and peaceful scenes
• Curated collections from independent artists, each with their own distinct style and charm
• Calm background music and ambient sounds to deepen your focus while you color
• Soft, cozy brushes and palettes made for relaxing, not overthinking
• Frames and personal touches to make each artwork truly yours
• Total creative freedom: color your way, at your own pace
COLOR TOGETHER
Artasy isn't just a solo escape — it creates connection through art. Share a finished page, discover how someone across the world colored the same scene, and be reminded that creativity — in all its forms — is something worth celebrating together.
Open Artasy, start coloring, and turn ordinary breaks into something calm, creative, and quietly satisfying.
We are constantly working to make Artasy better. Please share your feedback at: artasyteam@gmail.com

Privacy Policy: https://artasy.net/privacy.html

bluejetty:00139741:ios.description:
Unofficial Pokémon Card Scanner: Card Scanner for Pokémon - Your Ultimate Card Collection Tool!
Discover the easiest way to manage and track your Pokémon TCG card collection with Card Scanner for Pokémon – the unofficial but essential tool for collectors! Whether you're a seasoned expert or just starting out, this app provides everything you need to organize, value, and share your favorite Pokémon cards—all in one place!
Key Features:
Search any card – Quickly find any Pokémon card using our up-to-date database, featuring the latest Pokémon TCG sets. With just a few taps, access detailed information on every card.
Comprehensive card details – Learn everything about each card: set, series, rarity, artist, and up-to-date market prices. Stay fully informed on your collection.
Real-time price tracking – Get detailed pricing information from multiple TCG marketplaces, including price variations by card condition (mint, near mint, etc.). Stay ahead of market trends!
Organize your personal collection – Effortlessly create and manage your personal Pokémon card collection. Simply scan your cards to add them to your digital collection, and track your progress in one place.
Share your favorites – Show off your rarest and most valuable cards with friends and family by sharing all the card details and pricing with just a click.
Track collection value – Monitor the real-time value of your entire card collection. Keep track of market fluctuations and watch your collection appreciate in value.
Whether you’re buying, selling, or simply a Pokémon TCG enthusiast, Card Scanner for Pokémon is the ultimate companion for collectors of all levels.

bluejetty:00176597:ios.description:
Creepy Maria is a simulation and horror game made in 24 hours to pass the time in the bathroom or in the early morning, discover the secrets of the kitten Maria.
If you love horror games, creepy mysteries and strange virtual pets, Creepy Maria will surprise you.
At first, Maria looks like a normal talking cat… but something is wrong. Her eyes, her behavior, and the way she reacts to you make this one of the most unusual horror games on mobile.
Take care of Maria like a virtual pet, but be careful… the more you interact with her, the more secrets you may uncover.
What you can do with Maria
• Feed Maria and keep her alive
• Talk to Maria and hear her respond
• Play mini-games and earn coins
• Let Maria sleep, clean her, and interact with her
• Discover strange and creepy secrets hidden in the game
Unlike other pet simulators, this experience mixes simulation with psychological horror, creating a strange and unsettling atmosphere.
Why players love Creepy Maria
• A unique mix of virtual pet and horror games
• A creepy cat unlike anything you have seen
• Simple gameplay you can play anytime
• Weird secrets and mysterious interactions
• Perfect for late-night gaming sessions
If you enjoy creepy horror games, talking pet simulators, scary mobile games, and strange internet mysteries, Creepy Maria is an experience you should try.

bluejetty:00040037:ios.description:
NoteX: AI Note Taker, AI Meeting Agent, AI Notebook & Voice to Notes
Live Transcription, Meeting Agent & Smart Summaries
NoteX is an all-in-one AI note taker and intelligent notebook that transforms meetings, lectures, and conversations into clear notes, summaries, and presentations. Designed for professionals, students, and teams, NoteX helps you stay focused while AI captures, organizes, and turns information into actionable knowledge.
Live Transcription and Multilingual Meetings
NoteX provides real-time AI transcription for meetings, lectures, and discussions with high accuracy. It supports multilingual meetings, allowing you to transcribe and translate conversations across multiple languages, making it ideal for global teams, international classes, and remote collaboration.
AI Meeting Agent for Online Meetings
With the built-in AI meeting agent, NoteX can automatically join online meetings using a meeting link and capture everything for you. It supports Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and WebEx, ensuring you never miss important discussions even when you cannot attend live.
Calendar Sync for Automated Note Taking
Connect your calendar to NoteX and let AI prepare for upcoming meetings automatically. Notes, transcripts, and summaries are generated and organized without manual setup, creating a seamless workflow from scheduling to follow-up.
Voice to Notes and Meeting Minutes
Record or upload voice and instantly convert speech into structured notes, meeting minutes, key points, and action items. NoteX delivers fast, reliable results so you can focus on the conversation instead of typing.
AI Notebook That Connects Your Knowledge
All your notes live in one intelligent AI notebook that links related information, improves search, and helps you rediscover insights when you need them. Your notebook becomes smarter as you use it.
Smart Summaries, Visual Insights, and Slides
NoteX automatically creates concise summaries and visual insights from your notes. You can generate mind maps to understand complex topics and instantly turn notes into clean, professional slide decks for presentations, recaps, or study review.
Study Tools and Knowledge Sharing
Turn notes into flashcards and quizzes to improve learning and retention. Convert your notes into audio or video explanations to share ideas quickly with others.
Built for Work, Study, and Creation
NoteX is perfect for professionals who need accurate meeting minutes and action summaries, students who want to transform lectures into organized study materials, and creators who want to turn conversations and research into reusable content.
Why Choose NoteX
NoteX combines live transcription, multilingual support, an AI meeting agent, calendar sync, and an intelligent notebook into one simple app. It is secure, private, and designed to save time while increasing clarity and productivity.
Do not just take notes. Let AI attend meetings, capture conversations, and transform information into knowledge.
Download NoteX today and experience the next generation of AI note taking.

bluejetty:00095279:ios.description:
Welcome to Garden & Home: Design Game – your peaceful escape into a world of creativity, style, and serenity!
Step into a delightful design journey where you can decorate cozy homes and create your dream garden – one flower, one room, and one puzzle at a time. Whether you’re a passionate interior decorator, a garden lover, or simply looking for a relaxing game, this experience is made just for you.
TRANSFORM YOUR GARDEN INTO A BLOOMING HAVEN
Build your dream outdoor space from the ground up! Choose from hundreds of plants, flowers, trees, sculptures, fountains, and more. Add paths, lighting, garden furniture, and unique decor items to shape a vibrant, colourful paradise. Unlock new garden sections and express your creativity with complete freedom.
DESIGN STUNNING INTERIORS
From cozy cottages to modern villas, every house you enter is a new opportunity to create. Style living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms with your favorite furniture, color palettes, wall art, and flooring options. Embrace a variety of interior design styles: boho, rustic, Scandinavian, modern, and more.
RELAX WITH FUN MATCH-3 PUZZLES
Earn stars by playing enjoyable match-3 levels that challenge and relax you at the same time. Use boosters and clever strategies to solve puzzles, unlock decor items, and progress through the game. Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, you’ll enjoy satisfying gameplay that fuels your creativity.
ENJOY ENDLESS DESIGN POSSIBILITIES
Every player has a unique style, and in Garden & Home, you can show it off! Each space you design becomes part of your personal journey. Mix and match, redesign whenever you want, and discover new items through special events and seasonal updates.
DISCOVER AESTHETIC THEMES AND EVENTS
Play through limited-time events and themed design challenges that offer exclusive furniture sets and seasonal garden elements. Celebrate holidays like Christmas, Halloween, and Spring Bloom with beautifully crafted decorations!
WHY YOU’LL LOVE GARDEN & HOME: DESIGN GAME
• Design gardens, patios, terraces, and beautiful indoor spaces
• Create peaceful, cozy environments that reflect your style
• Enjoy a perfect balance of relaxing puzzles and fun design tasks
• Hundreds of decor items, including furniture, plants, art, and more
• Unwind anytime with offline play – no internet required
• Frequent updates bring new content, puzzles, and surprises
• A cozy, feel-good game for all ages – no pressure, just fun!
Whether you’re curled up on the couch or taking a break during the day, Garden & Home is your go-to escape into a relaxing, creative world.
Let your imagination bloom. Build, design, and play your way to the most beautiful home and garden ever!
Download Garden & Home: Design Game today and begin your makeover journey!

bluejetty:00125911:ios.name: Staslink: Satellites Tracker
bluejetty:00125911:ios.summary:
Satellites ISS & Star Tracker helps you identify the best time to catch a glimpse of International Space Station & Starlink satellites on your night sky. 
Input your location and tap through to find the best times to observe them near your
bluejetty:00125911:ios.description:
Satellites ISS & Star Tracker helps you identify the best time to catch a glimpse of International Space Station & Starlink satellites on your night sky. 
Input your location and tap through to find the best times to observe them near your area. Reminders can be set for upcoming launches and/or high visibility sightings around your location. The satellites & ISS routes in low Earth orbit can be discovered through the 'Live Map'.
Track the Starlink Satellites & International Space Station in real-time with HD Live Map and Smart Tracking Engine. Explore the universe and outer space life under the astronaut perspective with Livestream videos directly from NASA. 
You can also have the chances to stargaze when tracking the orbits through live videos. Plan ahead your plan to catch the glimpse of ISS and SpaceX satellites on the night sky in your area with provided statistics & reminders. 
Satellites ISS & Star Tracker gives you access to the 24/7 Live HD video of the Earth & Starlink launch recorded directly by NASA. As the ISS station orbits with an average altitude of 250 miles (400 kilometers), you can follow its camera & explore all the Earth's surface within roughly 93 minutes. 
Launched 60 at a time, the Starlink is described as a "train" of lights as they gracefully move through our skies. With Google Maps integrated into the app, users can easily track the ISS and Starlink around the globe and monitor its movement. 
Satellites ISS & Star Tracker features:
+ Live camera feed of ISS & Starlink directly from NASA.
+ Track the ISS & Starlink around the globe with a Live Map.
+ Reminders for upcoming Starlink visits with visibility predictions.
+ Check the ISS & Starlink's live statistics to locate it more easily on the night sky. 
+ Predicted ISS & Starlink location for users for better monitoring and planning at the night sky.
Note:
When the International Space Station is on the night side of Earth, the video image is black - this is normal. Please do not worry!
Sometimes, the live video is not available due to transmission issues or because the crew is changing cameras. In such cases, you will usually have a blue or blank screen. In a few minutes the transmission should return back to normal, so just relax for a moment. This is not a problem with the app.
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with neither NASA nor ISS nor Starlink or any space related platforms. All the videos are rights reserved by NASA, we do not own any of these videos. 
Terms of Use: http://vulcanlabs.co/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: http://vulcanlabs.co/privacy-policy/
Any questions? Contact us: support@vulcanlabs.com

STEEZY is the #1 dance studio on your iPhone, iPad, or smart TV – use it to learn to dance step-by-step, at a pace that works for you.
Copying music videos will only get you so far. If you really want to master the dance styles of today, you need to learn from the best dancers and instructors. STEEZY brings the professionalism of a world-class dance school to you.
STEEZY instructors are the best in the game. You’ll regularly find them competing in international competitions, touring, or starring in music videos, and they are here to teach YOU!

bluejetty:00129073:ios.description:
Download the official app for Hong Kong Disneyland! 
Enhance your next visit with an enchanting mobile experience. See approximate wait times for attractions, browse the park map, see schedules and much more!
- Check Wait Times: See attraction approximate wait times at a glance and make better use of time in your adventure.
- Exploring Made Easy:  Find what you’re looking for at the park with a GPS-enabled map that show your location and the attractions, Character Greetings, restaurants, shops and more near you.
- The Details You Need:  See park hours, Character Greeting times, show schedules and accessibility information, plus descriptions of attractions, entertainment and more.
- Make Reservations: Enjoy 1-tap calling for restaurant and hotel reservations.
- A Plus for Magic Access Members: View blockout calendars and see your merchandise, food and beverage discounts at select restaurants and shops. 
- Order food and beverage ahead: save time for magical journey.
- Magic AR: Guests can explore Elsa’s Ice Magic, as well as interact, take photos and videos with beloved Frozen friends at our Frozen themed land, World of Frozen.
Make your visit more magical with the Hong Kong Disneyland app! 
Download it before your next visit. 
Note: Before downloading this app, please consider that some app features require location data as well as a Wi-Fi or mobile carrier data connection. In addition, this app will access your device’s external storage in order to  store debug logs and your device’s accounts to store and retrieve a public token in a secure fashion that is needed to access server content. 
This app uses location services to display Guests’ approximate position on the map.
This app is available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
This app provides you with the option to receive push notifications for information relating to your visit to Hong Kong Disneyland Resort.
This app will request access to your camera to let you send and upload photos and contains links that let you share and connect with others through social media. To download photos to your device, the app will request access to your external storage.
This app provides you with a Baidu map. Baidu collects, uses and shares certain information in accordance with its privacy policy found here: http://www.baidu.com/duty/yinsiquan.html
Terms of Use: https://disneytermsofuse.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.hongkongdisneyland.com/privacy-legal
By downloading and/or using the app, you are deemed to have understood and consented to the above.

FOR FLYING, PICKING UP, OR FOLLOWING A FLIGHT

bluejetty:00186128:ios.description:
Key Features:
Ask Anything in Tigrinya — Chat with an AI that understands Tigrinya questions, expressions, idioms, and cultural context.
Audio — Tigrinya speech technology: text‑to‑audio and audio‑to‑text for natural voice interaction.
Full‑Sentence Tigrinya Translation — Translate complete sentences between Tigrinya and 20+ languages with natural, context aware results.
Rich Tigrinya Dictionary — Definitions, usage examples, synonyms, and variant spellings (Tigrinya, Tigrigna).
Built for Low‑Resource Language Support — Modern AI tools designed to strengthen digital access for millions of Tigrinya speakers worldwide.
Clean, Fast, Modern Interface — Simple layout, instant responses, and a distraction‑free design.
Why Tigrinya AI Matters:
Tigrinya is one of the world’s least digitally supported languages. Tigrinya AI changes that by offering modern tools that match global standards translation, dictionary, AI chat, and upcoming speech features all tailored to the language’s grammar, script, and cultural nuance.
This app helps students, diaspora communities, travellers, professionals, and anyone wanting to communicate clearly in Tigrinya.
Perfect For:
Eritrean & Ethiopian diaspora
Students learning Tigrinya
Translators & interpreters
Families teaching children the language
Anyone needing accurate Tigrinya communication

Our puzzle game includes large numbers of levels. Some levels might be hard. Challenge your mind and solve the puzzles, and then you will find them easy and exciting!

Sharpen your strategic skills as you pair tiles in this timeless puzzle game. Conquer challenging levels that will leave you refreshed and revitalized. Power-ups and obstacles add an exciting and unpredictable twist to each level.Tile Block Jam is an engaging game that perfectly balances strategy and relaxation, catering to players of all skill levels.

The game's objective is simple: match open pairs of identical tiles and clear the board. With its captivating gameplay, Tile Block Jam has won the hearts of puzzle enthusiasts around the globe. Prepare for a challenging puzzle tile adventure that will keep you coming back for more!


How To Play

- Match the same tiles on the board!
- Tap 3 of the same tiles to remove them!
- Use a booster when you are having a hard time!


Features

- Easy to learn and quite addictive
- No time limit, so no rush, just relax playing matching tiles
- Beautiful graphics and various layouts
- Hours of gameplay for you to enjoy
- Free to play and no wifi needed


Ready To Play

- Available to play on mobile and tablet devices!
- Casual and easy gameplay, open your mind!
- Connect all fruits and eliminate them! Enjoy this free puzzle board game! 
- Much harder level, unique tile sets. Challenge yourself! 



With thousands of tile puzzles in various layouts and stunning graphics, this game is sure to keep you entertained for hours. If you love playing tile games , puzzle games, dominoes games, chess games, or other board games, then Tile Block Jam is the perfect game for you!

Introducing Fidelity Youth®—a free* app that helps teens save and invest their own money. Teens can practice good money habits with features that help them organize their goals, monitor their spending, and save money automatically. For Teens:
See how Fidelity Youth® can help you invest, manage, and make your own money.
Invest:
Fidelity Youth® helps teens learn to invest early to put their money to work.
 - Learn about investing with tools and tips in the app’s learning center.
 - Get the only investment account that teens can own themselves.
Manage:
Fidelity Youth® helps teens learn to manage how they save.
 - Organize your money with customizable buckets.
 - Set rules to save money automatically.
 - Enjoy no subscription fees, account fees, or minimum balance.†
Make:
Fidelity Youth® helps teens get started making their own money.
 - Request and receive money from your parent or guardian.
 - Set up direct deposits to easily get your paychecks.
 - Exchange unwanted gift cards for cash you can save or invest.
For Parents or Guardians:
Help your teen develop a sense of financial independence—with your guidance.
 - Track how your teen saves and spends every month.
 - Support their financial learning.
 - Easily send money between accounts.
 - Set up recurring allowance payments.
 - View your teen’s account activity (trades and transactions).
 - Close your teen’s debit card or account at any time.
 - Fidelity Customer Protection Guarantee.
 - View multiple children’s account activity and learning progress.
 - Get 24/7 support.‡
*The Fidelity Youth® app is free to download. Fees associated with your account positions or transacting in your account apply.
†Zero account minimums and zero account fees apply to retail brokerage accounts only. Book of Mormon
Discover the depth of spiritual heritage with the Book of Mormon app — a unique tool for exploring one of the central texts of the Latter-day Saint movement. This app combines sacred writings, commentary, and historical context to help you better understand the teachings and beliefs of this tradition.
Main Features:
• Daily Scripture Reflections: Start your day with insights inspired by selected passages from the Book of Mormon, featuring ancient prophecies and spiritual guidance. (pro subscription required)
• Step-by-Step Scripture Study: Read, reflect, pray, and deepen your relationship with God by following a structured spiritual study approach. (pro subscription required)
• Historical and Cultural Context: Dive into the story of ancient peoples on the American continent from 2200 B.C. to A.D. 421, as taught by the Latter-day Saint tradition. (pro subscription required)
• Audio Passages of Prophecy: Listen to professionally narrated excerpts from the Book of Mormon anytime for a deeper and more accessible spiritual experience. (pro subscription required)
• Church Calendar Integration: Keep track of significant events and dates meaningful to the faith community and stay aligned with your spiritual rhythm. (pro subscription required)
• Educational Tools: Enhance your knowledge with interactive features — explore theological themes, take quizzes, and study the structure of the scripture. (pro subscription required)
Book of Mormon is more than just an app — it’s your personal guide to understanding the teachings of the Latter-day Saint movement. Whether you're a newcomer or a devoted follower, this app helps you strengthen your spiritual practice and connection.

bluejetty:00119382:ios.description:
Keep your John Deere riding lawn mower running its best and know how you mow with the John Deere MowerPlus app. Simply scan your lawn tractor’s barcode to get custom information on your equipment. The app helps you determine the best time to mow, communicates expert pre-mow tips, offers maintenance reminders, and provides walk-through guides. Ready to mow? Select “Mow Now”, slide your phone into your pocket, and MowerPlus records your mowing path, total mowing time, as well as speed and coverage data for your mowing session.
New for 2019 - Get machine information automatically using the new MowerPlus Smart Connector and MowerPlus Hour Meter (see your local dealer for availability and compatibility). 
Note: The app supports residential lawn equipment such as 100 Series, S240, X300, X500, X700, Z200 through Z600, and many similarly-sized older products. It does not presently support tractor models numbered 1000 and larger, such as 1025R. The app uses most recent product images. Some variation may exist from prior model years.

bluejetty:00121152:ios.description:
The Daystar app is a new way to interact with the fastest-growing, faith-based network in the world! You can enjoy the Daystar live stream or keep up with your favorite videos with Daystar on Demand. 
New Daystar version with improved experience and new features.
The Daystar team is pleased to announce a new version of the Daystar app. In this release, users will continue to enjoy all existing content, now with an enhanced and more intuitive experience. The app design has been updated to improve navigation and make it easier for users to interact with content.
Note: The features and navigation logic described below establish the new global standard for the Daystar mobile ecosystem across all platforms.
Core Functionalities & Updates
- New Floating Menu (Global Navigation)
A persistent navigation overlay designed to provide quick access to the platform’s core sections.
Menu Options: Home, My List, Radio, and Donate.
Behavior: The Donate option opens a new browser window on the user’s device.
- Radio Button (Persistent Audio)
A dedicated toggle within the Floating Menu that provides a seamless audio-only experience.
Function: Pressing the button activates the live audio stream.
Interaction: The button functions as a toggle; pressing it again stops playback.
Note: If the radio is activated while a video is playing, the video will automatically stop.
- Long Press Trailer (Smart Discovery)
A new interaction that allows users to preview content without leaving the main feed.
Description: Plays the first 30 seconds of any video within a modal window.
Access Methods:
 - Long press on any video thumbnail
 - Tap the three dots (…) icon in the bottom-right corner of the video card
- DaystarTV Live (Default Engagement)
To ensure immediate viewer engagement upon entering the app environment.
Behavior: The live video stream automatically plays by default when the application is launched.
- Top Trending Content
A dynamic, CMS-driven carousel that highlights the platform’s most popular content.
Purpose: Improves discoverability by surfacing real-time global trends to users.
*Live stream is broadcast in US Central time
Terms of Service: https://www.daystar.tv/tos
Privacy Policy: https://daystar.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00096501:ios.name: Yogio: Chair Yoga & Tai Chi
bluejetty:00096501:ios.summary:
Yogio brings chair yoga, tai chi and gentle Pilates together in one personal plan for seniors and beginners. Every program was created with a rehabilitation specialist and is led by certified instructors.
Lean on a chair for support. Feel
bluejetty:00096501:ios.description:
Yogio brings chair yoga, tai chi and gentle Pilates together in one personal plan for seniors and beginners. Every program was created with a rehabilitation specialist and is led by certified instructors.
Lean on a chair for support. Feel steadier on your feet, without the fear of falling. Strengthen your core and posture. Everything is done seated or standing, in 5–20 minutes a day - no floor, no jumping, no pressure.
WHY YOU CAN TRUST YOUR PLAN
• Expert-built - programs designed with a rehabilitation specialist and a movement methodologist
• Truly personal - your plan is matched to your age, body and level, from Absolute Beginner up
• Injury-aware - mark your back, knees, hips, shoulders or wrists, and your plan avoids moves that strain them
• Low-impact by design - no floor work, no jumping, no equipment beyond a chair
• Clear guidance - 1,400+ guided exercises with video, step-by-step instructions, voice guidance and calm music
HOW IT WORKS
1. Tell us about you - your goals (like gentle weight loss or better balance), level and any sensitive areas.
2. Get your personal plan - a mix of chair yoga, tai chi and Pilates.
3. Practice a little every day. Your plan grows with you as you get stronger.
WHAT YOU CAN PRACTICE
CHAIR YOGA
Seated yoga and stretching to ease stiffness, support gentle weight loss and help you feel lighter in your body.
TAI CHI
Beginner-friendly tai chi for balance, mobility and calm, steady strength. Move at your own pace.
PILATES
Gentle core and posture sessions, including wall Pilates, with a chair or a wall for support.
TOOLS THAT KEEP YOU GOING
• Daily check-in - tell us your mood, body and energy, and today's session adapts
• AI Coach - remembers your workouts and chats, checks in on you and answers questions anytime
• Printable weekly plans - a new one every week. Download, print and practice anywhere
• 28-day challenges and streaks, with streak freezes for busy days
• A coach you connect with - practice with Margaret, Joy, Helen and others, or go solo
Download Yogio and start the plan made for your body. Feel stronger day by day.
FAQ
Can chair yoga help with weight loss?
Yes, it can be a gentle place to start. Regular low-impact movement supports healthy weight loss, especially alongside balanced habits. Most of all, you'll feel lighter and more comfortable moving.
Can I do Yogio with bad knees or back pain?
Yes. During setup you can mark sensitive areas, and your plan swaps out moves that put stress on them. Always follow your doctor's advice.
What's the difference between chair yoga and tai chi?
Chair yoga uses a chair for support while you stretch and strengthen. Tai chi is a slow, flowing practice that focuses on balance and coordination. Yogio combines both in one plan.
Is Yogio safe for seniors who are afraid of falling?
Every session is low-impact and done seated or standing, with a chair for support and no jumping. Programs were created with a rehabilitation specialist, and tai chi sessions focus on balance, so you build confidence step by step.
SUBSCRIPTION
Yogio is free to download. To unlock your full personalized plan, choose a 1-month, 3-month or 6-month subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Yogio offers general fitness guidance, not medical advice. If you have a health condition, check with your doctor before starting a new exercise routine.
Terms of Use: https://www.yogio.net/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.yogio.net/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00085084:ios.name: Ultimate Scoreboard
bluejetty:00085084:ios.summary: Versatile and highly customizable scoreboard that lets you track any game and share standings and results with friends and family! Can also be used as a "real" scoreboard by connecting to an external screen by HDMI or AirPlay mirroring, or
bluejetty:00085084:ios.description:
Versatile and highly customizable scoreboard that lets you track any game and share standings and results with friends and family! Can also be used as a "real" scoreboard by connecting to an external screen by HDMI or AirPlay mirroring, or use up to 7 other iDevices as external screens by connecting them over the network. 
Features:
- Choose between 6 different layouts when presented on an external screen.
- Adjustable length- and number of periods.
- Set up teams with optional logos and colors.
- Penalties - shows up to three concurrent penalties per team, supports unlimited concurrent penalties. Penalties can be edited and removed.
- Shot clock.
- Timeouts.
- Intermissions.
- All clocks can be adjusted, even while still running. Long tap to enter edit mode.
- Change clock direction.
- Get a notification when the period or game ends if the app is running in the background (you need to accept push notifications for this to work).
- Sound effects: select from a rich set of sound effects for events such as scoring, match clock start/stop, period end, game won, penalty or timeout expiration etc.
- Customize the colors and fonts of clocks, scores and teams individually.
- Select your own background for an even more personal touch.
- Share results on social media, Email, messages etc.
- Use the companion Apple Watch app to control the scoreboard from your wrist, maybe even as one of the participants?
- Show a big scoreboard by connecting a TV by cable or AirPlay mirroring and select from a number of different layouts.
- Connect up to 7 iPads or iPhones over the network and use them as external screens. Each connected scoreboard can use it's own separate layout and styling.
- Supports most sports including Soccer, Ice hockey, Basketball, Tennis, Padel, Handball, Floorball, Lacrosse and many more.
- Connect external buttons (Flic) to control the scoreboard as one of the participants or a referee. Wear the button on your wrist or on your cloths, stick it to the side of your table tennis table... you get the idea.

bluejetty:00088748:ios.name: Euchre ‣
bluejetty:00088748:ios.summary:
Euchre card game classic • Solo and Multiplayer • Smart bots • Thousands of people to play with • Play online with friends • Interactive tutorial • Free and no signup required!
Play Euchre to your heart's content with the official Euchre c
bluejetty:00088748:ios.description:
Euchre card game classic • Solo and Multiplayer • Smart bots • Thousands of people to play with • Play online with friends • Interactive tutorial • Free and no signup required!
Play Euchre to your heart's content with the official Euchre card game app from World of Card Games. Pair up with people by joining one of our tables, play by yourself against our bots, or create a private table and invite your friends and family to play. Our game is free to play and no signup is required.
Euchre is played by 2 teams consisting of 2 people each, with partners sitting across from each other. The game's objective is to reach 10 points first. At the start of the game, each player is dealt 5 cards from a deck containing only Ace, King, Queen, Jacks, 10s and 9s. A single card is dealt face-up, and players can then accept it as the trump suit or pass. If all 3 players pass, the dealer must play with the card being the trump suit.
Players must follow the suit of the lead player. The highest card of that suit wins the trick unless a trump card is played. If a person wins a trick, that person leads the next trick. A team is called the "Maker" team if they choose the trump suit, and the other team is called the "Defending" team.
Defenders score 2 points for 3 or more tricks, and makers score 1 point for 3 and 4 tricks and 2 points for all 5 tricks. Every player can choose to ignore their partner's card, which is called "Going alone". The first team to reach 10 points wins the game.
We're always open to suggestions, so feel free to reach out to us at https://worldofcardgames.com/euchre with suggestions for improvements.
=== FEATURES:
=== Play against the computer using our bots
If you're new to a game, playing against others can feel intimidating. We always suggest playing against the computer before playing against other people. Our intelligent bots should be challenging enough, even for experienced players.
=== Play against other people online
We have a great community of card players. People are generally really nice to each other, and you can always find an open table to join. Just click List of Tables to find a table to your liking.
=== Play against friends or family at a private table
Meeting fellow card game enthusiasts online is nice, but nothing beats a game against friends or family. Start a private table and let your friends know about the table name to get them to join.
=== Ranked games and global leaderboards
If you're serious about your card games or have a competitive streak, ranked games are for you. These games are reserved for more series players and will only be accessible to you once you've signed up and played 10 games. Ranked players have a chance to end up on the daily leaderboard.
=== Custom design and avatars
Change the background and card design to something that suits you better. With 160+ different avatars, you're sure to be able to find one to your liking.
=== Join ongoing games and chat with other players
Click List of Tables to join an ongoing game. There are always live players at the site, so you're sure to find someone to play with. You can even chat with other players once you've joined a game, but remember to be friendly!
=== Detailed statistics and hand histories
Sign up to the site to be able to see detailed statistics. You can even save your hand history so you have a chance to analyze them later on!
