bluejetty:00023387:ios.description:
The Blue Tractor's here to teach! There's no kid that he can't reach!
In the game, you'll learn more about:
Animals and flowers!
Plants and trees!
Numbers! How many are there? What shapes are there? What's the world around us like?
Kids will study, kids will learn 'cause the Tractor knows it all!
Together with the main character, your kid will complete all the steps from introduction to the topic to making logical links between the object, its shape and meaning! Funny play-centered tasks will help to practice what has been learned!
Why begin your journey around the world with the Blue Tractor:
- 7 educational topics;
- over 200 objects to study;
- the game adapts to each kid's needs;
- trains attention, logic, and memory;
- develops dexterity;
- play-centered tasks;
- suitable for kids below 3!
Most importantly, your kid will learn things happily!
Kids will study:
- NUMBERS
With our easy and fun method to learn numbers!
- SHAPES
What do triangles and squares look like? How is an oval different from a circle?
- COLORS
Let's learn all the rainbow colors! We'll see what color gooseberries are, as well as foxes and many other objects!
- PLANTS
What vegetables, fruits, and berries are there? What do different flowers and trees look like?
- ANIMALS
Animals, birds, sea creatures, dinosaurs and pets! What sounds do they make? What do they eat?
- TRANSPORT
Sea vessels, aircrafts, public transport, and even emergency vehicles! How is a steamship different from a yacht? What does a limousine look like?
- PROFESSIONS
Who does your kid want to be? A builder, a doctor, a cook, an artist? Or maybe, a musician?
We are sure the learning with the Blue Tractor will help your kid to make the first steps towards knowing it all about the surrounding world!
Our game has all the necessary tools for fun learning!
Game tips will help the smallest users to study independently day by day.
Download the game, and let's explore the world together!

bluejetty:00128073:ios.description:
Let us present the wildest Touchgrind game so far, TOUCHGRIND SCOOTER, brought to you by the creators of Touchgrind BMX 2 and Touchgrind Skate 2. We took the core of the Touchgrind brand, listened closely to OUR PLAYERS suggestions and feedback and created the most advanced and stunning Touchgrind game yet.
FEATURES
* Revolutionary TWO FINGER CONTROLS as seen in Touchgrind BMX 2
* Customizable SCOOTERS: standard, epic and legendary with loads of gear and color combinations
* FEATURES realistic 3D graphics, an amazing original soundtrack accompanied by heavy sound effects
* GRIND and RIDE FAKIE
* Countless amount of UNLOCKABLE scooters and gear
* VARIOUS GAME MODES: tricky, freestyle & versus
* PERSONALIZED profile
* Heaps of CHALLENGES and TROPHIES on each location
* Full-blown RANKING SYSTEM on each location – world, country, city and among friends
* Super REALISTIC PHYSICS
* EPIC and LEGENDARY scooters that will make your jaw drop
* Gmail and Apple connectivity to SAVE & SYNC PROGRESS between devices
TAKE CONTROL AND RULE YOUR CITY when beating local rivals in your own region. Will you be the dominating rider and for how long? Compete on a big or small scale: globally, in your country or even in your OWN HOMETOWN. 
BECOME A LEGEND and prove your dominance whilst exploring urban locations in a large city. BE TOUGH and keep up with the best scooter competitors globally when racing on multiple tracks on each location. Grind escalators and rails, boost off huge jumps, ramps and ledges, score insane fakie trick combos and you may be just one step closer to becoming the best rider in the world.
DESIGN, CHANGE GEAR and assemble your customizable Scooter with hundreds of colors to choose from. Earn and unlock additional gear, epic and legendary scooters and much more.
CHALLENGE YOURSELF IN VARIOUS GAME MODES and rank up! Secure shiny trophies and compare your best scores with other players around the globe or in your own region. Learn and improve your skills by checking out other players’ runs. Glory awaits those skilled enough to master fakie riding, backflips, rider flips, grinds and many other tricks. So what are you waiting for?
REALISTIC GRAPHICS AND ORIGINAL MUSIC make Touchgrind Scooter a truly breathtaking gaming experience. Once you break the rules of gravity, get the hang of speed, style and precision and watch your Scooter soar in this adrenaline-fueled Scooter game nothing will stop you from becoming THE Legend!
Follow us on Twitter and TikTok: 
@ILLUSIONLABS
Check out great videos and more on our YouTube page!
www.youtube.com/user/ILLUSIONLABS
Find out more about the game on the official Web page:
http://www.touchgrindscooter.com

bluejetty:00182950:ios.description:
Make your own music and have fun! Create beats and tracks with this awesome drum pad machine and a huge library of ready to use high-quality sounds. Over 30,000,000 users make music with us! Musicians and beatmakers, we’ve designed our app for you. 
SOUND PACKS
Create your own music with 15 000+ sounds in different genres in our library including dubstep, trap, EDM, future beats, chill, neuro funk, big room house, electro.
Every sound pack is created with love by our professional music team or in collaboration with famous producers and DJs.
Fresh sound packs every week.
FEED 
Get sound packs from beatmakers all over the world in our unique feed. Or create your own sound pack and see how the likes and downloads grow ;)
PAD EDITOR
Create your own sound packs: sample audio from video, import your own audio files, use our sounds, record vocals or real instruments with a microphone. Make your sound pack and share it. Collaborate with your friends and make something absolutely new (or funny ;) ).
PATTERN EDITOR a.k.a step sequencer
Another way to create beats is to use a pattern editor with 16 x 4 steps for each pad and create more interesting and complicated beats! Enable pattern editor for any pad and use one of four pattern slots to set up your rhythms. 
RECORD 
Record your own track, turn it into a video, and share it with your friends.
JOIN COMMUNITY
Create your own tracks, train your finger drumming skills, have fun, and record freestyle sessions with your friends. Share your beat via messengers, add them to Soundcloud, upload your performances to Youtube or Instagram with #drumpads24
Drum Pads 24 is the key to have fast fingers so that can be epic on any drum pad controller.
Perfect rhythm app with step sequencer approved by professional beatmakers!
Watch new videos from Drum Pads 24 Crew members and learn new beat making tricks. Share your beats, share your music, share the fun!

In today's digital world, privacy is more important than ever. With Photo Vault, you can ensure that your personal photos, videos, and private data remain completely secure and hidden from unauthorized access.
==================
Ultimate Features to Keep Your Privacy Secure!
- Face ID & Touch ID Unlock: Use Face ID or Touch ID for quick, secure access.

- Secret Browser: Browse privately with your history and data kept secure.

- Intruder Alert & Break-In Reports: Automatically captures a photo of anyone trying to break into your vault.

1. Open SafeCalc.
2. Enter your secret passcode.
3. Securely store your photos, videos, notes, and files inside.
4. If someone tries to access it with the wrong passcode, Intruder Alert captures their photo!
5. Use Touch ID or Face ID for quick access anytime.
It’s that simple!
==================
Help & Support :
Visit Our Site at https://safecalc.app/contact-us

bluejetty:00124403:ios.description:
Amazon Photos lets you store and share full-resolution photos, keeping favorite moments secure and in the spotlight. Prime members in United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, France, Italy, Spain and Japan receive unlimited photo storage and 5GB of video storage. Not a Prime member? All Amazon Photos customers receive 5 GB full-resolution photo and video storage.
The following features are available for Amazon customers in the US: 
- Storage: Free 5 GB combined photo and video cloud storage means you keep memories secure while freeing up space in your phone
- Full-resolution: Keep your original image’s resolution: more pixels equal better quality photos and videos
- Display photos on devices: View photo memories on your Echo Show and Fire TV instead of tucked away in a phone or camera. Customize your Fire TV screensaver and Echo Show photo display with family and travel photos.
- Order prints: Consider Amazon Photos a one-stop-shop for turning memories into photo prints, custom gifts, and home décor. Available only in the U.S. 
- Secure photos: Back up photos and videos automatically by turning on Auto-Save in Settings
- Alexa: Enjoy many features using just your voice on your Echo Show and Fire TV or with the Alexa app on your mobile phone. Try saying, “Alexa, show my photos”
- Subscriptions: Expand storage (and cancel any time) with flexible monthly plans starting at $0.99
- Search: Easily locate photos when you search by date or location
- Auto-Save: Enable Auto-Save in Settings to automatically secure every photo and video you take.
- Re-live Memories: View and share photos from this date in years past, whether it’s one year ago or five years ago. See special moments set to music and re-surfaced as a curated slideshow to re-live the good times.
- Privacy: Share photos and albums with friends and family by inviting them to a private Amazon Photos Group. Consolidate photos of special events (vacations, playoffs, parties, graduations) into a single album.
US Prime members get all the above PLUS
- Unlimited photo storage 
- 5 GB video storage 
- Refined search filtering
- 45% off Shutterfly regularly priced products plus free shipping for orders over $35 
Get the app and upload your photos
Upload your photo collection to access memories across all your devices.
Amazon Photos provides online cloud storage. Easily access pictures stored across devices such as your Fire TV, Echo Show, and Amazon Fire tablet. Securely store, print, and share photos: Once saved to the cloud, you can safely delete them from your phone to free up space. Safekeeping your photos and videos in the cloud keeps them secure, even if your devices (and the pictures in them) are lost or destroyed. Turn on Auto-Save in Settings to save every photo you take to your Amazon Photos account.
By using this app, you agree to Amazon’s Conditions of Use (www.amazon.com/conditionsofuse) and Privacy Notice (www.amazon.com/privacy).

bluejetty:00070229:ios.name: Port City: Ship Simulator
bluejetty:00070229:ios.summary: All the ship lovers, ship collectors and ship simulation enthusiasts who love everything ship transport related unite! It’s time to put your ships on waters and build a port city and a global ship empire. Become a ship tycoon and enjoy a be
bluejetty:00070229:ios.description:
All the ship lovers, ship collectors and ship simulation enthusiasts who love everything ship transport related unite! It’s time to put your ships on waters and build a port city and a global ship empire. Become a ship tycoon and enjoy a beautiful ship simulation journey full of surprises, city customizations, achievements and challenging contracts. Express your ship self!
Discover and collect hundreds of famous real life ships. The better the ship, the more cargo it can take, the easier your strategy becomes. It can become quite challenging sometimes, but as a ship tycoon looking to build the biggest ship empire in the world you’ll find a way!
Shipping the required cargo and completing various contracts is the key to develop your port city.
Upgrading ships comes in handy because an upgraded ship fleet is way more powerful when completing contracts and can save a lot of time on waterways! Did you know that there are ship rarity categories in this tycoon city simulation? Rare ships have higher transport capacity! Bending rules of a port city tycoon simulator has never been easier either.
Port City game tycoon features:
▶ Own popular ships from history of maritime transport
▶ Collect famous cargo ships, upgrade them and reach their full transport potential
▶ Meet interesting contractors and complete ship freight transport and logistics jobs
▶ Coordinate and transport your ships according to your own simulation strategy
▶ Enhance your port city and build bigger and better transport facilities and docks to fit more ships 
▶ Explore new global regions as your ships travel the seas through bridges and islands
▶ Play new events every month in the Port City Ship Tycoon
▶ Team up with fellow ship tycoon enthusiasts during events & work together
▶ Compete in leaderboards to become the biggest ship tycoon
▶ Dispatch freight ships to collect resources and transport those to your contractors & city to complete jobs
Are you up for a transport challenge and ready to collect ships, to build and manage a global city and ship empire and become the biggest global ship tycoon in the Port City world?
Have you encountered a ship contract which does not suit your strategy? You can easily swap the ship transport requirements, or cargo requirements to get a better fit for your sea transportation needs. Both kids and adults can do this!
PLEASE NOTE! Port City is an online free strategy tycoon simulation game to download and play that requires a network connection to play. Some in-game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Do you have any suggestions or problems in your port city? Our caring community managers would love to hear from you, visit https://care.pxfd.co/portcity!
Terms of Use: http://pxfd.co/eula 
Privacy Policy: http://pxfd.co/privacy
Do you enjoy our 3D tycoon simulation game? Follow @portcitygame on social media to get the latest news and updates.

bluejetty:00123592:ios.name: Seamless: Local Food Delivery
bluejetty:00123592:ios.summary: When in doubt, go for takeout—Seamless has it all. Plus, fun fact: Seamless is powered by Grubhub! Order food delivery from thousands of restaurants, including local spots and national chains, and get groceries delivered too. Prefer pickup?
bluejetty:00123592:ios.description:
When in doubt, go for takeout—Seamless has it all. Plus, fun fact: Seamless is powered by Grubhub! Order food delivery from thousands of restaurants, including local spots and national chains, and get groceries delivered too. Prefer pickup? No problem. Know the fees upfront and track orders from Seamless delivery partners in real time. The only surprise is just how easy takeout can be. 
ORDER FROM THOUSANDS OF RESTAURANTS
With Seamless, you can order takeout from your favorite local restaurants and everyone’s favorite chains. There are so many good eats out there, but you obviously deserve the best. Seamless makes it easier to choose your next meal with restaurant ratings and reviews. French fries, pizza, burritos, burgers, sushi, donuts—it’s all here, whenever a craving strikes. 
GET GROCERIES DELIVERED TOO
Think beyond your breakfast, lunch, and dinner orders. Seamless offers the ultimate convenience with grocery delivery, in addition to restaurant takeout. Order milk, bread, snacks, and frozen foods, as well as household essentials like paper towels and laundry detergent, from local convenience stores. 
EXPECT TO SEE THE FEES UPFRONT
Seamless gives it to you straight. See the delivery fee upfront, before you start crafting the perfect food order. Pay your way with credit cards, Seamless gift cards, or Venmo.
SKIP DELIVERY FEES
The key is Grubhub+. Sign up for unlimited $0 delivery fees on eligible orders, and enjoy exclusive offers and rewards as a Grubhub+ member.* Try Grubhub+ free for 30 days, then level up for just $9.99/month. The truth is, food tastes even better when you spend less on delivery. See details below.
TRACK DELIVERY IN REAL TIME
Seamless puts your delivery on the map. Track eligible orders in real time, from the restaurant to your front door, and know the moment your bacon-egg-and-cheese arrives. Every delivery is a special delivery with Seamless. 
COUNT ON THE SEAMLESS GUARANTEE
Get your food delivered on time and at the lowest price. Guaranteed, or we’ll make it right. Terms apply. See details: seamless.com/help/contact-us/learn-about-guarantee
YOU DO YOU AND SEAMLESS DELIVERS
Seamless serves up a personalized app experience, so you can reorder that feast you’re still thinking about from two months ago. Order sauce on the side, go for extra pickles, lose the onions—Seamless gets you. Are you a regular? Get rewarded when you come back for more at the same restaurants. You can also plan ahead by pre-ordering food for pickup or delivery. 
ORDER FROM NATIONAL RESTAURANTS
Sometimes you need a sure thing, and that’s why Seamless partners with national restaurants to offer the takeout food you know and love. Get delivery from Applebee’s, Arby’s, Buffalo Wild Wings, Burger King, Chick-fil-A, Chipotle, Denny’s, Dunkin’, Five Guys, IHOP, McDonald’s, KFC, Panda Express, Panera, Papa John’s, Popeyes, Shake Shack, Subway, Taco Bell, Wendy’s, White Castle, and more.
GET SUPPORT WHEN YOU NEED IT
Burning questions? Delivery crisis? Seamless customer support is here for you 24/7. 
*$0 delivery fees only apply to eligible delivery orders from Grubhub+ merchants that meet the subtotal minimum (before tax, tip, and fees) on the applicable menu page or otherwise indicated on the Grubhub platform. Additional fees may apply. 5% pickup credit applicable on eligible future pickup orders only and is calculated based on the qualifying order subtotal. Credit is not transferable, not redeemable for cash, expires 90 days after most recent credit is issued and is subject to restrictions. Grubhub+ is an automatically renewing membership service requiring recurring payments. After your free trial ends, your free trial will convert to a paid Grubhub+ membership and Grubhub will automatically charge you each month at the then-current rate (currently $9.99) plus tax until you cancel. See Grubhub+ cancellation and refund policy and full terms at https://lp.grubhub.com/legal/plus/

bluejetty:00119229:ios.description:
IDnow Online Ident allows you to digitally verify your identity or sign contracts electronically in just a few minutes. All you need is a mobile device, a stable internet connection, and a valid ID document. 
Save yourself the hassle of queuing up to show your ID card at a bank or postal office. IDnow Online Ident offers highly secure and officially accepted ways to digitally prove your identity or sign contracts online. And the best part is: It is completely free of charge and only requires a few minutes of your time.
IDnow VideoIdent: Our default identification method will connect you with one of our ident specialists via video chat. This expert will guide you throughout the entire process. Have your ID document ready and just follow the easy instructions. 
IDnow eID: Where applicable, you may have the option to quickly verify your identity via a German electronic ID card without the need for a video chat. All you need is an NFC-enabled smartphone that serves as a card-reader and securely transmits the encrypted data of your eID. 
IDnow eSign: You will also be able to digitally sign relevant documents at the end of the video identification process. The process can be completed in just a few minutes from the comfort of your home, avoiding any media mismatch or need of additional hardware.
Be assured that your personal data is safe with us as all our identification processes are being audited regularly and comply with the highest security standards.
IDnow Online Ident runs on iPads and iPhones with iOS 9 or higher.
IDnow is a market-leading provider for identity verification and electronic signature solutions. For further information go on our website https://www.idnow.io/ . 
In case you need support with the identity verification itself, directly go to https://help.idnow.io/hc/en-gb .
Please note that IDnow also offers the app IDnow AutoIdent for AI-powered identification. If your token is not accepted on the home screen, you may need to switch to the IDnow AutoIdent app.

bluejetty:00088113:ios.description:
In this immersive simulation game, you’ll wake up early to a new day of responsibilities. Start with a refreshing jog through the park, then dive into cooking delicious breakfasts, helping your kids with their morning routines, and ensuring everyone is prepared for a busy day ahead. Manage household chores like a pro while keeping your home clean, organized, and filled with love!
But that's just the beginning! With mom taking a well-deserved break, it’s up to you to keep everything running smoothly. From driving your kids to school while following traffic rules to tackling unexpected events that keep you on your toes, every moment brings a new adventure. It’s time to show your family that being a dad is the greatest job of all!
Key Features:
Super Dad Gameplay: Take charge of daily family duties, from cooking and cleaning to school prep and beyond.
Fun Family Challenges: Unlock new levels and exciting scenarios that put your multitasking skills to the test.
Interactive Parenting Tasks: From helping your kids get dressed to managing household chores, experience the full range of family life.
Surprise Events: Face unexpected twists and turns that add fun surprises to your daily routine.
Realistic 3D Simulation: Enjoy high-quality graphics and smooth controls for an immersive family experience.
Explore the City: Drive around town, follow traffic rules, and enjoy mini adventures with your family.
Experience the joy, chaos, and rewards of being a dad in this fun and engaging family simulation game. Whether you’re handling chores, preparing for school, or taking your family on a drive, Virtual Dad: Family Adventure is your go-to game for endless family fun!
Download now and step into the role of the ultimate family hero!

bluejetty:00045322:ios.name: Liferoll
bluejetty:00045322:ios.summary:
Create stunning photo scrapbooks, cherish the little moments that make life special, and express everything that makes you *you*.
Our philosophy:
At Liferoll, we believe that happiness is found in the simple moments of life — the laughter
bluejetty:00045322:ios.description:
Create stunning photo scrapbooks, cherish the little moments that make life special, and express everything that makes you *you*.
Our philosophy:
At Liferoll, we believe that happiness is found in the simple moments of life — the laughter with friends, the beauty of a sunset, the joy of a homemade meal you’ve been perfecting for weeks. These moments are the threads that weave the fabric of our lives. We've created Liferoll, not just as an app, but as a canvas for you to fill with your life's stories.
We strongly believe that people are more than just one feed, so by allowing you to create unlimited rolls, we’ve crafted a place where you can capture all the different things that make you, you. We strive to be a place where your real life can be documented, with no pressure to perform or look picture perfect. That way, whenever you stop and look through your Liferoll, you’ll fall in love with your actual life, again and again.
How it works:
In Liferoll, 'rolls' act like minimal scrapbooks, each telling a unique chapter of your life's journey. Customize them with wallpapers and stickers, watch them grow over time, and revisit them whenever you need a dose of nostalgia or inspiration. What’s more, we want to make sure that your rolls stay true to who you really are, so we've put you in full control of the privacy for each one. This way, you can freely express all the different aspects of who you really are. 
How do I get started?
Three simple steps:
1) Start a roll
2) Add to it and build it up over time
3) Share it secretly with your friends in the app, add it to your public page, or simply export your favorites to social media!
Whether it's a summer abroad, your artwork, a new fitness goal, or your favorite outfits — Liferoll is the best way to document your life and build deeper connections with friends.
What can I do?
CREATE ROLLS
Create rolls effortlessly with your photos, videos and links. Invite friends to follow along and create their own.
SHARE WITH FRIENDS
Go ahead — share those bloopers that never made it on your Instagram. It’s all welcome here on Liferoll. Sharing life's simplicity has never been easier.
NEVER MISS A MOMENT
Stay up to date on people who matter most. Add friends, open their rolls and step into their lives. Rolls are so vivid you'll feel like you're living their stories through them!
ONE SECURE SPACE FOR EVERYTHING YOU LOVE
Your privacy is our policy. Liferoll uses encryption throughout, so you decide who sees your photos and videos. Learn more about how we protect your privacy at Liferoll.co.

bluejetty:00128652:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00128652:ios.description:
* FROM THE DEVELOPER
We've tried to blend the fun, varied, and intense adventure experience of a dungeon Roguelike with the rich story of a RPG, just enough to give players a dungeon game that's fun enough to play. We've retained the turn-based gameplay of the varied 4v4 battles of the original game, while enhancing the mix and match for heroes and colossuses outside of combat. The bosses in the dungeons are still tough, but I'm sure you can crush them one by one with your ingenuity. 
* COMBAT & ADVENTURE
- 6 classes with different features, 18 characters and 12 colossuses for you to mix and match. 
- Hundreds of weird and wonderful dungeons waiting for you to explore. 
- Diablo-style equipment affix system. Hundreds of sets of equipment for you to collect. 
- More than 50 dungeon items to help you break through the hurdles. 
* STORY
- With hundreds of random events buried in the dungeons, you'll never be lonely in your journey. 
- 18 main characters, each with their own unique story events. Their origins need to be unraveled by you. 
- The grand main story takes you step by step to uncover the secrets of the ancient colossus. 
* ENDLESS DUNGEON
After completing each dungeon, an entrance to the Endless Dungeon will automatically be created. Once inside, you'll encounter boss battles beyond imagination. Only the most savvy dungeon masters can survive to the end. 
* PVP 
Still worried that the best gears you've looted are nowhere to be displayed? Still worried that the dungeon overlords you've trained have nowhere to show their skills? Then go into the Arena and compete with the strongest in ranked matches. 
* CONTACT US
If you encounter any inconvenience during the game experience, or have any comments, suggestions or feedback, please contact us. We will reply to you as soon as possible. 
Customer Service Email: 54276264@qq.com

bluejetty:00141255:ios.name: Stock the Fridge - Room Legend
bluejetty:00141255:ios.summary: Stock The Fridge-Organize Game is a fridge-organizing and beauty item-sorting game that challenges your creativity and problem-solving skills. Sort shelves, drawers, and compartments as you arrange food, makeup, and beauty items with soothi
bluejetty:00141255:ios.description:
Stock The Fridge-Organize Game is a fridge-organizing and beauty item-sorting game that challenges your creativity and problem-solving skills. Sort shelves, drawers, and compartments as you arrange food, makeup, and beauty items with soothing sounds and a relaxing filling experience.
In the Fridge Organizer, you must fit an array of groceries into a limited fridge space. Each level presents a new puzzle, your goal is to arrange items like fruits, vegetables, drinks, and frozen goods. Make sure everything fits perfectly while maintaining the ideal order for freshness and accessibility.
As you progress, the levels become more complex, with different fridge layouts and varying amounts of items. Shift gears from the kitchen to makeup as you take on the challenge of organizing a wide variety of beauty products. From lipsticks and eyeshadow palettes to skincare bottles and hair accessories, your goal is to organize the makeup kit and drawer. Each level introduces new challenges, such as fitting items into different drawer sizes, arranging by color, or even preparing for a quick-access makeup kit.
Features:
Challenging Levels: Hundreds of levels with increasing difficulty and unique layouts.
Variety of Items: Stock an array of groceries, from fruits and veggies to snacks and beverages.
Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy colorful, high-quality visuals and a user-friendly interface.
Relaxing Gameplay: Ideal for casual gaming, offering a relaxing yet stimulating experience.
Achievements and Rewards: Unlock achievements and earn rewards as you progress.
Hints and Boosters: Use helpful tools to overcome tricky stages.
How to Play:
Drag and Drop: Place items in the fridge strategically to maximize space.
Rotate and Adjust: Fit items perfectly by rotating and adjusting them.
Complete Objectives: Achieve specific goals to advance and earn stars.
Use Boosters: Clear challenging levels with handy boosters.
Whether you’re a fan of organizing puzzles or simply looking for a relaxing yet challenging game, Stock The Fridge-Organize Game has something for everyone.

Digital vouchers
Replace the bulk of paper vouchers with digital ones.
Weather & currency info
Get the latest weather info and local currency rates.
Emergency contacts
Feel safe and secure wherever you are with pre-loaded phone numbers and email addresses for your CEO, the regional G Adventures office, and our global headquarters.
Direct access to your agent
Get in touch with your booking agent directly through the app with a single tap.
Optional activities
Customize your experience by adding optional activities.

bluejetty:00069914:ios.name: Twinkl Rhino Readers - British
bluejetty:00069914:ios.summary: Twinkl Rhino Readers are the phonics-led, interactive books that help children not only learn to read, but love to read! This vibrant series of decodable readers has been created by experienced teachers to build children’s reading confidenc
bluejetty:00069914:ios.description:
Twinkl Rhino Readers are the phonics-led, interactive books that help children not only learn to read, but love to read! This vibrant series of decodable readers has been created by experienced teachers to build children’s reading confidence and fluency.
We’ve got fiction, non-fiction and poetry eBooks covering phonics levels 1-6, along with fun reading games and activities. Learn to read with Twinkl - the world’s largest educational publisher!
As Rhino Readers align perfectly with the DfE-validated Twinkl Phonics scheme, every child can read books that contain letters and sounds they already know. This enables them to get from ABC to reading fluently more quickly and enjoy reading more.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE THE TWINKL RHINO READERS READING APP FOR KIDS:
A constantly-growing library of children’s books covering fiction, non-fiction and poetry, to appeal to every child’s interests.
Fully-decodable reading books aligned with all Twinkl Phonics levels from 1-6, taking children all the way from letter recognition to reading fluently. Ideal for teaching EYFS, KS1 and KS2.
Choose from UK or Australian content libraries, specifically tailored for each market and curriculum.
Access reading hints with pop-up sound cards at any stage in every eBook.
The books are packed with colourful, original illustrations, designed to appeal to kids for added engagement.
Exciting in-app activities such as reading games and puzzles to bring the stories to life, offering a truly interactive reading app for kids.
Add unlimited child profiles per device, ideal for a whole-class solution for teachers, or for parents with children at different literacy levels.
Children can choose from a fun range of avatars to personalise their profiles.
Download eBooks to read offline, perfect for teaching and learning on the go.
Can be used as audiobooks - optional audio so children can choose to listen to the story, read along with the audio, or read it themselves.
Phonics Sounds books available for every level, so children can hear and practise the sounds before reading their chosen book.
Children can pick up where they left off and save their favourite books to read again.
Teachers and parents can hide higher-level books, ensuring children can decode the sounds and words which suit their reading level.
Read in landscape or portrait mode.
Zoom controls enable you to focus on particular words or features.
WHY CHOOSE TWINKL?
We’re the world’s biggest educational publisher, trusted by teachers and parents in over 200 countries.
The Rhino Readers school reading books align perfectly with the Twinkl Phonics scheme, used by hundreds of schools and validated by the Department for Education.
All our books and related activities are created by fully qualified teachers with real classroom experience - they know exactly what’s needed to help children engage with reading and improve their literacy.
We offer 24/7 support, with a real human to speak to at all times.
HOW TO ACCESS THE RHINO READERS APP:
All Twinkl Ultimate members automatically have full access to the Rhino Readers app - simply log in with your Twinkl membership details and you’re ready to go!
If you’re not currently a member, you can download the app and try some of its features for free with Try! Mode, or explore everything the app has to offer with our free trial month. You can also choose to subscribe in-app on a monthly basis for full access without the full commitment!
We'd love to hear what you think of Twinkl Rhino Readers. Your feedback is very important to us! If you have any problems using the app, have any questions, or would like to see new features, please get in touch.
Privacy Policy: https://www.twinkl.com/legal#privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.twinkl.com/legal#terms-and-conditions
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

Easily register visitors by capturing important verification details such as
bluejetty:00014727:ios.description:
Save time and go paperless with the free Sine Pro mobile app. Streamline your visitor and contractor management and provide a seamless experience for your guests.
Easily register visitors by capturing important verification details such as their name, contact information, and reason for visit. Generate QR codes and issues digital visitor passes, ensuring a smooth and efficient check-in process, every time.
For workplace safety, contractors can conduct risk assessments and hazard checks, ensuring that their working environment is free from potential risks. The app also enables users to report incidents, making it easier to maintain a safe and secure workplace for all.
Invite and welcome your visitors
Allow visitors to view their invites and check in and out with just one tap, or scan QR codes to access sites using the app where branded QR posters are displayed.
Receive real-time notifications
Get notified of a guests arrival and approve their arrival straight from the Approvals screen. Visitors can also receive notifications asking them if they would like to check in and out whilst inside the geofence location, as well as receiving alerts during an emergency.
Keep up with guests and staff
Whether you're accounting for people across a conference or during an evacuation, the Sine Pro roll call feature makes it easy for administrators to accurately capture and report on who was accounted for and unaccounted for across one or many sites.
Digitize and automate compliance processes
Automate company inductions and permits to work by allowing contractors to complete workflows and upload documents prior to coming to site. View and approve pending workflow responses straight from the app too.
With its user-friendly interface and intuitive design, the Sine Pro mobile app is a valuable tool that combines convenience, efficiency, and security. Whether it's managing visitors, ensuring workplace safety, organising events, or tracking attendance, the app provides users with the necessary features to enhance their productivity and streamline their check-in experience.

bluejetty:00097871:ios.summary: Get ready for Block Color: Jam Mania, the ultimate puzzle game where you slide colorful blocks to clear the jam and solve exciting challenges! Test your strategic thinking as you move each block into place, overcoming obstacles and clearing
bluejetty:00097871:ios.description:
Get ready for Block Color: Jam Mania, the ultimate puzzle game where you slide colorful blocks to clear the jam and solve exciting challenges! Test your strategic thinking as you move each block into place, overcoming obstacles and clearing pathways. With endless puzzles, bright visuals, and thrilling challenges, this game will keep you engaged for hours!
Slide, Match & Solve!
Each level presents a unique puzzle where you need to slide the blocks, clear the jam, and place each colorful piece in its correct position. The more you play, the tougher the challenges become, pushing your strategic skills to the limit!
Exciting Features:
- Addictive block puzzles – Slide blocks, clear the jam, and solve tricky puzzles.
- Colorful & vibrant visuals – Enjoy a mania of bright colors and exciting gameplay.
- Hundreds of puzzles – Each new puzzle is more fun and challenging than the last.
- Strategic gameplay – Think ahead and slide the blocks carefully to solve the puzzle.
- Jam-packed excitement – A perfect mix of fun, strategy, and brain-teasing puzzles!
- Rewards & achievements – Conquer tough puzzles and earn exciting rewards!
Why You'll Love Block Color: Jam Mania!
- A perfect blend of fun & challenge – Test your strategic thinking while having fun.
- Great for all ages – Whether you're a casual gamer or a puzzle master, it's for everyone!
- Relaxing yet challenging gameplay – A mania of colors and puzzles to enjoy!
How to Play:
- Slide the blocks – Move the colorful pieces into place and clear the jam.
- Solve the puzzle – Plan your moves carefully to complete each block challenge.
- Use strategy – Think ahead and slide wisely to avoid getting stuck.
- Unlock new levels – Keep progressing through tougher puzzles and master every jam.
Are you ready for a colorful puzzle adventure? Download Block Color: Jam Mania now and slide your way to victory!

bluejetty:00136638:ios.description:
Visited Countries turns your iPhone/iPad into a personal travel atlas. Tap any country on the world map to record where you've been, where you've lived, and where you dream of going next.
KEY FEATURES
- Interactive World Map: Pan, zoom, and explore your travels on a beautiful, responsive map. Every country you've visited glows with your chosen color.
- Three Visit Types: Mark countries as Visited, Lived In, or Want to Visit. See your life's journey and your bucket list side by side.
- City & Date Tracking: Go deeper than just countries. Log the cities you explored, the dates you were there, and let the app build your full travel history automatically.
- Import from Photos: Already have years of travel photos? Visited Countries scans your photo library's location metadata to discover countries and cities you've been to - instantly populating your map.
- Travel Stats & Timeline: See your total country count, a timeline of every trip, and browse city photos from your destinations. Perfect for sharing your travel story.
- Word Cloud: A visual snapshot of all the places you've been, rendered as a beautiful word cloud.
- Home Screen Widgets: Glance at your visited, lived, and bucket-list counts without opening the app.
- Custom Map Colors: Personalize the color of each visit type so your map looks exactly the way you want.
- iCloud Sync: Your travel data syncs seamlessly across all your iPhone and iPad devices.
- Offline Ready: Country identification works without an internet connection.
SHARE YOUR TRAVELS
- Screenshot your map or share a summary card with your country count and travel stats. Show the world where you've been.
---
Privacy Policy: https://federicoramos.com.ar/visited-countries/privacy-policy
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00117684:ios.description:
FPS Sniper Shooters, Get ready for modern warfare FPS 3D gun shooting games with a variety of action adventure warzone maps. Commando strike is an fps shooting game commando mission where you have to strike your enemies with your sniper assassin skills as a special gorilla force commando. You can enjoy apex battle fire combat as an offline multiplayer game. Or you can choose story mode by completing fps commando missions as a gun shooter in the gun game. 
Action adventure thriller FPS 3D is presenting covet operation in a commando adventure game. Welcome to FPS 3D gun shooting games against the modern 3d ops battleground. In this commando adventure mission, your aim is to destroy a terrorist training camp that has been used for many terrorist activities in your beloved country. Fps games are usually designed for modern strike warface known as first person shooting games. In this modern combat critical cs strike game you will enjoy kill shots of gun shooter from real sniper assassin.
Crazy Dustown is located in the middle of a desert in your country. Your mission is to get rid of enemy troops that have infiltrated your country. This counter terrorist ww2 combat warfare mission is the last hope for the citizens of your modern warfare arena. Enjoy addictive gameplay with multiple weapons to attack terrorists with maximum force.
Squad Game is designed to act as a world war hero by fighting in special strike modern war zone using full force. A 3D map that needs your 3d sniper shooting skills with the ability to aim headshots from rooftops or stairs. Get advance weapons from airdrop and kill opponents in this secret fps commando mission.
City of Sin is located on top of snowy mountains where crime and sin are routine. In this snow map, you have to liberate innocent people of that town from cruel modern black ops dictator. Your epic bullets force team is here to fight terrorism in a small town located at a great height. Challenge is to survive in those snowy cold mountains with an assault mission. Fight till your last breath and give a chance of liberty to citizens of the prime battle warzone.
Game Features:
- Realistic special force control
- Addictive gun games view & gameplay
- Counter terrorist critical ops combat games story
- HD graphics war games maps
- PvE mode for offline multiplayer experience

bluejetty:00180394:ios.name: Fottur: All Hiking Trails Maps
bluejetty:00180394:ios.summary: Start your outdoor adventure with the Fottur, biking and hiking app and discover new trails and routes. Choose your favorite activity: hiking, biking, backpacking, or trail running; explore nature, and improve your physical and mental well-
bluejetty:00180394:ios.description:
Start your outdoor adventure with the Fottur, biking and hiking app and discover new trails and routes. Choose your favorite activity: hiking, biking, backpacking, or trail running; explore nature, and improve your physical and mental well-being.
You don't need to be a professional hiker, trail runner, or cycler, all you need is your smartphone! 
Open the trail app and plan your route in detail: 
• Choose your activity type: hiking, road or mountain biking, trail running, backpacking, or just walking
• Choose from numerous trail maps: satellite, terrain, USGS topo, or terrain mode
• Find the perfect route for you and start your next adventure
After the app loads the map, you will see your current location. Then, using the different map views you'll be able to intuitively understand the terrain. It's biking and hiking navigation made easy!
Use the bike and hike tracker to see your:
• activity time - you can pause or stop the timer anytime you want
• elevation stats - cumulative elevation gain and loss, as well as an elevation chart
• distance stats - track walking distance or the number of miles you cycled
• average speed and pace
All your hikes are saved to your account, so you can repeat your favorite routes and compare your hiking or biking progress!
SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
You can download the app for free. Further use requires a subscription. At our discretion, we may decide to offer you a free trial per the terms displayed in the app. Please note that:
When opting for a subscription, you pay the fixed price for your country, which is displayed in the app.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account upon confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews and free trial automatically converts into subscription unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
When canceling a subscription or a free trial, your subscription/free trial will stay active until the end of the current period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
Terms of Use: https://legal.fottur.io/page/terms-of-use
Privacy Notice: https://legal.fottur.io/page/privacy-policy
Create the perfect biking, running, and hiking trails with Fottur!

bluejetty:00143063:ios.summary: Welcome to Fire Up Football Manager 2026 — a fast, fun, and addictive football manager game, made for anyone who loves making decisions like a real coach. This modern soccer simulator is built for quick sessions, big choices, and that uniqu
bluejetty:00143063:ios.description:
Welcome to Fire Up Football Manager 2026 — a fast, fun, and addictive football manager game, made for anyone who loves making decisions like a real coach. This modern soccer simulator is built for quick sessions, big choices, and that unique satisfaction of watching your club improve because of you. If you want a coaching game with real choices, real consequences, and steady progress, it’s time to take charge of your team management and turn ambition into trophies in 2026.
YOUR CLUB. YOUR IDENTITY. YOUR FC.
This isn’t just about winning one match — it’s about building a story. Create your club’s identity and develop your FC your way, with tough decisions that define your era of club management. Give your team a personality fans can recognize: brave, disciplined, explosive, or relentless. From your badge to your style of play, you choose the path — and you own the consequences.
WORLD CUP PICK’EM
Show that you know soccer beyond the field. Make your picks for free on World Cup matches, follow the results directly in the game, and cheer for the score. The better your performance, the bigger the reward to strengthen your club.
UPGRADE YOUR INFRASTRUCTURE: STADIUM, FACILITIES, AND ELITE ROUTINES
Great clubs are built behind the scenes. Invest wisely and grow your entire organization. Plan every step to upgrade your stadium and increase your presence and pressure in home matches. Work to improve facilities and raise performance, consistency, and preparation throughout the season. When it’s time to level up, focus on building a training center to sustain results, accelerate development, and turn potential into performance.
SCOUT, NEGOTIATE, AND MASTER THE TRANSFER MARKET
This is where the best separate themselves from the rest. Use scouts to find the perfect fit for your system and your current needs. Decide when and how to sign players, and win the transfer market with smart timing, clear needs, strong value decisions, and squad balance. Build a strong group with depth and real options for different situations — from the opening match to the final stretch.
TRAINING THAT MAKES A REAL DIFFERENCE (AND SHOWS ON THE PITCH)
You’re not just collecting names — you’re developing players. Set routines to train players, strengthen their best qualities, and fix weaknesses. Your squad’s progression happens week after week, with clear development and goals that match your playstyle. Create a sustainable pipeline with a well-run youth setup, preparing talents that fit your ideas and keeping the club growing season after season.
MATCHDAY: LINEUP, TACTICS, AND IN-MATCH COMMANDS
This is where you become a legend. Your decisions hit the pitch. Pick the best lineup based on form, fitness, and the type of opponent. Adjust your formation and strategy as the match demands: press, counter, control, or go all-in. Use in-match commands confidently in every clash — change the tempo, reorganize, protect a lead, or push for a comeback. When the win comes, it feels earned… because it is.
LEAGUE, CHAMPIONSHIPS, AND THE FIGHT FOR THE TOP
Feel the thrill of competing in championship after championship and chasing the top of your league, facing challenges that demand planning, adaptation, and decisive leadership. Every season is a new chance to prove yourself as a manager, build consistency, and turn a rising club into a respected powerhouse.
BECOME THE MANAGER WHO BUILDS A DYNASTY IN 2026
In Fire Up Football Manager 2026, you don’t wait for results — you create them. Take control, make the smartest calls, and feel the adrenaline as your work turns into victories. Start your journey now: build your club, command the touchline, and fire up your season in football 2026.

NOTE: Content only available in the United States and Puerto Rico
Join the movement! The TheaterEars app allows you to watch new release films at the movie theater in Spanish. Simply load the app select your movie, showtime and language to get the movie track on your phone. When you arrive at the movietheater, TheaterEars will sync to the movie through your phone's microphone and then play the full movie soundtrack in your chosen language. For millions, cine en Español, is now within reach without the barriers of language. 
• THOUSANDS OF THEATERS AVAILABLE (United States & Puerto Rico): TheaterEars is available in thousands of movie theaters nationwide. Simply select your date, movie theater, and showtime and you’ll be ready to use TheaterEars.
• ADVANCED RESERVATIONS: Want to make sure that you don’t miss out on your favorite upcoming movie? With TheaterEars you can reserve your movie before it comes out (on selected titles). You’ll automatically be notified when the movie is available for you in our area. 
• AT HOME SHOWTIMES: Selected movies will be available for at home use. 
• ALL FORMATS: Use TheaterEars for all standard movies plus all premium formats such as IMAX, RealD, 3D, XD, Dolby Cinema, and more. 
• EASY TO CHANGE SHOWTIME: Change of plans? No problem. Change your movie showtime directly on the app anytime before showtime. 
• MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT: Need support in English…en Español? No problem. TheaterEars interfaces with its users in both English and Spanish.
• RATE & SHARE YOUR FAVORITE MOVIES: Love a movie? You can show your love by rating it on the TheaterEars app. Then you can share your ratings with friends on social media (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram). 
• MOVIE DESCRIPTIONS: Learn more about upcoming and current movies, access the movie summary, actors, and more on the TheaterEars app.
Hundreds of Thousands have used TheaterEars to watch great movies such as F9, Avengers: Endgame, Joker, Coco, and more. TheaterEars is always adding new movies, so stay tuned for updates.

bluejetty:00040738:ios.description:
The Official Face Search AI – Advanced Facial Recognition and Deep Image Search
Discover Where Any Face Appears Online:
Face Search AI is a powerful deep search and facial recognition app designed to help you explore the internet through photos. Using advanced AI technology, this face find and reverse image search tool scans the web to discover where a photo may appear online. Simply upload a clear image in popular formats such as JPEG, JPG, or PNG, and let Face Search AI perform an intelligent image search across websites to uncover visually similar results. Whether you are trying to find info about someone, reconnect with old contacts, verify identities, or conduct a people search, our AI powered engine works as your digital investigation assistant.
Advanced Facial Recognition Technology:
Built with next generation facial recognition and deep image analysis, Face Search AI compares facial features and patterns to deliver accurate and fast results. The system performs a true reverse face search, going beyond basic image search to execute a broader deep search across publicly available sources. Optimized for sharp and well lit face photos, our technology scans, analyzes, and generates relevant links where similar images may appear. In some cases, users may even discover visually similar faces or subtle resemblance results, adding another layer of insight to the search experience.
Smart Deep Search Engine for Modern Image Discovery:
Face Search AI offers functionality comparable to well known face search and reverse image platforms such as and similar facial recognition tools, while providing its own streamlined experience and unique search advantages. Users searching for tools like facecheck or advanced people search solutions will find Face Search AI delivers fast, intelligent, and accessible results. From deep web image search to reverse face lookup and facial recognition analysis, the platform is built for speed, simplicity, and reliable performance.
Constantly Improving AI Intelligence:
The platform is continuously evolving. With every update, our AI models enhance facial recognition precision, expand image search coverage, and improve deep search intelligence. If exact matches are not immediately found, the system continues refining its algorithms to deliver better and more comprehensive results over time.
Start Your Face Search Today:
Ready to experience the next generation of face search, reverse image search, and deep facial recognition? Upload a photo today and discover where a face appears online in seconds.

bluejetty:00128258:ios.name: FooEvents Check-ins
bluejetty:00128258:ios.summary: The FooEvents Check-ins app connects securely to any WordPress website that uses FooEvents, the #1 ticket plugin for WooCommerce. This app makes it easier than ever to manage access to your events, venues and other services like a pro!
bluejetty:00128258:ios.description:
The FooEvents Check-ins app connects securely to any WordPress website that uses FooEvents, the #1 ticket plugin for WooCommerce. This app makes it easier than ever to manage access to your events, venues and other services like a pro!
Attendee Search
Easily find attendees that are registered for your event and view their information by searching for them by name or ticket ID.
Auto Check-ins
Speed up check-ins using the lightning fast auto check-ins option, which will automatically check-in an attendee and return to the scanning screen once their ticket has been successfully validated.
Barcode and QR Code Support
Scan the 1D barcode or QR code contained on the attendee's ticket directly from your device using the built-in camera or a handheld Bluetooth barcode scanner.
Bluetooth Scanner Integration
Scan tickets using your mobile device's built-in camera or pair your device to any handheld Bluetooth barcode scanner.
Bulk Status Updates
Quickly change the ticket status of multiple attendees by using the bulk update feature. Simply select the tickets and mark them as checked-in, checked-out or canceled.
Calendar and Image List Styles
Set the list style in the app to display events using their featured image or use the new date mode. The date mode will display a customizable color-coded date icon that will help make your events easy to spot even when you're in a rush.
Customizable Branding
Make the Check-ins apps your own by changing the logo and color scheme from the plugin settings to match your website.
Custom Terminology
Customize various terms used within the app including 'Events', 'Attendees' and 'Check-ins' to suit your business needs.
Dark Mode
The Check-ins app supports dark mode so you can save battery life and reduce eye strain and screen glare.
Filters and Sorting
New filter and sorting options are available for both events and attendees which helps to keep things organized and makes information easier to find, even for large events.
Flexible Event Scanning
Scan tickets for a specific event or use the global scan option to scan tickets from any screen.
Multi-language Support
Bonjour Hallo Hola Olá Hallå. Use the Check-ins app in your own language thanks to native support for 17 different languages. Change your language preferences at any time from your device settings.
Offline Mode
Don't stress if the power goes out or the internet connection drops as you can still do check-ins using the built-in offline mode until your connection is reestablished and the data automatically syncs.
Privacy Mode
Hide all personal information for attendees and/or ticket purchasers in the app. Only attendee names will be visible for check-in purposes.
Restricted Event Display
Manage which events are displayed in the app. By default, the Check-ins app displays all published events but you also have the option to display only the events that were created by the signed-in user or you can pre-select which events to display.
View Attendee Information
View information for attendees as well as any custom attendee fields that were captured when the ticket was purchased.

bluejetty:00070301:ios.summary: Educational games for kids kindergarten are the most popular way to study nowadays and our building games will help them in their preschool education. So welcome our new game for toddlers full of cars, puzzles and other racing and building
bluejetty:00070301:ios.description:
Educational games for kids kindergarten are the most popular way to study nowadays and our building games will help them in their preschool education. So welcome our new game for toddlers full of cars, puzzles and other racing and building activities! 
Learn how to build a house - supermarket, manage a vast park of trucks and cars, take part in many mini-games - well, just enjoy this world of childhood :) 
Classic features: 
● Introducing a new location supermarket! Construct it gradually with intelligent building trucks;
● Meet a collection of construction machinery like trucks, tractor simulator, excavator, bulldozer etc.
● Arrange puzzles - enliven the cars!
● Build a car here. All the transport is just like in real life - you can build with them or take part in a hill climb truck racing! 
● Here you can visit a car wash! Clean trucks with water, soap and bubbles and dry it off so your car shines like a diamond! 
● Refueling station is always at your service - fill the cars up before going to a building site;
● Car fixing service is obligatory after any activity, because caring of your cars is important;
Dear parents, we are happy to announce that with this game you can gain at least a half an hour for your own business! 
Let your kids dive into educational and funny game. 
The kids will learn important developing things like motility, memory and imagination, isn’t it fruitful activity? Choosing the appropriate language (there are plenty) you help your baby train speaking and listening skills in his/her own language and learn new words from the foreign ones.
! We cared about security for kids and implemented the parents’ corner inside with accidental entry protection - a math riddle:).
Check the game now!:) 
Contact us at feedback.gokids@gmail.com we will be happy to hear some feedback from you!
Car games are designed specifically for children aged 2 years and older, full of animations child choice app free and colorful graphics, fully voiced characters preschool 2 year old games free and tasks, the interface is simple and clear to the child.
Privacy Policy: https://gokidsmobile.com/policy3.php
Terms of use: http://gokidsmobile.com/terms/

bluejetty:00034752:ios.description:

- Comprehensive Nutrition Hub: Access a curated selection of high-quality nutrition products for endurance athletes, all in one convenient online store.

- Community Focus: Join a community of like-minded endurance enthusiasts and gain insights from expert advice and shared experiences.
- Earn Rewards: Earn Rewards as you shop.
Aid Station was born from a desire to streamline the nutrition process for endurance athletes. Our founder, James McCleery, faced the same challenges you do and created Aid Station to offer a one-stop shop for all your nutritional needs. With our support, you can push your limits and discover what your body is truly capable of. Join the Aid Station family today and elevate your endurance journey. With the right nutrition, you can go further and feel great doing it.
Happy Training,
James McCleery, Founder

Intermittent Fasting Tracker: Your Ultimate Guide to a Healthier You!
Welcome to the Intermittent Fasting Tracker, the essential app to help you achieve your wellness goals with ease. Whether you're a seasoned intermittent faster or just starting your journey, our app is designed to support and guide you every step of the way. Embrace a healthier lifestyle and discover the benefits of intermittent fasting today!
Why Choose Intermittent Fasting Tracker?
- Intuitive and User-Friendly: Our app is designed with simplicity in mind, making it easy for anyone to start and stick to their fasting routine.
- Comprehensive Tracking: Monitor your fasting periods and eating windows with ease.
- Personalized Insights: Gain valuable insights into your progress and make informed decisions to optimize your health.
Key Features
- Fasting Timer: Start and stop your fast with a single tap. 
- Customizable Plans: Choose from various intermittent fasting plans such as 14:10, 16:8, 18:6, and more. Tailor your plan to suit your lifestyle.
- Progress Tracking: Visualize your journey with intuitive graphs that display your fasting history and achievements over time.
- Health Insights: Stay informed with expert articles and tips on intermittent fasting, nutrition, and overall well-being.
Benefits of Intermittent Fasting
- Natural Weight Loss: Burn fat effectively without dieting or intense exercise.
- Enhanced Energy Levels: Feel more active and vibrant throughout the day.
- Improved Mental Clarity: Boost your brain function and stay focused.
- Better Metabolic Health: Improve your body's metabolic markers, including blood pressure, glucose levels, and insulin sensitivity.
Is Intermittent Fasting Safe? Yes! Intermittent fasting is a natural and safe way to improve your health. By giving your body a break from constant digestion, you allow it to switch to fat-burning mode, enhancing your overall well-being. However, if you have any health concerns, please consult your doctor before starting any fasting regimen.

bluejetty:00070840:ios.summary:
EMT Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) exam with a high score on your first attempt.
EMT Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into conc
bluejetty:00070840:ios.description:
EMT Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) exam with a high score on your first attempt.
EMT Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into concepts related to EMT exam preparation, but also helps you increase your confidence in passing the exam on the first attempt by practicing thousands of exam-like questions.
### Passing the exam on the first attempt ###
In EMT Exam Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the range of official EMT exam requirements. In total, there are four certification categories for you to choose from, from easy to hard, according to the increasing difficulty and requirements of the exam, including EMR, EMT, AEMT & Paramedic. each category contains all five officially required exam subjects, each of which can be subdivided into a dozen areas according to the exam requirements. You have the flexibility to choose which subjects you need to practice, depending on your situation.
Specifically, these subjects include:
• Scene Size-Up and Safety
• Primary Assessment
• Secondary Assessment
• Patient Treatment and Transport
• Operations
### Key features ###
- Over 2,000 question exercises, each including detailed answer explanations
- Specialized exercises by content area, with the flexibility to switch at any time
- View an analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the EMT exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that every time you practice on EMT B Exam Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions, while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high not only on the EMT exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://emt.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://emt.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00014143:ios.description:
Easily catalog your book collection. Automatic book details, cover art and estimated values.
Just scan ISBNs (barcode or text) or search our CLZ Core database by author and title.
CLZ Books is a paid subscription app, costing US $1.99 per month or US $19.99 per year.
Use the free 7-day trial to try all of the app's features and online services!
== 2 easy ways to add books: ==
1. Search our CLZ Core by ISBN:
 You can either scan ISBN barcodes or scan the ISBN numbers using OCR
 Guaranteed 98% success rate on ISBN lookups!
2. Search our CLZ Core by author and title
Our CLZ Core online book database automatically provides cover images and full book details, like author, title, publisher, publication date, plot, genres, subjects, estimated pricing, etc..
== Edit all fields ==
Modify all automatically provided details from Core, like Authors, Titles, Publishers, Publications Dates, Plot descriptions, etc.. you can even upload your own cover art (front and back!). Add personal details like condition, location, purchase date / price / store, notes, etc.. 
Create your own Custom Fields so that you can catalog information for which the app does not have a built-in data field.
== Create multiple collections ==
Collections will appear as Excel-like tabs at the bottom of your screen. E.g. for different people, to separate your physical books from your ebooks, to keep track of books you sold or have for sale, etc... 
== Fully customizable ==
Browse your book catalog as a list with small thumbnails or as cards with big images.
Sort any way you want, e.g. by author, title, publication date, date added etc.. Group your books into folders by author, publisher, genre, subject, location, etc...
== CLZ Cloud storage ==
Sync your data to the CLZ Cloud, to:
* Always have an online backup of your book organizer database.
* Sync your book library between multiple devices
* View and share your book collection online
== Got a question or need help? ==
We are always ready to help or to answer your questions, 7 days a week.
Just use "Contact Support" or "CLZ Club forum" from the menu.
== About CLZ ==
CLZ has been developing collection database software since 1996. Located in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, the CLZ team now consists of 12 guys and one gal. We're always working to bring you regular updates for the apps and software, and to keep our Core online databases up-to-date with all weekly releases.
Our other CLZ apps:
* CLZ Movies, for cataloging your DVDs, Blu-rays and 4K UHDs
* CLZ Music, for creating a database of your CDs and vinyl records
* CLZ Comics, for your collection of US comic books.
* CLZ Games, for creating a database of your video game collection
== What our users say ==
"A fantastically nice book library app that I am incredibly happy with, you really get an overview of the things that need to be sorted out, for a good overview, easy to use and everything works seamlessly. Strongly recommend."
Emmanate (Norway)
"The best I have found. I have over 1200 books and have used a number of book cataloging apps over the years. CLZ Books does the job of keeping track of my library and gets syncing right. Most importantly (speaking as a software developer) they keep improving the app. It’s tough to make a business of niche software products. These folks have apparently figured out how to make a go of it and they keep improving. Kudos to them!"
LEK2 (USA)
== About auto-renewable subscriptions ==
* The payment will be charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the purchase.
* The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
* Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.

bluejetty:00129607:ios.description:
The official Flip & Write companion to the board game hit!
Step into the shoes of a royal cartographer and surveyor commissioned by Queen Gimnax. Your mission: explore, stake out, and immortalize the wild northern lands on parchment. In this strategic card game, you decide how to shape your territory—but beware: you are not alone in the wilderness!
An Epic Adventure in the Roll Player Universe
Cartographers brings the fascinating mechanics of the modern board game directly to your smartphone. Experience the tactical Flip & Write principle that has thrilled critics and fans worldwide and was nominated for the prestigious Kennerspiel des Jahres (Connoisseur Game of the Year) in 2020.
Strategy Through Ever-Changing Decrees

bluejetty:00145218:ios.description:
Our CBT-based app is a self-help tool designed to support self-reflection, emotional well-being, and the development of healthier thinking patterns.
Psychological Tests
Currently, diagnostic tests are available for various psychological issues such as depression, eating disorders, neurosis, and ADHD. After completing these tests, you can create your own psychological profile and monitor its progress over time.
Our psychological tests are developed considering modern methods in psychiatry and psychotherapy. After taking the tests for depression and anxiety, you will receive feedback and recommendations from qualified psychotherapists. These tests are your first step towards anti-depression and enhancing your mental health.
Popular CBT Techniques
- CBT Thoughts Diary (cbt journal) — a primary tool of cognitive behavioral therapy. The diary consists of 9 steps, helping you identify and work through your cognitive distortions.
- Daily Diary — record your thoughts freely with analysis and recommendations from AI.
- Coping Cards — note down your destructive beliefs in coping cards format and work through them conveniently.
Studying Psychology
We have developed a series of interactive courses on topics such as depression and mental health. Thanks to our educational materials, you will understand the basic principles of CBT and learn how to work properly with a thoughts diary.
Throughout your journey, your personal AI psychologist will accompany you. It will suggest the best exercises based on your condition and help rephrase negative thoughts.
Mood Tracker
Twice a day, you can assess your mood and note predominant emotions. This way, you can track changes in your well-being and maintain a mood diary.
Depression, neurosis, anxiety, burnout, panic attacks — unfortunately, these issues are familiar to everyone. That is why we started developing our product. Our goal is to create the best self-help app on the market.
We position the app as "your personal psychologist" for self-help. Our AI assistant will support you on the challenging path to psychological health.
In addition, you will find affirmations and reflective questions in the app. You can share your experiences with others.
Our methods are based on proven principles of cognitive behavioral therapy, one of the most effective psychotherapy methods.
With our app, everyone can become their own psychotherapist, gain self-confidence, improve mental and psychological health, and overcome anxiety disorders and depression.
Use of this app is subject to Apple's standard license agreement, available at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/.

An analog-style weather information app that expresses your daily air conditions in a beautiful and intuitive way.
Based on your current location, check outdoor tempe
bluejetty:00174867:ios.description:
Check temperature, humidity, pressure, and discomfort index at a glance.
An analog-style weather information app that expresses your daily air conditions in a beautiful and intuitive way.
Based on your current location, check outdoor temperature, feels-like temperature, humidity, pressure changes, and discomfort index (DI) through a beautifully designed gauge interface.
[FEATURES]
• Beautiful analog gauge design
• Current temperature and feels-like temperature (Celsius / Fahrenheit)
• Humidity meter for monitoring comfort levels
• Mini trend graph for short-term changes
• Barometer support (hPa / inHg / mmHg)
• Sea-level pressure and station pressure display
• 24-hour pressure trend (rising · falling · stable)
• Discomfort Index (DI) calculation
• Widgets support (Lock Screen widgets and Home Screen widgets)
• Apple Watch app and various complications
[DID YOU KNOW?]
• The Discomfort Index (DI), developed by Thom in 1959, is an indicator that quantifies how hot and uncomfortable people feel based on temperature and humidity.
• Pressure values are converted and provided as sea-level pressure based on World Meteorological Organization (WMO) standards. Supported devices can also measure station pressure using the built-in sensor.
• On GPS-enabled iPhone and iPad devices, more accurate information can be provided using the latest observation data around your current location.
• Add cities manually to use the app without GPS.
[PLEASE NOTE]
• This app does not measure room temperature using an indoor sensor.
• It provides outdoor temperature, humidity, and pressure information based on your current location.
[CONTACT & SUPPORT]
If you have any issues or suggestions, please contact us anytime:
https://morethan.net/support/

This amazing puzzle game is a unique brain training game where you use your brain to win this challenging game. While playing the “Disaster Will Strike” game, you will come across multiple challenging game levels and you advance each level one by one to cover your interesting journey on the disaster battle challenge game.
Get yourself a taste of an amazing challenging game of natural disasters. You will absolutely enjoy playing this unique challenge of natural battles with interesting challenging game levels.

We are constantly working hard on making the “Disaster Will Strike” game better and more entertaining for you. We need your constant support to get going. Please feel free to email us for any queries/suggestions/problems or if you just want to say hello. We would love to hear from you. Join thousands of students and memorize words, sentences, expressions and grammar rules in a simple and intuitive way!
Memhack is an app that uses a powerful SRS (spaced repetition system) algorithm to help you fix content: no more forgetting everything within days after you study!
All the flashcards were created by teachers in order to guarantee the best learning experience possible in any language!
It works in a very simple way: during your Fluency Academy classes, you will learn a lot of new words and expressions, and after class you’ll be able to practice them all by using Memhack!
Reinforce the content seen in class through an algorithm that is personalized for you: the app learns with your answers and shows the cards you need to review at the right moment.
Don’t waste hours and hours planning and creating cards or lists from scratch - our team of teachers has already done that for you! This way, you can focus on what really matters: learning.
To make your learning even easier, we created an intuitive and user-friendly interface, all you have to do is open the app and study!
All your progress is synced with the web app, which means you can study on both your computer or smartphone.
So hey, let’s revolutionize your way of learning languages?

bluejetty:00176598:ios.description:
Step into the incredible world of time and space travel with Blue Box Simulator, your very own Time and Space Machine on your phone! Explore the universe and travel to any planet you desire at superluminal speeds.
With easy-to-use controls, simply tap the screen to access the console and begin your adventure.
Experience manual flight like never before! Set the Handbrake mode to FLIGHT, pull it up to prevent unwanted braking, then lower the Space Throttle to around 50%. Set its mode to WARP to exponentially increase its power, allowing you to fly around planets and explore the vast expanse of space.
