bluejetty:00089093:ios.name: MyCatch Fishing App
bluejetty:00089093:ios.summary: Welcome to MyCatch by Angler’s Atlas - a fishing app to record your catches, participate in fishing events or just track your stats. You can explore thousands of fishing destinations through the app, and keep track of every fish caught. For
bluejetty:00089093:ios.description:
Welcome to MyCatch by Angler’s Atlas - a fishing app to record your catches, participate in fishing events or just track your stats. You can explore thousands of fishing destinations through the app, and keep track of every fish caught. For the competitive anglers, our fishing events give you a chance to fish for prizes AND contribute to fisheries science.
MyCatch was first released in 2018 as a way for anglers to track their catches and at the same time help fisheries biologists by providing important catch data. Since the launch, MyCatch anglers have worked with dozens of university researchers across Canada and the United States, helping address important questions and gaps in fisheries science. To see some examples of these projects, please visit our website at www.anglersatlas.com/research.
From a conservation standpoint, MyCatch has developed efficient catch reporting tools so anglers can quickly record their catch and get the fish back into the water in less than a minute. This approach is referred to as Catch-Photo-Release and are hallmarks of the event series available on the app.
“Our promise to anglers is that Secret Spots Stay Secret,” says Sean Simmons, Founder and President of Angler’s Atlas and MyCatch. “Our research partners sign data sharing agreements that protect the privacy and location of our anglers, while providing fisheries biologists with the critical data they need to study our fisheries.”
For anglers, the app also provides useful statistics to keep track of catches, such as the number of fish caught, catch rate, species and specific details around each catch.
My Catch is produced by Angler’s Atlas, an online platform that has catalogued hundreds of thousands of waterbodies, and helps anglers explore lakes, rivers and oceans with detailed maps, tips and local fishing information.
Sign up, report a catch, participate in an event and become a citizen scientist today!

bluejetty:00041767:ios.description:

Go blow for blow against warriors around the world. Rule the ring with your favorite fighters in this hard-hitting version of the classic arcade game.
Take control of iconic fighters and test your mettle in hand-to-hand combat against players from all over the world. "Street Fighter IV: Champion Edition" perfects the original arcade game's winning formula with a host of updates and refinements for mobile devices. Long-time Street Fighter fans will feel right at home, while adjustable difficulty settings and tutorials set newer players on the path to victory.
PICK YOUR FIGHTER
Choose between 32 different Street Fighter characters, including new warriors added to the game since launch: Dudley, Ibuki, Poison, Guy, Gouken, Evil Ryu, Elena, Juri and Rose.
FACE OFF OR FLY SOLO
Battle head-to-head against players all over the globe with an online multiplayer option. Or, if you'd rather enter the ring on your own, choose between Arcade and Survival single-player modes.
FIND YOUR FIGHTING STYLE
Memorize each fighter's move sequences to deploy unique attacks and combos, or use SP Assist to instantly unleash special moves. With four difficulty levels, both veterans and new players can dive into combat.
TAKE IT OUTSIDE
High-resolution graphics, wide-screen support and intuitive virtual pad controls create a great play experience on mobile devices. Connect a controller to take your game to the next level (note that it won't function in menus — only during fights).
- Created by Capcom.

bluejetty:00127492:ios.description:
Build your business empire, trade properties, and compete with players around the world in the ultimate property trading card game.
Play online, offline, or with friends as you buy, trade, negotiate, and collect property sets to outsmart your opponents and dominate the market. Whether you enjoy quick matches, classic strategy, or competitive multiplayer, Business Deal offers multiple ways to play while preserving the familiar rules players know and love.
NEW: BUSINESS GLOBAL
Take your business worldwide and build empires across iconic cities:
New York
Toronto
 Paris
 London
 Dubai
Each city features:
 Unique city-themed properties inspired by real-world locations
 Custom visuals and card designs
 Independent progression and city rankings
 New milestones, rewards, and achievements to unlock
Start your journey as a Hustler and grow your influence as you climb the business ladder. Every city offers a fresh progression path, allowing you to build a powerful empire and earn your place among the world’s top business leaders. The city progression system culminates in becoming an Emperor, with each city offering its own journey and rewards.
WEEKLY CITY MISSIONS
Every week introduces a brand-new city challenge.
Compete in limited-time city events, expand your empire, climb the rankings, and earn exclusive rewards. Weekly cities offer a fast-paced progression experience while allowing players to continue advancing through permanent cities at their own pace
CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS
Compete for the top spot across:
 City Leaderboards
 Weekly Event Leaderboards
 Global Leaderboards
Build your reputation, track your progress, and see how you rank against players worldwide.
MULTIPLE WAYS TO PLAY
Classic Mode
The original Business Deal experience, loved by thousands of players. Trade, negotiate, and collect property sets to win.
Blitz Mode
Fast-paced matches designed for quick decisions and instant action.
Property Poker
A unique twist that combines property strategy with exciting poker-inspired gameplay.
All game modes contribute to your overall business journey and leaderboard presence.
 PLAY YOUR WAY
 Online Multiplayer
 Offline Play
 Play With Friends
 Global Competition
 Weekly Challenges
Whether you’re a casual player looking for fun matches or a competitive strategist aiming for the top of the rankings, there’s always a new opportunity to grow your business empire.
FEATURES
 Multiplayer property trading card game
 Build business empires across global cities
 City-themed properties and custom card designs
 Weekly city missions and special events
 Independent city rankings and global leaderboards
 Multiple game modes including Blitz Mode and Property Poker
 Strategic trading, negotiation, and collection gameplay
 Play online, offline, or with friends
 Unlock achievements, titles, badges, and rewards
 Regular updates and new content
Think strategically. Trade smart. Build your empire.
Download Business Deal today and begin your journey from local deals to global domination.

bluejetty:00144077:ios.description:
La app Mi Telcel es la manera más fácil de realizar recargas, pagos, compra de paquetes y de gestionar los servicios de tu línea sin necesidad de acudir a un Centro de Atención a Clientes. Está disponible para todos nuestros clientes con dispositivo iOS compatible.
Descárgala, úsala y ahorra tiempo.
Una vez que la descargues regístrate para acceder a todas las posibilidades que ofrece. Si aún no estás registrado, puedes utilizar Mi Telcel para realizar recargas y consultar tu saldo y consumo de Internet.
¿Tienes Plan de Renta?
En la pantalla de “Inicio” te presentamos la información más relevante de tu línea; conoce tu saldo y fecha límite de pago.
En la sección “Consumos” consulta tu Estado de Cuenta Interactivo, paga tu factura con tarjeta de crédito o débito y descarga tus estados anteriores.
En la sección “Servicios” puedes dar de alta/baja los Servicios Adicionales de tu línea.
En la sección “Paquetes” puedes comprar paquetes de Internet, paquetes para viajar al extranjero y recargar saldo a amigos y familiares con tarjeta de crédito o débito.
¿Tienes Amigo de Telcel?
En la sección “Inicio” te mostramos la información más relevante de tu línea, puedes contratar Paquetes de Internet y Amigo Sin Límite y, si ya tienes uno, te decimos cuál es y los MB disponibles. Consulta el detalle de tus saldos y realiza recargas con tarjeta de crédito o débito.
En la sección “Servicios” puedes consultar tus suscripciones de Telcel.
En la sección “Paquetes” también puedes recargar saldo, contratar paquetes de Internet.

bluejetty:00133506:ios.description:
Bible - Holy Bible KJV App is a free offline Bible designed to help read and study scripture daily. We decided to make it a KJV Bible as this version is the most accurate compared to the Greek Manuscripts found in the New Testament. The Holy Bible is a habit-forming Christian friendly app that focuses on providing users Daily Bible verse scriptures where they can study and reflect on how it relates to a present situation in their life. The process is simple, inspirational, and easy to follow. This Bible app is easily downloadable and FREE
READ THE BIBLE DAILY 
- Daily Bible verse
- Audio Bible
- Spend 5 minutes with God with our daily devotionals both offered day and night
- Dive deep into scripture and study the Old & New testament Bible verses word by word.
- Receive Daily Bible Devotional Verse of the day reminders from King James Bible 
- Write your thoughts and inspirations on the daily Bible verse of the day and night prayer. Study scripture in depth.
- Jump from Holy Bible verse to verse in the King James Bible (KJV Bible) anytime anywhere by swiping left or right
- Browse your personal Holy Bible journal history and past Bible verses of the day
- Study King James Holy Bible Offline Daily
- Share KJV Bible App verses and scripture with your family, women, and men friends on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram
- Turn on Audio to listen to Prayer Music and receive audio based prayer alarms. Audio Bible reading feature also coming soon.
SAVE BIBLE VERSES THAT STAND OUT TO YOU
- Journal: Write down what's on your mind about the particular verse you are studying that day
- Highlight: Mark popular and your favorite Bible verses and manage them in your Journal
- Notes: Write down your own thoughts for personal keeping or share with friends or family
- Font Adjustment: Over 50 different fonts, colors, and styles with the option of line spacing if desired
- Share verses with friends and family to multiple platforms with ease
- Listen to hymns and popular christian music not limited to hip hop, country, rock, melodies, instrumentals, and more
- Music is catered to play while reading or doing another activity on the app
- Connect with like minded individuals on topics such as marriage, singleness, college, teens, women, struggles, and men
- Share personal stories and find friends in your area
- Get to know users and later connect via different social media platforms
- Start as many books as you want, read from the old and new testament at the same time
- Never miss a day without spending time with God, get reminded twice a day
- Prayer reminder: Take a moment to pray
- Set the time your reminded to spend time with God (Every Day, Every Weekday, Weekends)
- Add friends and see their activity
READ THE MOST ACCURATE TRANSLATION BIBLE KJV
- Read and study scripture through the King James Holy Bible App daily. The KJV is the most closely oriented to the ancient Greek manuscripts and therefore feels more pure to read
- King James Holy Bible (KJV), also known as the KJV Bible App, is the most read English Bible version in the world
- Read the King James Bible Version without access to the internet in English
- We also offer translations in NASB, ESV, & NKJV
KEEP IN TOUCH & LEAVE US FEEDBACK
- Visit our website: https://holybible.unicornplatform.page/
- Follow us on Instagram: @prayerlives
- Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Daily Bible - Is a free English KJV Bible App that includes the 1611 King James Bible including both the New testament and Old testament. Our mission is the preach the Gospel onto every creature while helping Christians stay closer to God’s word which is the Bible. You will be reminded to read the Bible however the difference is you will be motivated through the KJV Bible App through daily devotionals. This Holy Bible is God’s instruction in the palm of your hand, you can learn God’s word anytime and anywhere you want.

bluejetty:00175261:ios.description:
The number 1 recipe organizer and meal planner. ReciMe saves all your favorite recipes in one place, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest. Create grocery lists and meal plans. Calculate calories for every recipe. However you cook, ReciMe helps you do it, better.
FEATURES
- Save Recipes from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest - Download recipes from social media sites. The ingredients and method steps are saved in an easy-to-read format.
- Upload recipes from anywhere - Save your favorite recipes from your existing apps like Notes app, Google Docs, Notion, Evernote, and more! Or add your own recipes.
- Grocery Lists - Create smart grocery lists to shop faster! Sort ingredients by supermarket aisle or by recipe.
- Order Groceries - Turn your grocery list into a delivery! Order directly in-app and get ingredients to your door.
- Meal Plan for the Week - Categorize meals for breakfast, lunch, or dinner with the built-in meal planner.
- Nutrition Information - Calculate calories, protein, carbs, and fats for any recipe with the nutrition calculator.
- Create Cookbooks - Organize your recipes into cookbooks. Customize recipes by meal type (breakfast, lunch, dinner), cuisine, diet, and more!
- Cloud Sync - All recipes are saved on the cloud.
- Access Across Multiple Devices - iOS and iPad.
- Adjust Ingredients - Scale ingredients to your desired serving size.
- Convert Measurements - Change recipe measurements between standard and metric.
- Cook with Ease - Keep your phone screen unlocked while you cook. Follow recipes step-by-step so you can focus in the kitchen.
- Share - Share recipes with your friends and family. Or send via email, SMS, WhatsApp, Messenger, or AirDrop.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
ReciMe includes both a free version and a subscription version with premium features.
The premium version allows you to:
1. Download unlimited recipes from social media, and
2. Upload unlimited images of recipes to our smart importer
3. Calculate nutrition for every recipe
You can start a 7-day free trial to access these premium features. Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial, you will be automatically charged the price indicated on the payment screen for your chosen subscription period. The ReciMe Premium subscription renews automatically at the end of each period (each month or year) until you cancel. Canceling your subscription means the automatic renewal will be disabled. However, you will still have access to all your subscription features for the remaining time of your then-current period. Note that deleting the app does not cancel your subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.recime.app/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.recime.app/privacy-policy
Have an idea to make your cooking experience with ReciMe better? Please reach out to us at https://recime.app/help

bluejetty:00080786:ios.description:
Welcome to Pixel Squad, a vibrant pixelated world made of tiny squares full of magic. It's like a shining star in a huge space. Here, time goes up and down, powerful gods became weaker, but new races were born.
Take on the mantle of the legendary and supreme legends then dive in strategic battles. 
MAGIC AWAITS, WHEREVER YOU ROAM.
Only you can lead heroes to draw forth the sword from the stone and unveil the verities of this world.
DISCOVER A PIXEL WORLD
• Guide the Six Factions to their Destiny
• Immerse yourself in a spellbinding saga, where you chart your own course through the captivating landscapes of Pixel Squad. From the sun-drenched fields of Pixel World to the eerie allure of the Dark Forest, traverse diverse realms and forge bonds with heroes from the Six Factions.
• Assume the main role, guiding these heroes on their destined path to greatness.
MASTER TACTICAL
• Overcome Every Obstacle with Precision
• Navigate battlefields, strategically assembling your hero lineup and arranging their positions. Opt for bold offensives or balanced compositions as you experiment with diverse formations, ushering forth an enthralling gameplay experience.
• Heroes boast three unique skills, with ultimate abilities requiring precise activation. Time your assaults adeptly to disrupt enemy actions and seize control of the fray.
• Adapt your tactics to diverse battle terrains, utilizing obstacles for cover in woodland skirmishes or launching swift assaults in open clearings.
• Employ flamethrowers, landmines, and other tactical implements to outmaneuver your foes. Deploy isolating walls to alter the tide of battle in your favor.
SUMMON AND TEAM UP SUPREME HEROES
• Tailor Your Formations for Triumph
• Join our open beta and uncover 46 heroes spanning all factions. Witness the valor of the Kazetsu, the vitality of the Werewolf, and the resilience of the Wukong. Let muster your legions, while the eternal struggle between Celestials rages on—all within the realms of Pixel Squad.
• Select from archetypal RPG classes to craft diverse lineups suited to any combat scenario.
ACCUMULATED RESOURCES
• Enhance Your Arsenal with a Simple Tap
• Bid farewell to resource grinding with our auto-battle and AFK functionalities. Continue accruing rewards even as you slumber.
• Elevate your team's prowess and seamlessly share equipment across all heroes. Engage with our intuitive crafting system, converting outdated gear into valuable resources without the hassle of grinding. Level up with ease and embrace the adventure that awaits in Pixel Squad!

bluejetty:00155158:ios.name: Momo Confeitaria
bluejetty:00155158:ios.summary: A MOMO CONFEITARIA foi inaugurada em 1989 pelo casal de empresários Marcelo e Eugenia. Eles constataram que precisavam de alguém mais maduro, alguém em quem pudessem confiar e com quem pudessem compartilhar seus sonhos. O engenheiro Breno P
bluejetty:00155158:ios.description:
A MOMO CONFEITARIA foi inaugurada em 1989 pelo casal de empresários Marcelo e Eugenia. Eles constataram que precisavam de alguém mais maduro, alguém em quem pudessem confiar e com quem pudessem compartilhar seus sonhos. O engenheiro Breno Procópio, pai da Eugenia, com determinação, afeto e dedicação acompanhou-os até o fim de sua vida. Estava formado o time que daria os primeiros contornos à MOMO. Marcelo na administração e Eugenia, na culinária. Breno tornou-se o mentor intelectual, o conselheiro, o principal pilar da tríade, cuja função era transformar os sonhos dos dois jovens em realidade. 
Encontraram o imóvel ideal bem no coração da Floresta, na esquina das ruas Itajubá com Pouso Alegre. Eram duas velhas lojas que se transformaram em uma confeitaria e um restaurante self-service, a quilo, uma grande novidade para a época. A esquina era tradicional marca do Carnaval de Belo Horizonte e por isso o nome escolhido foi uma homenagem ao Rei do Carnaval.
O começo foi muito difícil, a rotina do cotidiano começava com o dia ainda escuro e chegava até dez, onze horas da noite. Mas, apesar das dificuldades, a empresa ia crescendo... Assim, em 1992, decidiram abrir ali pertinho da MOMO, na rua Itajubá, a Panificadora Colombina, que trouxe a novidade de padaria com estacionamento, hoje uma das mais diversificadas da cidade e um dos principais negócios do grupo, um verdadeiro sucesso. Nesta ocasião já haviam sido adotados métodos e processos padronizados e implantado um sofisticado sistema de informação.
A constante necessidade dos clientes de encomendar produtos para reuniões e festas levou à implantação do Telemarketing, propiciando muito mais conforto. Desta vez, a novidade não foi o Telemarketing em si, mas a agilidade com que a MOMO consegue preparar seus produtos personalizados em sensacionais embalagens.
A MOMO da Cidade Jardim, foi inaugurada em 1998 e a empresa ganhou visibilidade, passando a ser mais conhecida na Zona Sul de BH. Equipamentos e vitrines italianos foram adquiridos para que os alimentos tivessem muito mais qualidade e fossem melhor apresentados aos clientes.
Se um termo pudesse descrever o fantástico sucesso da MOMO Savassi provavelmente seria “o desafio à descrença”. A região da Savassi estava desacreditada. Suas lojas haviam migrado para os Shoppings. Novamente, Marcelo e Eugenia tiveram intuição, ousadia e muita coragem para enfrentar tudo e todos. Com muito entusiasmo, mantinham acesa a crença de que somente com métodos e processos modernos e tecnologia de ponta seria possível buscar expansão aliada à qualidade. Acreditavam que desta vez a MOMO precisava se impor no mercado. Não queriam mais uma loja, queriam a loja! Queriam tornar obsoleto seu próprio negócio, perseguindo todos os tipos de inovação. Uma loja nada parecida com o que havia em BH, equipada com o que havia de melhor no mundo. Não queriam apenas clientes satisfeitos em lojinhas bonitinhas e apertadinhas bem ao estilo barroco, singelo mesmo, do mineiro. Queriam dar ao mineiro o que ele merecia: um espaço arrojado, de primeiro mundo, em um ambiente sem arrogância. Queriam recompensar seus clientes que sempre foram fiéis e torcedores. Com um esforço hercúleo, arregaçaram as mangas na força-tarefa de forjar uma nova MOMO. Era preciso dividir funções e somar trabalhos para multiplicar resultados. Era necessário desafiar as leis da física e estar em muitos lugares ao mesmo tempo. A equipe MOMO escolheu o local, fechou o negócio, planejou e executou o projeto e inaugurou a loja em apenas seis meses! Todos se espantavam quando passavam por ali, olhavam o novo prédio e lembravam-se de que até outro dia era apenas um terreno. Como foi possível?
A MOMO Buritis, inaugurada em 2005, é considerada um atrativo do Shopping Paragem. Além de almoço e de todos os produtos MOMO, foi adaptada ao público alvo, oferecendo tábuas de petiscos diferenciados, pois se tornou um local de encontro de jovens e universitários do bairro.

Eles constataram que precisavam de alguém mais maduro, alguém em quem pudessem confiar e com quem pudessem compartilhar seus sonhos. O engenheiro Breno Procópio, pai da Eugenia, com determinação, afeto e dedicação acompanhou-os até o fim de sua vida. Estava formado o time que daria os primeiros contornos à MOMO. Marcelo na administração e Eugenia, na culinária. Breno tornou-se o mentor intelectual, o conselheiro, o principal pilar da tríade, cuja função era transformar os sonhos dos dois jovens em realidade. 

Encontraram o imóvel ideal bem no coração da Floresta, na esquina das ruas Itajubá com Pouso Alegre. Eram duas velhas lojas que se transformaram em uma confeitaria e um restaurante self-service, a quilo, uma grande novidade para a época. A esquina era tradicional marca do Carnaval de Belo Horizonte e por isso o nome escolhido foi uma homenagem ao Rei do Carnaval.

O começo foi muito difícil, a rotina do cotidiano começava com o dia ainda escuro e chegava até dez, onze horas da noite. Mas, apesar das dificuldades, a empresa ia crescendo... Assim, em 1992, decidiram abrir ali pertinho da MOMO, na rua Itajubá, a Panificadora Colombina, que trouxe a novidade de padaria com estacionamento, hoje uma das mais diversificadas da cidade e um dos principais negócios do grupo, um verdadeiro sucesso. Nesta ocasião já haviam sido adotados métodos e processos padronizados e implantado um sofisticado sistema de informação.

A constante necessidade dos clientes de encomendar produtos para reuniões e festas levou à implantação do Telemarketing, propiciando muito mais conforto. Desta vez, a novidade não foi o Telemarketing em si, mas a agilidade com que a MOMO consegue preparar seus produtos personalizados em sensacionais embalagens.

A MOMO da Cidade Jardim, foi inaugurada em 1998 e a empresa ganhou visibilidade, passando a ser mais conhecida na Zona Sul de BH. Equipamentos e vitrines italianos foram adquiridos para que os alimentos tivessem muito mais qualidade e fossem melhor apresentados aos clientes.

Se um termo pudesse descrever o fantástico sucesso da MOMO Savassi provavelmente seria “o desafio à descrença”. A região da Savassi estava desacreditada. Suas lojas haviam migrado para os Shoppings. Novamente, Marcelo e Eugenia tiveram intuição, ousadia e muita coragem para enfrentar tudo e todos. Com muito entusiasmo, mantinham acesa a crença de que somente com métodos e processos modernos e tecnologia de ponta seria possível buscar expansão aliada à qualidade. Acreditavam que desta vez a MOMO precisava se impor no mercado. Não queriam mais uma loja, queriam a loja! Queriam tornar obsoleto seu próprio negócio, perseguindo todos os tipos de inovação. Uma loja nada parecida com o que havia em BH, equipada com o que havia de melhor no mundo. Não queriam apenas clientes satisfeitos em lojinhas bonitinhas e apertadinhas bem ao estilo barroco, singelo mesmo, do mineiro. Queriam dar ao mineiro o que ele merecia: um espaço arrojado, de primeiro mundo, em um ambiente sem arrogância. Queriam recompensar seus clientes que sempre foram fiéis e torcedores. Com um esforço hercúleo, arregaçaram as mangas na força-tarefa de forjar uma nova MOMO. Era preciso dividir funções e somar trabalhos para multiplicar resultados. Era necessário desafiar as leis da física e estar em muitos lugares ao mesmo tempo. A equipe MOMO escolheu o local, fechou o negócio, planejou e executou o projeto e inaugurou a loja em apenas seis meses! Todos se espantavam quando passavam por ali, olhavam o novo prédio e lembravam-se de que até outro dia era apenas um terreno. Como foi possível?

A MOMO Buritis, inaugurada em 2005, é considerada um atrativo do Shopping Paragem. Além de almoço e de todos os produtos MOMO, foi adaptada ao público alvo, oferecendo tábuas de petiscos diferenciados, pois se tornou um local de encontro de jovens e universitários do bairro.

bluejetty:00128225:ios.name: Jotform Health - Medical Forms
bluejetty:00128225:ios.summary: Jotform Health is a secure medical form builder that lets healthcare organizations collect patient information, file uploads, e-signatures, fee payments, and more. Build custom medical forms in minutes with HIPAA-enabled features and a Busi
bluejetty:00128225:ios.description:
Jotform Health is a secure medical form builder that lets healthcare organizations collect patient information, file uploads, e-signatures, fee payments, and more. Build custom medical forms in minutes with HIPAA-enabled features and a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) to help keep patient medical data secure. Healthcare organizations, doctors, and specialists no longer need to rely on messy paper forms — with Jotform Health, you can seamlessly collect the information you need from any device, online or offline, and store it in a secure Jotform account.
Create Forms Without Coding
Building a HIPAA-enabled form with Jotform takes just a couple of minutes and requires zero technical skills. You can create your own form or use our professional healthcare form templates.
Use HIPAA-Enabled Features
Jotform Health provides HIPAA-enabled features designed to help protect sensitive patient health information. Form submission data can be encrypted automatically, and eligible customers can receive a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA) to support their healthcare data workflows.
Schedule Appointments
Arrange medical appointments, schedule voice or video calls, receive meeting requests, and more. Patients can easily book appointments by selecting a date and time on your form. With our Google Calendar integration, appointments booked through your form will automatically become events in your calendar.
Obtain Informed Consent
Customize your medical form to describe your patients’ treatment, any possible risks, and their right to refuse treatment. Patients can sign your consent form with an electronic signature. You can even convert each submission into a downloadable, printable PDF!
Accept Medical Bill Payments
Let patients pay appointment fees or medical bills directly through your forms. Connect your medical form to dozens of secure payment processors, including PayPal, Square, Stripe, and Authorize.net. You won’t have to pay any additional transaction fees.
Collect Patient Signatures and Files
Patients can easily sign their forms with electronic signatures and attach important medical documents, images, and other files.
Integrate with 100+ Apps
Connect your forms and surveys to other software to sync submissions automatically and make patient data more organized and accessible for your team.
Enable Mobile Responses
All forms are mobile-responsive and can be filled out on any smartphone, tablet, or computer with ease. Patients can check in for their appointments, register as new patients, or update their medical history directly on your office’s device.
Streamline Your Workflow
Organize your patients’ data. You can export form data as PDFs and automatically email them to your patients — or seamlessly integrate with other software.
KEY FEATURES
Automate Your Workflow
- Create and manage patient registration forms, consent forms, intake forms, self-assessment forms, screening forms, emergency forms, surveys, and more!
- Add conditional logic, calculations, and widgets
- Set up autoresponders to send confirmation emails and reminders
- Get notified of submissions instantly with push notifications
- Collect multiple submissions at once with kiosk mode
- Provide a contactless form-filling experience for your patients with QR codes
Collaborate with Your Team
- Share forms via email, text, and other mobile apps (Facebook, Slack, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, etc.)
- Assign forms to patients or colleagues and view their responses
Advanced Form Fields
- Appointment calendar
- GPS location capture
- QR code and barcode scanner
- Voice recorder
- Signature capture (24/7 mobile signing)
- File upload
- Take photos
Keep Patient Data Safe
- 256-bit SSL encryption
- PCI DSS Level 1 certification
- GDPR features
- HIPAA-enabled features
Privacy Policy: https://www.jotform.com/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://www.jotform.com/terms/

bluejetty:00073542:ios.description:
A brand-new WeatherBug is here!
The weather app you rely on for live local radar, severe storm alerts, lightning alerts and pollen forecasts, now with a new design, an improved experience and even more ways to stay ahead of the weather.
Whether you’re planning your day, tracking a storm, checking your UV exposure, or wondering when the rain will start, WeatherBug gives you the weather information you need when you need it.
Explore new and improved features, including UV, Spark Lightning, Tropical Center, Precipitation Outlook and more, all designed to make understanding what’s happening outside easier and more useful.
Plan ahead with 10-Day Forecasts and over 140 hours of Hourly Forecasts, track changing conditions with interactive weather maps, and get timely severe weather alerts when conditions could impact your day.
WeatherBug brings your forecast, radar, lightning, severe weather, pollen, precipitation and more together in one easy-to-use app.
Because checking the weather shouldn’t just tell you what’s happening. It should help you know what to do next.
Join millions of people who use WeatherBug to stay informed, prepared and ready for whatever the weather brings.
WEATHERBUG FEATURES:
YOUR WEATHER FORECAST
• Real-Time Pinpoint Forecasts: Get the most accurate current, hourly, and 10-day weather forecasts
• Precipitation Outlook: See when rain or snow is likely to start and stop near you
• Enhanced Interactive Map: Visualize weather conditions with over 20 weather maps
• Lifestyle Forecasts: Know how the weather will impact your trips, workouts, allergies, chronic pain and much more
• Weather Widget: Customize your alerts and display them with weather widgets
• Severe Weather Alerts: Get alerted to thunderstorms, tornadoes, flooding and other severe weather near you
• Weather Videos: Get storm updates, weather explainers, seasonal outlooks, and practical safety tips from WeatherBug meteorologists to help you understand what’s happening and what it means for you.
TRACK ANY CONDITION
• Live Weather Radar: available across the U.S.
• Spark Lightning Alerts: track lightning near you with minute-by-minute, mile-by-mile lightning proximity alerts, ideal for outdoor sports, golf, pools and hiking
• Tropical Center: track hurricanes and tropical storms with forecasts and changing conditions
• Fire Center: global fire data to know when you are at risk
• Winter Weather: Stay safe in severe winter conditions with our real-time snowstorm alerts
MORE THAN JUST RAIN
• Pollen Count & Allergy Forecast: Keep your allergies in check by knowing what the local pollen conditions are like
• UV Index: Check local UV levels and know when sun exposure may be strongest
• Air Quality: Get an in-depth look at the air quality around you
• Precise Weather Details: Wind speed, weather observations and more
FASTEST WEATHER ALERTS
• Receive all National Weather Service watches, warnings, and advisories, including tornado and flood warnings.
CONNECT WITH US
• Facebook: @WeatherBug
• Instagram: @weatherbug
• TikTok: @officialweatherbug
• Check out WeatherBug's YouTube weather channel broadcast here: https://www.youtube.com/user/WeatherBugVideo
Download WeatherBug, the free weather app for live radar, severe storm alerts, lightning alerts and pollen forecasts, used and loved by millions. Awarded the "Best Weather App" in 2019 by Mediapost Appy Awards. Also, voted the "Best Weather App for iPads" by AppPicker and "Best App for Moms" by Parent Magazine: WeatherBug!
This app may include "Interest-Based Ads" (see https://www.weatherbug.com/legal/privacy#AC for more information) and may collect or share "Precise Location Data" (see https://www.weatherbug.com/legal/privacy#PLD for more details).

Time and speed play a crucial role. Hippo is a police car driver and can catch criminals in thrilling chases through the city streets.
🚒 The race becomes even more fun when kids interact with objects they encounter along the way. This develops fine motor skills in little ones. There are also many obstacles on the road, but boys and girls can easily overcome them and play independently. And parents can be at ease - the new racing game will bring only positive emotions. Racing games improve reaction time, as to navigate a turn at high speed, one must make a real effort! The ability to act quickly, learned in childhood, will come in handy in the future.
🚓 In the new children's racing game, there are simple levels for little ones and more challenging levels for teenagers and adults. The car will go along a virtual road at high speed because Hippo has very important tasks. Choose who you want to become: a firefighter, a police officer, or a taxi driver. The Liverpool Echo brings you the very latest Liverpool and Merseyside news, as well as breaking news from around the globe, sport, what's on, travel, weather and more. Get your news on the go and don’t miss out on the latest top stories, football updates, celebrity gossip and events happening in your city. Great journalism takes time and resources — your subscription helps us keep doing it.
What’s included? 
Breaking News Alerts:
Be the first to know about important news, updates, and events with our real-time push notifications. From breaking news stories to traffic updates, we'll keep you informed and connected to the pulse of Liverpool.
Personalised Content:
Customise your newsfeed based on your preferences and interests. Stay up-to-date with the topics you care about effortlessly.
Live Sports Coverage:
Never miss a moment of the action with our extensive coverage of Liverpool’s sports scene. Get real-time updates, match highlights, expert analysis, and exclusive interviews from Liverpool FC, Everton FC and other teams. Whether it's football, boxing, rugby league or cricket, we’ve got you covered.
What’s On:
Discover the latest things to do, from music to comedy to nightlife, with our comprehensive What’s On section. Stay informed about upcoming events, concerts, festivals, and exhibitions, ensuring you never miss out on the vibrant cultural scene of Liverpool. 
Interactive Features:
Share articles with friends, leave comments, and participate in polls to voice your opinions. Join the conversation and become a part of the Liverpool Echo community.
Save For Later:
Save articles to read later, even when you're offline, so you can enjoy your news on the go, anytime. 
Echo Essential:
A weekly curation of the best long reads every Monday morning selected by our features editor. 
The Digest:
A specially curated round-up of the most important stories to catch you up on anything you might have missed, twice-daily.

bluejetty:00146936:ios.description:
Are you looking to track your menstrual cycles and symptoms, get pregnant or avoid pregnancy? 
The FEMM app is more than just a period tracker: it provides you with cutting edge science that helps you keep track of your health, understand what is going on with your body, flag potential issues and connect with a network of doctors and nurses to provide you the best health care. We’re a new revolution in women’s health! 
Empower yourself and be an active player in your health care with our easy to use app!
FEATURES
* Easy data input to track your cycle or period.
* Track physical and emotional symptoms to better diagnose potential health problems.
* Daily reminder. Never forget to input your data through our app's notification feature.
* View several Charts on a screen to help you understand your patterns.
* Track medications you are currently taking.
* Email and/or print your charts to share with your doctor, friends or family
* Various view styles let you see and interpret your cycles better: calendar view, chart view and the detailed chart view, which let you see your symptoms.
* Understand your health and the interplay of hormones in your body through our knowledge base.
CONTACT OUR TEAM TO HELP YOU FIND:
* a FEMM-trained doctor or FEMM health center near you
* a FEMM teacher who can teach you how to chart and understand the interplay of hormones in your body

Share photos safely with family and friends. Free and unlimited!

Perfect for family photos or events like weddings!
3 easy steps:
1) Create an album - no registration required

"Your app is so beautiful! Our guests love it! Thank you so much :)" - Lena, 28, wedding in 2019
—
SECURE
None of us want private photos to end up on the Internet. Therefore all Celebrate albums are password protected. They are stored on German servers with the highest data protection standards. Unlike Facebook or WhatsApp, all image rights remain 100% yours.
SIMPLE OPERATION
Forget multiple WhatsApp groups and chats. No complicated registration even for grandparents.
OVERVIEW
Create a separate album for each occasion. In WhatsApp and co the photos will only get lost anyway.
PRACTICAL
Celebrate is the easiest way to get all those great photos in original quality - no matter if your partner, family or friends took them.
CENTRAL
All photos are stored centrally in one place in the cloud. They are always just a click away if you want to wallow in the past. Plus, creating photo books and more is so easy.
INTERACTIVE
Your family and friends will like and comment on each picture! It's like a private Instagram, only better.
FREE OF CHARGE
... for photos! Videos are available as an optional upgrade. But we mainly earn money only when you decide to order photo products through us. But that's not obligatory: You can also download the photos in best quality only.
— 
"We had a photographer, but our guests took additional pictures in completely different moments!" - Lisa, 24, wedding in 2019
"I've really tried a few apps, but yours was the only one that was really simple and well thought out! Thanks :)" - Julia, 33, baby in 2020
— 
You have a question or feedback? We are looking forward to hearing from you! Write to hello@celebrate.app at any time.
Available for all platforms.

bluejetty:00177516:ios.summary:
Every walk tells a story. Map My Tracks helps you understand yours.
Whether you're walking around the neighborhood, exploring new trails, or hiking in the mountains, Map My Tracks gives you insights that actually matter. Discover patterns
bluejetty:00177516:ios.description:
Every walk tells a story. Map My Tracks helps you understand yours.
Whether you're walking around the neighborhood, exploring new trails, or hiking in the mountains, Map My Tracks gives you insights that actually matter. Discover patterns in your walking habits. Celebrate streaks that keep you motivated. Understand what your body is telling you. Join over a million people who've made Map My Tracks their go-to companion for walks and hikes.
=====
Featured in Apple's What's hot list
#1 iPhone app in Health & Fitness in Japan, France, Belgium, Iceland, Czech Republic
=====
YOUR PERSONAL WALKING COACH
After every walk, get feedback that's tailored to you. Learn about your consistency and habit-building. Discover which routes you enjoy most. See how weather affects your walking distance. Get encouragement that keeps you moving.
See patterns like: "You tend to walk further on sunny days" or "Your morning walks are consistently longer than evening ones." Celebrate when you hit a new streak. Track your favorite routes. It's like having a walking companion who knows your history and keeps you motivated.
TRACK YOUR WALKS AND HIKES
Record every walk with GPS precision. Track distance, pace, elevation, steps, calories, and duration. Or just press start and let the app do the work. Review your week at a glance or dive deep into detailed stats when you want them.
Connect your Garmin, Wahoo, Coros, HealthKit, and more, to automatically bring all your walks into one place. All your outdoor activities—all your insights—in a single app.
SHARE YOUR WALKING ADVENTURES
Broadcast live so friends and family can follow along on your hikes. Add photos from your walks and create videos that capture the whole experience. Follow friends and keep each other motivated. Or keep it private—it's your choice.
SET YOUR OWN WALKING GOALS
Whether it's walking 10,000 steps daily, maintaining a walking streak, exploring new routes, or increasing your distance, set goals that matter to you. Track your progress with intelligent insights that help you get there.
DISCOVER NEW ROUTES
Find popular walking routes and hiking trails near you. See where other walkers go. Track your favorite paths and revisit them anytime.
UNLOCK EVERYTHING WITH PLUS
• AI-powered Activity Insights after every walk
• Live tracking so others can follow your progress
• Ad-free experience
• Advanced analysis tools on app and website
• Full access to all features
Subscriptions for Map My Tracks PLUS are $4.99 per month or $49.99 for a full year. Map My Tracks PLUS subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account after your confirmation of purchase. Your monthly subscription will automatically renew each month and be charged through your iTunes account, yearly subscriptions will automatically renew each year. Subscriptions renew at $4.99 per month or $49.99 for a full year automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.
FEEDBACK
If you're enjoying Map My Tracks: Walking Tracker, leave us a good review in the App Store. If not, send your feedback to support@mapmytracks.com and let us fix it before you write a review.
Map My Tracks uses HealthKit to export your walking activities into the Health app and to read heart rate and biometric data. This service is optional. Please note that continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Terms of service: https://www.mapmytracks.com/term-service
Privacy policy: https://www.mapmytracks.com/privacy-policy

• View your statements and notifications

• View, contribute and distribute HSA transactions
• Pay bills from any account and add a payee
• Manage your expenses by entering medical expense information and supporting documentation
• View and Manage your HSA investments
• Retrieve your forgotten username/password
• Report a debit card as lost or stolen
Powered by WEX®

Experience football like never before in Football Rivals!
Join this multiplayer soccer world with millions of real players worldwide. Team up, clash with real people, and prove your skills on the field in epic matches that reward strategy, teamwork, and rivalry!
 Collaborate, strategize, and dominate
Play with real football fans around the globe — every match is against real opponents.

Lead your football team to victory and climb the leaderboards, showing the world your football skills.
Spin football cards and unleash your power

Why Football Rivals: Soccer Clash is different
Real multiplayer matches against real players, not AI
Focused on collaboration, strategy, and team rivalry — not just action
Spin football cards to gain skills and trigger mini-games, adding depth to gameplay
Long-term progression through tournaments, leagues, and team challenges
Football Rivals is free to play, with optional in-game purchases.

LiteTV – Instant Entertainment, Zero Wait
Bored of hour-long videos? Drowning in endless scrolling?
It’s time for something faster, funnier, and smarter.
Welcome to LiteTV — your go-to micro-entertainment hub with premium content under 2 minutes, personalized just for you.
With over 8,000 episodes spanning genres like romance, thriller, comedy, and fantasy, there’s always something to match your mood.
Say goodbye to buffering and boredom.
Say hello to LiteTV.
Hit Stories You Can’t Miss
[30 Days Swapping Lives with a Mafia Boss]
A car crash turns two lives upside down.
A high-society heiress wakes up in the body of a feared mafia boss.
The gangster sent to kidnap her? Now trapped in her body.
They must fake each other's lives in a world of crime, stilettos, secrets—and sparks.
Mistrust, mistaken identity, and a love they never saw coming.
[Love You Beyond Six Months]
Janitor Sarah Milton and billionaire Daniel Rodney marry in a flash—but both want out.
Stuck in a six-month cooling-off period, they fake a life together while hiding their truths.
Then comes Matt, Sarah's first love… and the secret Daniel never saw coming.
Can a contract marriage turn into something real—or will their six months end in goodbye?

ER doctor Charlie joins a warzone medical mission and unexpectedly reunites with Harry - her long-lost lover who's now a military officer.
The shocking truth emerges: he's a prince, and the child she's raised alone is his.
Amid battlefield perils and resurfaced betrayals, can their love survive the ultimate test?
A wartime romance where a doctor and a soldier-prince get a second chance at love.

Designed for your daily fragments of free time
Because life moves fast—and your content should too.

Exclusive Originals, Updated Weekly
New creator-driven shows and dramas drop every week. You'll never run out of fresh twists.

bluejetty:00166100:ios.description:
Welcome to Bird Master：Spin Merge Sort - the ultimate puzzle adventure game that challenges your logic and problem-sorting skills! Enter an immersive world where every move will test your strategic thinking. With hundreds of unique and engaging levels, your task is to sort the items and place them in boxes of corresponding colors. Get ready for endless fun as you twist, spin and solve the most complex puzzles!
HOW TO PLAY:
1. Carefully remove items in the right sequence to ensure each colorful panel drops safely.
2. Sort and fill boxes one by one that match the colors to finish each level.
3. Savor a relaxed gaming experience without time constraints — play at your own leisurely pace.
4. Employ strategic thinking to tackle complex puzzles, which may include a variety of items.
5. Utilize boosters to help you when you encounter particularly challenging hurdles.
FEATURES:
1.Addictive Gameplay: Perfect for unwinding and training your brain. Each level increases in complexity, offering a new challenge to master.
2.Unlimited Levels: With endless puzzles to solve, you'll never run out of levels to conquer. New content is added regularly, ensuring fresh gameplay.
3.Custom Tools: Unlock special tools to help tackle harder puzzles and speed up unscrewing.
4.Multi-layered Challenges: Solve puzzles with multiple screw and pin layers, requiring the right sequence for success.
5.Satisfying ASMR Experience: Enjoy calming sounds and visuals that make gameplay both engaging and relaxing.
6.Daily Challenges and Rewards: Complete special levels for exclusive rewards and bonuses.
7.Powerful Boosters: Utilize helpful boosters when facing tough levels, such as removing obstacles or adding extra moves.
8.Events and Activities: Participate in seasonal events and special activities to win unique rewards and enhance your gameplay.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE BIRD MASTER：SPIN MERGE SORT:
1.Perfect for all ages – whether you're a casual gamer looking for relaxation or a puzzle master seeking a serious challenge, Screw Pin Jam adapts to your play style.
2.Easy to learn, hard to master – intuitive controls and straightforward mechanics make it easy to start playing, while increasingly complex puzzles keep you hooked.
3.Rewarding gameplay – feel a sense of accomplishment as you complete levels, unlock achievements, and see your progress.
Bird Master：Spin Merge Sort is perfect for puzzle enthusiasts looking for a fun way to sharpen their minds and enjoy a stress-free gaming experience. Whether you're a seasoned puzzle master or just starting, this game will captivate you with its innovative mechanics and rewarding progression.
Get ready for a jam-packed puzzle-solving experience in Bird Master：Spin Merge Sort, where each level offers a new twist and a fresh challenge. Whether you love sorting, matching, or untangling screws, this game is tailored for puzzle enthusiasts looking for both relaxation and a mental workout. Download now and start unscrewing your way to puzzle mastery – your ultimate nuts-and-bolts adventure awaits!

bluejetty:00063240:ios.description:
The cult-classic, family card game finally makes it to your mobile! 
DeckHeads is the perfect companion to any party or event bringing a traditional guessing-game up to date for the digital age. We’ve added a modern twist to the hit game, including current cultural references so get ready to act out ‘Falafel’, ‘Millennials’, and ‘Robert Mugabe’.
Accents, singing, miming, even frantic gesticulations are all required to help each player guess the word on the card. Guess as many as you can before the time runs out.
Choose from three main categories crammed with hundreds of cards to play with and unlock specialist subjects - Sport, Music, Entertainment, Christmas, Rude, and many more to keep the party going!
WARNING: Some words in the adult categories may cause extreme blushing!
Features:
Play in a pair or as a big group, one at a time or all at once.
Tilt your phone for the next card.
Tilt down after each correct word, up to pass.
Huge variety of cards including people, places, feelings, objects, etc.
Free Card Decks Include:
Family
Kids
Noughties
Additional Decks:
Around the World
Christmas
Film & TV
Music
Sport
And loads more!

bluejetty:00151408:ios.description:
Local Mom and Dad Friends, Playdates and Family Pods
The original friend-matching app for moms and dads since 2016.
Build your local parent village with 1:1 matching, playdates and Family Pods.
Meet parents who make playdates fun for you too.
MomieGo pioneered Parent Connection Tech in 2016. Because parenting is hard enough. Finding your village should be the easy part.
WHY 1:1 MATTERS
Hot mess days happen. With the right parent friend, you can be real, laugh about it and make parenting more fun.
BUILT FOR PARENTS. BUILT DIFFERENT.
• 1:1 Friend-Matching for Parents™: Connect through shared interests and values, not just zip codes.
• Playdate Now™: Go live so friends nearby can meet up. Discover family-friendly activities, from parks and story time to classes and kid-friendly eats, with real-time chat and SOS alerts.
• Family Pods: Build your circle for childcare swaps, group playdates, homeschool, military PCS support and more.
• The Playdate Planner™: Send options. Pick a time. Make it happen.
• The Pod Planner™: Send options. Pick a time. Make it happen.
• Vibe Streak: Post a fresh Today's Vibe every day, keep your streak going and unlock in-app and partner rewards.
• 6M Notes™: Bite-size parenting insights from founder Jen and her daughter Amelia.
• Local Leaders: One per ZIP code. Host pop-up playdates, represent family-friendly businesses near you and earn commission when you promote them on your Local Leader page.
SAFETY FIRST. ALWAYS.
No searching local parents by ZIP code. No ads. No selling your data. We turned down VC funding to keep family safety ahead of growth-at-all-costs pressure.
6M PARENTING™: THE HEARTBEAT OF MOMIEGO
Created by founder Jennifer Whyte, 6M Parenting™ is built on one simple truth: six moments from childhood stay with us for life.
The people who raise us help shape the voice in our heads. We cannot choose which moments our children carry into adulthood. We can help give them better ones.
Before becoming Amelia’s mom, Jen spent years working with displaced and orphaned children. Many called her Mommy first. Her mission was to help each child experience at least one of their six defining moments.
MomieGo brings that same mission to modern parenthood: reaching children by connecting the parents raising them.
Happy parents raise happy kids who become kinder neighbors, better parents and tomorrow’s leaders.
MEMBERSHIP
• Neighbor: Swipe, see full profiles and match with parents near you for free.
• Villager: Message your matches and unlock Playdate Now™, Family Pods and planning.
• Limited Edition Villager: Get partner perks and members-only contests. Limited to 5,000 spots.
• Employer-Sponsored Access: Check whether your employer offers free membership.
Thanked by former U.S. Surgeon General Dr. Vivek Murthy in 2025.
Featured by BabyCenter and Parents.
EST. 2016 | Born in Venice, California
Pioneering Parent Connection Tech. Helping parents and families find their village in 50 countries.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
Privacy Policy: https://momiegoapp.com/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00180583:ios.summary: NoteLedge is a digital notebook for designers and creatives to quickly capture inspiration and organize everything in one place. Discover ideas from Pinterest, web pages, YouTube, Vimeo, or your surroundings, save clips to your notes and ad
bluejetty:00180583:ios.description:
NoteLedge is a digital notebook for designers and creatives to quickly capture inspiration and organize everything in one place. Discover ideas from Pinterest, web pages, YouTube, Vimeo, or your surroundings, save clips to your notes and add your thoughts. NoteLedge streamlines your creative process, allowing you to connect the dots and get creative in the flexible workspace.
Create mood boards or collages to play around with content and visualize your thoughts. Draw, outline, and make quick design sketches with a variety of brushes for designers. Present work straight from your smart device or share notes in PDF format with audio and video included. Communicate ideas with your team or clients efficiently multimedia aids. NoteLedge is the best note-taking app for creative projects including interior styling, home decor, product design, fashion design, character design, and more!
AWARDS & RECOGNITION
- Featured as “Perfect with Apple Pencil,” “Amazing Apps for iPad Pro,” and “Easy Note-taking” on the App Store
- Designated app for iPad program at Monbulk College, Australia & Special Education School in Tokushima, Japan
KEY FEATURES
CAPTURE IDEAS QUICKLY
- Record audio, add photos, or insert videos 
- Web Clipper – Clip images, texts or screenshots from Pinterest and websites with easy drag and drop (iPad only)
- Clip videos from YouTube & Vimeo, and take notes while you’re streaming videos (iPad only)
- Type anywhere and stay organized with bullet points and checklists
EMPOWER YOUR CREATIVITY
- Draw, outline, sketch, or color with a variety of brushes for designers and creators*
- Create custom brush tips and modify the effects* (iPad only)
- Get colors from a photo and generate stunning color palettes in seconds* (iPad only)
- Customize fonts with your own handwriting*
- Make mood boards, design boards, idea boards
- Create collages by cutting out images and arranging layers
- Get creative with a variety of stickers and covers*
- Select note paper for Cornell notes, planner, lined paper, graphic paper, and more (iPad only)
- Customize note paper with your own photos (iPad only)
- Stylus support: Apple Pencil, Adonit, Wacom Bamboo, and Pogo Connect 2 
SYNC, MANAGE & SHARE
- Export notes to PDFs with audio and video included*
- Auto-sync to multiple cloud storages, including Kdan Cloud, iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, and Goog

bluejetty:00158568:ios.description:
Dear friends,
We've listened to your feedback and are excited to introduce our completely redesigned mobile app!
Enjoy a more intuitive interface, brand-new features, and enhanced functionality. We've simplified the registration process, improved security, and significantly boosted app performance — all to make your banking experience faster and easier.
Our team is constantly working to improve the quality of our service so you can access banking 24/7 with ease and confidence. We’d love to hear your thoughts!
Got an idea or facing a problem? Send your feedback directly through the app or via email at info@anorbank.uz.
What you can do in the app:
Cards & Accounts
• Order a new card with free delivery
• Fast and low-fee transfers by card number or phone number
• Virtual Humo-Mastercard
• Add cards from any Uzbekistani bank
• Request funds from others
• Currency exchange
• Transfer from Tinkoff cards to TRIA Humo
• Multi-currency wallet
• Foreign currency accounts
Deposits
• Open and top up deposits online
• Deposits in UZS and foreign currencies
• Withdraw funds without losing interest
• Early closure options available
Loans
• Apply for microloans
• Order a payment card
• Enable overdraft
• Make loan repayments
• Loan terms: 12 to 36 months. Annual interest rate: 26%–35%
Payments
• Pay for mobile services and more
• Save recurring payments
• Make QR code payments
• Monitor and manage your transactions
Stay connected with us!

Telegram: https://t.me/anorbank
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/anorbank/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/anorbank
Phone: +998 55 503 0000, 1290

bluejetty:00184460:ios.description:
Yachty Deluxe: A traditional yahtzee(tm) like dice game, suitable for all ages. You've tried the rest, now play the best - with your friends.
Video here: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YiGaQQ57wyg 
ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Play and beat anyone in the world using your Game Center account. You can play multiple games at once, but at a pace that suits you.
SOLO MODE
A standard yachty patience game for one player.
TRIPLES MODE
A more in-depth patience game for one player, using three scoring columns.
PASS & PLAY
A two-player game needing no internet connection - just pass the device to your friend when you've taken your turn.
LEADERBOARDS
There are several Game Center leaderboards to register your best scores on. Can you be the best?
ACHIEVEMENTS
With twenty different Game Center achievements to chase down, you will never be short of extra challenge.
REALISTIC DICE
The dice are rendered in full 3D and shaken using an advanced physics simulation. This brings an unprecedented level of realism to iOS dice gaming.
HOW TO PLAY
Rules of the game, for all gameplay variants, are included within the game.
If you're a yahtzee(tm) addict then this is the best game for you.

bluejetty:00041766:ios.summary:
Your plants deserve better than scattered notes and a camera roll full of unlabeled photos.
Cheerful Plants is a personal journal for your plant collection — your photos, your care history, your reminders. Everything about your plants, in
bluejetty:00041766:ios.description:
Your plants deserve better than scattered notes and a camera roll full of unlabeled photos.
Cheerful Plants is a personal journal for your plant collection — your photos, your care history, your reminders. Everything about your plants, in one place, instead of in your head.
WHAT USERS ARE SAYING
"I have been using this app for 3 or 4 years. There are endless options so you can track as much or as little as you want! I track fertilizing, repotting, blooms, diseases, and the progress through photos! My favorite app!"
"I never have to worry about forgetting to water my plants."
"My poor ADHD brain has had a slightly difficult time keeping track of the minutiae for every plant. A few months ago, I dreamed up an app that would help. THIS is the app!"
"This isn't an ID or Diagnostic app! It's a Helper app: To help keep track of your succulents. I've tried a few other apps that try to 'do it all,' but they all fell short for me. I think this one is the best."
YOU DON'T NEED ANOTHER APP TELLING YOU WHAT TO DO
This isn't a plant ID tool or an AI care advisor. You already know your plants. You just need a better place to put everything you're tracking in your head.
Set your own watering reminders. Record care the way you actually do it. Look back when something goes wrong and figure out why.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO STAY ON TOP OF YOUR COLLECTION
- Custom Reminders — Set watering intervals for each plant. Color-coded badges show what's due, what's coming up, and what's fine. Snooze when you're busy. Disable for dormant plants.
- One-Tap Quick Water — Mark plants as watered in a single tap. Undo if you tapped too fast.
- Full Care Tracking — Log watering, fertilizing, pruning, repotting, pest treatments, and custom tasks. See your complete history for every plant.
- Photo Journal — Capture progress over time and build a visual record you'll actually want to look back at.
- Flexible Organization — Group by location, tags, or plant type. Create arrangements so you can care for plants together.
- Family Sharing — Share your collection with a sync key so family or roommates know exactly what to do when you're away.
- Memory Garden — A place for plants that are no longer with you. Keep their history instead of deleting it.
FREE FOR UP TO 5 PLANTS — ALL FEATURES INCLUDED
No locked features. No trial period. Start with 5 plants and see if it works for you. If your collection is bigger than that, upgrade to Premium for unlimited plants at $2.99/month or $29.99/year.
Made by Cassidy Tuttle of Succulents and Sunshine, helping plant lovers since 2013.
Terms of Use: https://cheerfulplants.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://cheerfulplants.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00177525:ios.name: BIAS FX 2 - #1 Guitar Tone App
bluejetty:00177525:ios.summary: BIAS FX 2 Mobile transforms your mobile device into the ultimate all-in-one guitar effects processor, letting you explore hundreds of premium amps, pedals, and studio racks to create your dream guitar tone. Now plug in and PLAY WITHOUT LIMI
bluejetty:00177525:ios.description:
BIAS FX 2 Mobile transforms your mobile device into the ultimate all-in-one guitar effects processor, letting you explore hundreds of premium amps, pedals, and studio racks to create your dream guitar tone. Now plug in and PLAY WITHOUT LIMITS - Anywhere, Anytime.
GUITAR RIG PARADISE
Build to your heart’s content – with a gorgeous user interface, an intuitive drag-and-drop operation, and a massive library of world-class guitar and bass amps, pedals, and effects, you can easily create a rig that’s true to you and your playing style for the ultimate custom guitar tone. Amplify your creativity!
EXCLUSIVE GUITAR MATCH
Looking to transform your guitar into a collection of legendary axes? Thanks to our groundbreaking Guitar Match technology, you can make your guitar sound like a classic American guitar, a vintage LP, and an array of highly-coveted guitar models. Whether you’re recording, performing, or jamming at home, you’ll have a collection of iconic modern and vintage guitars with you at all times – right in your mobile device. 
YOUR TONE STUDIO ON THE GO
Practice, record, and jam with Looper, the perfect companion for nailing down riffs and solos for your song ideas. Don’t miss a note – hit the Record button whenever inspiration strikes! Feeling creative? BIAS FX 2 Mobile supports AudioBus, GarageBand, and other IAA host applications so you can take your tones even further.
PRIMED FOR THE BIG STAGE
Ready to rock the show? Forget packing all your effects and hauling your pedalboard to the gig – carry all your gear in your iPhone/iPad with BIAS FX 2 Mobile so you’ll never miss a beat. Fire up LiveView and switch up your entire rig on the fly instantly using a single tap – with zero latency. 
UNLIMITED TONES TO DOWNLOAD
Connect to ToneCloud®, discover and download over thousands of custom rigs created by artists, producers, and recording engineers. Got tones? Upload your own custom guitar rig and share with fellow musicians from across the world!
Key Features:
- Ultimate Tone Arsenal – build your dream rig with *101 effects, 35 amps, 25 cabs, 4 mics
- Dual Signal Path – create unique dual amp hybrid setups for your ultimate custom tone
- HD Sound Engine – explore hyper-realistic and detailed tones, backed by our award-winning BIAS tone engine
- Factory Presets – dial in your dream guitar tone in an instant with 77 pre-made rigs of all genres
- Guitar Match – turn your guitar into a collection of 20 legendary axes, right in your pocket!
- Looper – practice, record, overdub, and develop song ideas whenever inspiration strikes
- LiveView – single tap to switch up your rig instantly, with zero latency
- Impulse Response – load your favorite custom cab IR files for even more tonal possibilities
- Celestion® Inside – access official-licensed Celestion cabs (IR) right within BIAS FX 2 Mobile (coming soon)
- BIAS Ecosystem – load all your favorite gear from BIAS AMP 2 & BIAS Pedal (coming soon) within the app
- ToneCloud® – easily share & download custom guitar rigs and artist tones online
- IAA (inter-app audio) and AudioBus support
- Full MIDI support
- Tuner and metronome built in
- 9 expansion packs available for exploring all-new sounds (via in-app purchase)
*Unlocked via Standard, Professional or Elite license.
BIAS FX 2 Mobile supports iOS 11 or later.
Supported Audio Interfaces: iRig (all series), Apogee Jam/Jam Plus, Focusrite iTrack Solo, Shure MVi, Korg plugKEY, iConnect AUDIO and all MFi or Class Compliant audio interfaces with Lightning to USB adapter.

bluejetty:00186038:ios.description:
Write Telugu Alphabets – Learn to Write & Speak Telugu (Offline Supported)
Learn to read, write, and pronounce Telugu – the complete offline learning app.
Write Telugu Alphabets is a free app who want to master Telugu script, pronunciation and number systems at their own pace. Whether you're starting fresh or revisiting your roots, this app provides an intuitive way to practice Telugu letters — all offline and at no cost.
No internet required after installation.
What You’ll Learn:
 1. Vowels - Atchulu
 2. Consonants - Hallulu
 3. Composite Letters - Guninthalu
 4. Remember and Match Game – Practice through interactive learning
 5. Spinning Game for Composite Letters
 6. Yes/No Game for Vowels, Consonants
Key Features:
- Trace and practice writing each Telugu letter.
- Audio support for correct pronunciation of all letters.
- Choose your favorite color and from 5 pencil sizes.
- Easy-to-use erase tool for corrections.
- Tap Play to hear the pronunciation of any letter.
- Use Next / Previous buttons for quick navigation.
- Fully usable offline after first install — no data needed.
Who Is It For?
- Learners seeking to read and write Telugu.
- Learners who prefer offline, self-paced education.
Learn Telugu easily — anytime, anywhere. No internet required!

bluejetty:00100411:ios.name: Night Shift: Scary Horror Game
bluejetty:00100411:ios.summary: You are alone on a night shift in a small store. No customers. No noise. Just silence. Then strange things begin to happen. In this scary horror game, every sound and shadow makes you question what is real as the night slowly turns into a n
bluejetty:00100411:ios.description:
You are alone on a night shift in a small store. No customers. No noise. Just silence. Then strange things begin to happen. In this scary horror game, every sound and shadow makes you question what is real as the night slowly turns into a nightmare.
Night Shift: Scary Horror Game is a first person horror experience focused on tension, atmosphere, and survival. There are no cheap jump scares every second. The fear builds slowly as you explore the store, interact with objects, and try to understand what is happening around you.
This is a scary game designed to keep you on edge from start to finish.
A true first person horror experience
Explore the store entirely in first person. Every sound, shadow, and movement matters. You are always in control, which makes every moment feel personal and dangerous. Fans of first person horror games will feel right at home.
One location. Endless fear.
The setting is simple, but the horror is not. A small convenience store becomes a trap as the night goes on. Doors lock. Power fails. Something watches you. The more you explore, the more unsettling the environment becomes.
Inspired by classic horror
The visuals are inspired by classic PSX era graphics, giving the game a raw and unsettling look that modern horror often lacks. Low fidelity visuals leave more to the imagination, making this horror game feel unpredictable and disturbing.
Alien invasion horror
This is not a typical ghost story. Something not from this world is involved. As clues appear and systems fail, you begin to understand that the threat is bigger than the store itself. The alien presence is subtle at first, then impossible to ignore.
Built for fans of scary games
If you enjoy scary games that rely on atmosphere instead of constant action, this game is for you. If you like horror games where tension comes from silence, darkness, and uncertainty, you will feel right at home.
Features
• First person horror gameplay
• Scary and immersive atmosphere
• PSX style graphics
• Story driven exploration
• Alien horror elements
• Simple controls designed for mobile
• Headphones recommended
This horror game is designed to be played alone, in the dark, with the volume turned up. Every step matters. Every sound could be a warning.
If you are looking for scary games that focus on mood, tension, and psychological fear, Night Shift: Scary Horror Game delivers a focused and intense experience from the moment your shift begins.
The doors are locked. The night is long.
Finish your shift if you can.

Solve cute and colorful match 3 puzzles to earn money and design and decorate different hotels. Select furniture, mix and match or color-code the room to create unique, beautiful and totally insta-worthy home design rooms and places!

Meet fun and extraordinary clients and design breathtakingly beautiful places!
Design, renovate, remodel! Choose furniture and decor according to your style and preferences!
Exciting and addictive Match-3 puzzle games! Play puzzles to collect coins and use them to create your perfect design!
Express yourself and nurture your interior design skills! Plus, find inspiration for your own insta-worthy home makeover!
Play for free and offline!
New episodes and match-3 puzzle levels released regularly!

bluejetty:00152203:ios.description:
The officially licensed 3D strategy card game from Toei Animation, Saint Seiya EX - Official, now launches its new version 【The Hades Chapter】! It's time to summon the Gold Saints clad in black Cloths and join this epic battle! The game strives to recreate the audiovisual experience of the original anime, with CG-level 3D animations perfectly bringing to life the classic story of the Hades Chapter, letting you relive the passion and excitement of those days!
【Officially Licensed – 3D Vivid Sanctuary World】
With authorization from Toei Animation, the game recreates the original story, characters, and combat effects using 3D models, bringing an unforgettable visual experience! Over 40 classic characters including the The Five Bronze Saints, Gold Saints, and Athena reunite here. Join them to relive iconic battles such as the Galaxian Wars Tournament, the Twelve Temples, and the Specter Tower, start your journey with memories and new excitement in the Sanctuary!
【Unlock the Eighth Sense – All R-Rank Characters Can Become SSR】
Whether your Saints are Bronze or Silver, they can unlock the true essence of Cosmo and reach the Eighth Sense. All characters can advance to SSR! Want to be invincible in the Sanctuary? Train your favorite Saints and evolve them into your strongest allies!
【Flexible Growth – Resource Transfer System】

bluejetty:00069254:ios.description:
AirDisk is a wireless file transfer and file manager app that helps you move photos, videos, folders, documents, music, and archives between your phone, tablet, and computer.
Use local WiFi transfer to access your phone files from a computer browser. Open AirDisk, connect your computer to the same WiFi network, enter the browser address shown in the app, and start uploading or downloading files. No cable, no iTunes, no desktop software, and no cloud upload required for local WiFi transfer.
AirDisk is useful when you want to:
• Transfer photos from iPhone or iPad to Windows PC
• Move videos from phone to computer
• Send documents from computer to phone
• Transfer files over WiFi using a browser
• Access phone files without installing desktop software
• Organize folders, media, documents, and archives
• Manage files locally on your mobile device
• Use cloud storage when needed
Key features:
Wireless WiFi File Transfer
Transfer files between your phone and computer over the same local WiFi network. Use your computer browser to upload, download, and manage files.
Photo and Video Transfer
Move photos and videos from your phone to your computer without using a cable. This is helpful for backing up camera roll media, moving large videos, or freeing up phone storage.
Browser-Based Transfer
Access your files from a Mac, Windows PC, Chromebook, or other computer with a web browser. No desktop companion app is required for local WiFi transfer.
File Manager
Create folders, rename files, move files, copy files, delete files, organize folders, and manage your local storage from one place.
Document Viewer
Preview common document formats including PDF, Microsoft Office files, Apple iWork files, images, text files, and more.
Archive Tools
Zip, unzip, and manage archive files directly inside the app.
Music and Video Player
Play music and videos stored in AirDisk with built-in media player support.
Cloud Storage Support
Connect to iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, FTP, and WebDAV when you want to access or manage cloud files.
Privacy and Local Transfer
For local WiFi transfer, your files are transferred through your local network instead of requiring cloud upload. Your phone and computer must be connected to the same WiFi network, and AirDisk should stay open while transferring files.
AirDisk is designed for people who want a practical way to transfer files wirelessly, manage documents, move photos and videos, and access phone files from a computer browser.
Discover how AirDisk simplifies file management and boosts productivity.
• Learn more: https://airdisk.app
• Terms of Service: https://airdisk.app/terms-of-service
• Privacy Policy: https://airdisk.app/privacy-policy

listings.name: Яндекс Клавиатура
listings.description:
Онлайн-общение уже давно не ограничивается обменом фразами и смайликами. Эмодзи, гифки и картинки помогают передать друзьям нужную эмоцию или просто поднимают настроение. Яндекс.Клавиатура объединила в себе всё необходимое для современной переписки. И ещё немного.

Что есть в Яндекс.Клавиатуре, чего не хватает обычной:
+ между русской и английской раскладкой можно переключаться свайпом,
+ есть готовые наборы гифок на разные темы и удобный поиск картинок в интернете,
+ пока вы набираете текст, в подсказках появляются подходящие эмодзи,
+ непрерывный ввод: чтобы ввести слово, проведите линию по его буквам, не отрывая пальца от экрана
+ встроенный переводчик помогает общаться, если собеседник не понимает по-русски,
+ если нужно что-нибудь быстро нарисовать, то можно что-нибудь быстро нарисовать!

bluejetty:00184241:ios.name: Card Controls by Elements
bluejetty:00184241:ios.summary:
Card Control by Elements – Full control over your debit card usage in a way you’ve never had before
• Manage how, when and where your cards are used—on your own terms. Card Control by Elements enables you to set controls regarding the trans
bluejetty:00184241:ios.description:
Card Control by Elements – Full control over your debit card usage in a way you’ve never had before
• Manage how, when and where your cards are used—on your own terms. Card Control by Elements enables you to set controls regarding the transaction types, geographic rules, and the merchant types where your card can be used.
• Turn any card on, or off—in seconds. It’s as simple as a toggle. Perfect for safety, security and those scary moments when you’re not quite sure where your card might be.
• Ensure you are the only person using your cards. GPS capabilities can either limit where your card is used—or assure it’s only able to be used when with you.
• Turn your cards into active budget participants. Set dollar limits for transactions, and receive alerts when those limits are being reached. No more worrying about going over budget!
• Receive alerts when suspicious activity is suspected.
• Stop fraudulent activity before it even happens with the alert feature of Card Control by Elements. Based on your preferences, Card Control by Elements can send you a real-time alert when your card is used outside of your chosen preferences, giving you the power to deny the transaction or turn your card off. 
• Alert preferences can be set by:
 - Location – based on where the transaction occurs 
 - Transaction type – based on type of transaction at point of sale
 - Merchant type – based on the type of merchant where the transaction occurred
 - Threshold – based on the threshold amount set by the user
