bluejetty:00062853:ios.name: Word Jewels®
bluejetty:00062853:ios.summary:
"Terribly addicting! ••••• I have refused for years to ever get into a single game app, and it was always easy until I found Word Jewels. So fun, so quick, I can't say enough about how much I enjoy the game!" --Jordan SC
Word Jewels is
bluejetty:00062853:ios.description:
"Terribly addicting! ••••• I have refused for years to ever get into a single game app, and it was always easy until I found Word Jewels. So fun, so quick, I can't say enough about how much I enjoy the game!" --Jordan SC
Word Jewels is SUPER FUN and 100% FREE!
••••• "This is such an addicting game. I absolutely love it!!!!!!"  --hb9202010
••••• "Love this game on my phone for all those 'waiting' times in life." --NannerBanner 
••••• "I absolutely love Word Jewels. I hope to keep playing this game for a long time. It is never boring. Thanks for making it free!" --2011bulldog
••••• "I like word games with friends, but get tired of the timed ones. It's really relaxing to take your time and strategize without racing the timer. And with a choice of five games I can play different ones and switch back and forth" --Jllew333
EASY TO LEARN AND PLAY!
• One-minute tutorial that teaches you how to play!
• Make words in any direction with just a swipe!
• Your goal is to make words that use up all the red jewels, but you only get a few "moves" each level to make words… You can do it!
SIX GAME MODES TO SUIT YOUR MOOD!
• Start with fan-favorite Word Jewels word-finding without the frustrations in Endless Mode!
• If you're daring, you can try Classic Mode where if you fail a level you have to start over!
• Want a super-hard challenge that's not for the faint of heart? Try Challenge Mode!
• Got ten minutes? Try Rally Mode to play ten levels of patterned jewels that are just like the multiplayer game Word Rally, but solo!
• Or try Blitz Mode! In just one level, how high can you score? Use the multiplier jewels and see how high you can get! Bet you can't just play it once…
• And NEW is Wordzing adventure mode, with lots of new challenging goals to pass each level. Collect certain color letter jewels! Connect a path of words across the board! Collect stamps under key letters on the board! Your word-finding adventure awaits!
RELAX WHILE YOU SHARPEN YOUR MIND!
• No timers, so take your time and find the best words
• Beautiful graphics and animation
• Relaxing sound effects
• Listen to your music while playing
GO FOR A HIGH SCORE!
• Score summary shows you how well you did
• Compare your scores with the world using Game Center
WORD LOVE!
• Huge English dictionary included to verify words even while not connected to the internet!
(Word Jewels uses the YAWL word list, which has 264,097 words! Valid words must be 3 letters long and NOT be proper nouns, as is typical for most every word game.)
• Automagic letter balancing, to help from getting trapped with a big ol' pile of consonants with no vowels, or with too many duplicates of the same letter in a group!
• Magic auto-save - go ahead and quit the game, take a phone call, send a text - when you come back, your game will be waiting for you! Works on both old and new iThings!
• 54 Game Center Achievements to earn!
Thanks for playing Word Jewels!
Come see us at http://boyhowdytechnology.com
WORD JEWELS is a registered trademark of Boy Howdy Technology LLC.

Please check this out, also for the people who have not tried
bluejetty:00016891:ios.description:
‘Onion Cam2’ is a simple and useful app, which can take a time-lapse photography and create a movie by one-stop.
You can make interesting and great movies using your creativity!
Please check this out, also for the people who have not tried creating a time-lapse photography! 
'Onion Cam2' is the successor to 'Onion Cam'. The main difference is that 'Onion Cam2' now stores captured images in the app. Also, I was able to export it sideways.
Other than basic camera functions, the functions below are implemented.
・Onion-skin function
You can take a picture with checking the translucently displayed picture you took last time.
By this function, you can take gradually changing time-lapse photography easily.
You can adjust transparency and choose display and non-display mode by one tapping.
・Guideline display
You can set displaying guidelines.
You can choose display and non-display mode by one tapping.
・Changing order function
You can change the order of the pictures.
・Exporting movie function
You can export movies by this app.
You can set the time of switching pictures and the size of exporting file.
・Saving several projects
You can save several(32 projects for this version) projects.

iOS 17.6 or later

bluejetty:00120080:ios.summary:
Eclipse Guide is a comprehensive and easy-to-use app for observing solar and lunar eclipses. It provides all information you need to experience and understand any eclipse of the past and the future.
***From the developers of famous astrono
bluejetty:00120080:ios.description:
Eclipse Guide is a comprehensive and easy-to-use app for observing solar and lunar eclipses. It provides all information you need to experience and understand any eclipse of the past and the future.
***From the developers of famous astronomical app Star Walk, winner of the Apple Design Award 2010, loved by more than 20 million users around the world***
Main features:
● Eclipse calendar with the list of solar and lunar eclipses of the past and the future.
● Observing eclipses from the user's location, from any other place, or from the best location for observation.
● Eclipse simulation with the play button to get a visual representation of the celestial event from its beginning to the end.
● World map showing the eclipse path accompanied by the info about the sun coverage and the moon altitude.
● The map illustrating the gradation of eclipse visibility.
● The list of best places for eclipse observations.
● Eclipse phases, timelines, and other core information.
● Notifications about solar and lunar eclipses.
● Share the information about eclipses with friends.
The app is not limited to upcoming eclipses only - you can choose any eclipse you want to learn about and view it at home or worldwide.
Advanced features:*
● Audio guide with voice notifications won’t let you miss the desired solar or lunar eclipse. It will accompany your eclipse observation process providing comments on all the stages of the phenomenon.
● Fullscreen informative maps show the visibility of an eclipse and its path. Use them to pick a good location for your eclipse observation. Zoom in and out, check the eclipse visibility for any location.
● Star spotter simulates the sky at your observing location. Find out whether the eclipse will be visible from the selected location. Quickly identify and view solar and lunar eclipses in the sky.
The Star Spotter feature won't work for the devices that are not equipped with digital compass.
*Advanced features should be purchased separately (via In-App Purchase).
Remember: Looking directly at the Sun can cause serious eye damage or blindness. Never look at a solar eclipse without proper eye protection.
Questions or suggestions for improvements: support@vitotechnology.com
We are looking forward to your feedback.
Get ready for the next eclipse with Eclipse Guide!

bluejetty:00041058:ios.summary: Get ready for adventure with 'ARK Unity'! Your all-in-one helper for ARK! Whether you're a rookie explorer or a seasoned survivor, this comprehensive guide app is your key to mastering the intricate realms of the updated ARK: Survival Ascen
bluejetty:00041058:ios.description:
Get ready for adventure with 'ARK Unity'! Your all-in-one helper for ARK! Whether you're a rookie explorer or a seasoned survivor, this comprehensive guide app is your key to mastering the intricate realms of the updated ARK: Survival Ascended (ASA) or ARK: Survival Evolved (ASE). No more tab-switching between sites, our all-in-one tool is your companion in this wild, untamed world.
FEATURES: 
TAMING CALCULATOR:
Don't just survive—thrive! Calculate the resources needed to tame any creature, with detailed stats on food, narcotics, and time required.
BREEDING CALCULATOR:
Propagate the strongest species with our breeding calculator. Know the gestation periods, mating cooldowns, and essential stats to help your newborn creatures inherit the best traits.
XP CALCULATOR:
Plan your pathway to dominance. Input your tasks to find out how much XP you'll gain, helping you level up efficiently.
CREATURE INFOS:
From the majestic Argentavis to the cunning Raptor, get detailed information on every creature you encounter or wish to tame, including stats, behaviors, and unique abilities.
SPAWN MAPS:
Never get lost again! Our detailed spawn maps show you the locations of every creature in ASA, ensuring you're always prepared for what's around the corner.
RESOURCE MAPS:
Locate critical resources with ease using our comprehensive maps. Whether you need metal, obsidian, or rare flowers, we've got you covered.
BASE SPOT MAPS:
Find the perfect spot for your new home! From hidden caves to defendable cliff-top fortresses, scout the best locations before you commit to building.
OFFICIAL ASA TRIBE MAP:
Track the growth and territories of various tribes in the official ASA world, helping you find allies or avoid formidable foes.
COMMANDS:
Your shortcut to efficiency—get a comprehensive list of ASA console commands to enhance your gameplay.
ASA NEWS:
Stay updated with the latest ASA news! From updates to events, we'll make sure you're informed.
FULL DINO AND ITEM LISTS:
A survivor's encyclopedia—browse through complete lists of dinos and items available in ASA.
RESOURCE/CRAFTING CALCULATOR:
Prepare for your adventures! Calculate the materials needed for crafting and find out where to gather them.
DIFFERENT TOOLS:
Harness the power of advanced technology with tools like the Tek Generator and Tek Forcefield. Optimize your crafting skills with our calculators.
At "ARK Unity," we're survivors ourselves, dedicated to enhancing your ARK: Survival Ascended experience. This app is actively developed, with more features on the way! Join our community and ascend the food chain in ARK: Survival Ascended! 
[Note: "ARK Unity: ARK Survival Ascended" is a fan-made app and not officially associated with the game ARK: Survival Evolved, its developers, or publishers.]

bluejetty:00122928:ios.description:
Experience Digital Banking with Meezan 
Meezan Bank is one of the best digital banks in Pakistan offering Islamic Banking. Meezan Bank just wants to make your lives easier by taking care of all your financial needs. Meezan has launched a digital banking app for all its customers. Now perform your mobile banking transactions from the tip of your fingers! 
Key Features of Meezan Mobile Banking App 
1. Biometric Login: Easy access to your account with biometric login. No need to remember your username and password anymore. Plus, biometric login makes your account details more secure and prevents unauthorized login. 2. Account Statement & Transactions: Stay up to date with your account transactions with the option to download your statements according to your requirements. 3. Send Money: Send money to any bank in Pakistan in just a few taps 4. Pay Bills: No need to stand in long queues anymore. Just login on your App and pay all your utility bills in just a few taps. 5. Pay Fees: Pay all your fees including your children’s school or university fee directly from Meezan’s Mobile App 6. Donations: Pay your Zakat and Sadqat to registered organizations 7. Manage debit cards: Block / Unblock your debit cards according to your preference with just a tap 8. Meezan Tap n Go: Enable Meezan Tap & Go digital cards to make card payments directly from your Mobile App. Just enable Meezan Tap n Go from the debit card menu. 9. QR Payments: Make Visa QR payments directly from the Meezan Mobile App by scanning Visa based QRs 10. Find nearby Meezan Bank Branches / ATMs: Open the Meezan Mobile App to locate nearby Meezan locations.11. Discounts & Promotions: Meezan Bank offers various discount offers and promotional deals for Meezan Bank customers. All such offers can be viewed from the App 12. Qibla Locator: Never stress about locating Qibla anymore with Meezan App’s integrated Qibla locator. 
Payment Features of Meezan Digital Banking App: 
- Utility bill payments - Mobile top-ups and bill payments - Credit card payments - Internet bills - Education fees and payments - Government payments - Other miscellaneous payments 
How To Sign Up on Meezan Mobile App 
You can sign up on Meezan mobile banking app following five easy steps: 
Step 1: Download the Meezan Mobile App. 
Step 2: Open the App and tap on register. 
Step 3: Enter the required information. 
Step 4: Set up username and password and enter verification code sent on your registered mobile number. 
Step 5: Accept terms and conditions. 
Welcome to Meezan Mobile Banking App

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MeezanBank

bluejetty:00174194:ios.description:
Turn screenshots, photos, and screen recordings into polished device mockups.
OneMockup combines device mockups, 3D motion, video presentation, and long-image tools in one creative workspace. Import your media to make work for sharing, presentations, and product launches.
# 2D and 3D Mockups #
Customize device models, viewing angles, 3D rotation, scale, position, backgrounds, canvas, shadows, image fill, rotation, and corner radius. Export transparent PNGs, process multiple images, save templates, and share quickly.
# Supported Devices #
Create mockups for iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone Air, iPhone 17, iPhone 16, iPhone 15, iPhone 14, iPhone 13, iPhone 12, iPhone 11, iPhone X, iPhone XR, iPhone XS, iPhone 8, iPhone 7, iPhone 6s, and iPhone SE.
Also supported: iPad, iPad mini, Apple Watch, MacBook, iMac, and Studio Display. Available 2D, 3D, video, angles, and colors vary by device.
# 3D Motion and Video Mockups #
Place a screen recording inside a 2D or 3D device model. Use keyframes, poses, camera movement, backgrounds, canvas settings, and motion templates to create dynamic presentations. Export a video or export the current frame as a PNG image.
# iPhone Duo Dual-Screen Foldable Mockups #
Edit the outer and inner screens separately. Create closed, half-open, and unfolded states with continuous hinge motion. Choose independent or inner-screen-following content, perspective, blur, lighting, device colors, and landscape or portrait presentation.
# Long Images and Scrolling Screenshots #
Automatically detect order and overlap to stitch multiple screenshots into one long image. Import a screen recording to generate a scrolling screenshot, fine-tune seams, and save the result.
# Templates and Automation #
Use frame, poster, device, mockup, and motion templates, or save your own. OneMockup also supports widgets, Shortcuts, Action extensions, URL schemes, Dark Mode, and optional iCloud data sync.
OneMockup offers auto-renewable subscriptions.
- Available plans, durations, and localized prices are shown on the purchase screen. Prices may vary by country or region.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.
- The subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your Apple Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

bluejetty:00044776:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00044776:ios.description:
What is CirrusMD?
With CirrusMD, you can chat with a doctor just like you would a friend. CirrusMD is chat-based virtual care that allows you and your dependents to securely message, send photos, or video chat with a doctor from your smartphone or computer.
It’s a convenient alternative to traditional doctor visits. No more waiting for an appointment, taking time off work, or paying the high cost of in-person doctor visits. With CirrusMD, you can connect with board-certified physicians who deliver comprehensive, whole-person virtual primary care that fits your schedule, budget and preferences.
How does CirrusMD work?
The CirrusMD experience is similar to texting. After registering, you can begin securely chatting with a licensed doctor, just like you'd text a friend. Start and stop your conversations as needed and use the platform as often as you'd like.
- Connect to a CirrusMD doctor, 24/7/365, from anywhere in the U.S.
- When it’s necessary, doctors can switch to video or ask you to share photos in the app
- Doctors can refill many prescriptions (controlled substances and certain other drugs may not be available)
- In-app translation for patients with Spanish as their primary language
- Complete in-app chat history for follow-up as needed
When should I use CirrusMD? 
Use CirrusMD when you feel sick but it’s not an emergency, for things like cough, fever, sore throat, earache, stomach pain, diarrhea, rashes, allergic reactions, sports injuries, burns, heat-related illness, even issues specifically related to men’s or women’s health. 
You can reach out to a CirrusMD physician when you:
- Have general medical questions 
- Are feeling anxious or depressed
- Have questions or concerns about a chronic condition
- Want information about health screenings, tests or test results
- Want to refill a prescription (controlled substances and certain other drugs may not be available)
- Aren’t sure where to go for care and need help
How can I get CirrusMD?
CirrusMD is a service provided as a benefit through your employer, health insurance, or another sponsoring organization. Visit mycirrusmd.com to learn more.

bluejetty:00098971:ios.summary: TORQ Sports is the ultimate FREE platform for student-athletes looking to take their game to the next level. Whether you’re aiming for college recruitment or want to showcase your athletic achievements, our app provides everything you need
bluejetty:00098971:ios.description:
TORQ Sports is the ultimate FREE platform for student-athletes looking to take their game to the next level. Whether you’re aiming for college recruitment or want to showcase your athletic achievements, our app provides everything you need to stand out and succeed.
• Showcase Your Talent: Create a comprehensive athletic profile highlighting what makes you unique. Upload highlights and trim them before sharing. Connect with the sports community and build your brand.
• Connect with Colleges: Our College Connect feature puts you in direct contact with college programs across the country. Search and filter schools by division, location, sport, academic requirements, and more.
• Build Your Profile: Go beyond stats. Showcase your athletic achievements, positions, academic credentials (GPA, SAT/ACT scores), physical attributes, current school and graduation year, travel team and club affiliations. 
• Test Prep Included: Boost your academic game with built-in SAT and ACT practice materials. Access comprehensive prep questions for Math, Reading, Writing, and Science in English to ensure classroom success is as important as on-field performance.
• For the Entire Sports Community: TORQ Sports isn’t just for athletes. Coaches can scout talent, share training content, and build their program’s reputation. Parents can follow their athlete’s journey and connect with other sports families. Athletic directors and program directors can manage rosters and showcase their organizations.
• Social Features That Matter: Follow favorite athletes and teams, like and comment on highlight videos, share achievements with your network, get real-time notifications when coaches view your profile, and build your personal brand in the sports community.
• Roster Management: Teams and programs can create and manage digital rosters, making it easy to showcase entire squads to recruiters and organize team information in one place.
• Privacy & Security: Your data is protected with secure authentication and privacy controls. Choose what information to make public and control who can contact you. Verified badges help identify legitimate coaches and programs.
• Why Choose TORQ Sports:
 • Free to create your profile
 • Direct connection to college programs
 • Comprehensive athlete development tools
 • Active community of athletes, coaches, and fans
 • Regular updates with new features
 • Built by athletes, for athletes
Join thousands of student-athletes already using TORQ Sports to chase their dreams. Whether you’re starting your athletic journey or in the peak of your recruiting process, our platform gives you the tools to succeed both on and off the field. Download TORQ Sports today and start building your future in sports!

bluejetty:00119337:ios.description:
Buy & sell used machinery easily with the app of the leading marketplace for used machinery – Machineseeker.com.
Machining centers, forklifts, sliding table saws, tractors, presses, containers, excavators, and much more: Discover more than 200,000 immediately available machines and vehicles from over 2,000 categories in the free Machineseeker.com app and find exactly the machine you are looking for! The most popular categories of our users include:
• Metal processing machines
• Woodworking machines
• Construction machinery
• Agricultural machinery
• Industrial automation technology
• Food processing technology
YOUR ADVANTAGES AS A BUYER OF MACHINES
The Machineseeker.com app contains all the important functions so that interested parties can find used machinery quickly & easily:
• The largest selection: All listings of the leading marketplace for used machinery in one app: machines, accessories, spare parts or even entire production lines.
• Search specifically & find accurately: Filter by manufacturer, model, price, year of manufacture, operating hours and much more.
• Free of charge & without registration: Get started right away and make purchase inquiries.
• Local or international: Filter for regional offers or negotiate with international sellers around the globe.
• Fast & convenient: Save searches with just one click.
• Personal watch list: Bookmark interesting listings for later.
• Different sales formats: Whether classified ad, auction or buy-it-now - at Machineseeker you will find what you are looking for.
• Don't miss a thing: Receive new, personalized offers via push notification.
YOUR ADVANTAGES AS A SELLER OF MACHINES
Do you deal in used machinery? The Machineseeker.com app also offers real added value for sellers to maximize buyer contacts and sales:
• International reach: get access to over 11 million prospective buyers from over 50 countries every month.
• Easy to advertise: Create comprehensive listings directly from your phone or tablet in just a few steps. 
• Image upload made easy: Select machine images directly from your device's photo gallery.
• Manage anytime and anywhere: Edit, pause or activate your ads.
• Immediately informed: Receive push notifications for customer inquiries.
• Increase security: Protect your account with two-factor authentication.
Machineseeker.com brings together over 8,100 sellers and more than 11 million prospective buyers every month. Install the app now and benefit from our international reach. Available in more than 10 languages!

bluejetty:00014035:ios.description:
Duo Mobile works with Duo Security's two-factor authentication service to make logins more secure. The application generates passcodes for login and can receive push notifications for easy, one-tap authentication on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch.

Captain your fishing trawler to explore a collection of remote isles, and their surrounding depths, to see what lies below. Sell your catch to the locals and complete quests to learn more about each area’s troubled past. Someone wants you to dig up the past, but can you trust them and will it ever be enough?

- Unravel a Mystery: Captain your fishing trawler across a collection of remote islands, each with its own inhabitants to meet, wildlife to discover, and stories to unearth.

- Study Your Craft: Research special equipment and upgrade your boat’s capabilities to gain access to rare fish and valuable deep-sea curios.
- Fish to Survive: Sell your discoveries to the locals to learn more about each area, and upgrade your boat to reach even more secluded locations.
- Fight the Unfathomable: Strengthen your mind and use your abilities to survive trips out on the water after dark.

bluejetty:00015494:ios.name: MTestM
bluejetty:00015494:ios.developer: ShenZhen SamApp Technology Development Co., Ltd
bluejetty:00015494:ios.summary:
MTestM is an exam creator application that allows you to create, publish and share exams. Creating an exam has never been easier. You can add different types of questions on an Excel spreadsheet. 
MTestM is used by educators, trainers, non-
bluejetty:00015494:ios.description:
MTestM is an exam creator application that allows you to create, publish and share exams. Creating an exam has never been easier. You can add different types of questions on an Excel spreadsheet. 
MTestM is used by educators, trainers, non-profits, businesses and other professionals who need an easy way to quickly make exams, tests, and quizzes online. You can create and publish your first exam in a few minutes!
1.Create exams easily
Excel is a great program for creating questions. Exams can be created offline using Excel. By taking a tour, it’s easy to understand the MTestM format and add your own questions in the spreadsheet.
MTestM allows you to use Excel to write multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blank and matching questions in a simple format that can be imported. When creating a large numbers of questions, MTestM can provide a quick way of bulk importing questions.
2.Advanced question types
MTestM allows you to create single choice, multiple choice, fill in the blank and matching questions. MTestM supports case sensitive answers and questions having more than one correct correct answer.
You can also create questions that are based on the same material or based on the same stem. You can also specify HTML, MathML, image, audio and video for the question.
3.Publish exams
After you have created an exam, you can publish it. You can mark your exams as private if you do not want others to see your exams, otherwise your exam can be seen by others.
In order to create high quality exams, we recommend you to update your exams regularly. MTestM allows you to update your published exams. If an exam is not the current version, it will be kept for 30 days on the server.
4.Share exams
Anyone can share public exams with others. Only you can share your own private exams with others. Others cannot share your private exams.
If you are a teacher, sharing exams is an alternative way to assign homework to your students. If you are a student, share your study quiz with your classmates and test each other as much as possible in order to discover even more details and areas you may have overlooked.
5.Organize exams into folders
Organizing exams is very important. You can organize exams into folders and subfolders.
Exams are saved locally on your phone, so you can search exams quickly using keywords. You can also find the exams and questions you recently took.
6.Take exams offline
MTestM allows you to take your exam anytime, anywhere at your convenience. You do not need to be connected to the internet while you are taking the exam.
After the exam is scored, you can review the grade report and see which questions you got wrong.
You can re-test yourself on the questions you’ve missed and you can re-test yourself on your favorite questions.

bluejetty:00127579:ios.name: Parcel - Delivery Tracking
bluejetty:00127579:ios.summary:
If you are looking for an app to track deliveries on iPhone, iPad, Mac or Apple Watch - Parcel is the best choice for you. 
With this application you can promptly access tracking information for 300 delivery services, including UPS, USPS,
bluejetty:00127579:ios.description:
If you are looking for an app to track deliveries on iPhone, iPad, Mac or Apple Watch - Parcel is the best choice for you. 
With this application you can promptly access tracking information for 300 delivery services, including UPS, USPS, FedEx, DHL, GLS, LaserShip, Aramex, OnTrac, China Post, Amazon Logistics and many other carriers. Full list of supported carriers is available at: https://parcel.app
With our unique carrier recognition function, adding a new delivery is just a matter of seconds. Sometimes you won't even need to enter a tracking number, you can use a barcode scanner which is available right in the app. 
Amazon integration in Parcel allows you to get your packages added automatically from your Amazon account. Once an order is shipped, it will appear in Parcel. This is done in a secure and privacy-friendly way with your credentials never leaving the device.
You can also locate your delivery on the map or manage your deliveries using Web Access (web.parcelapp.net) - easy and simple. Parcel has a native macOS app available for free in the Mac App Store.
Parcel utilizes the power of iOS to provide you the best possible user experience. You can use its widgets to see your upcoming deliveries and the share extension to add a new delivery directly from any other app.
Push notifications provided by Parcel are more convenient than from any other app. They are being sent only from 8am to 10 pm according to your timezone, so you will not be bothered at night (however, you can disable this option in the settings).
Some features, such as push notifications and tracking more than 3 deliveries are limited to premium subscribers. Current price for the premium subscription is $6.99 per year, and may vary from country to country. Parcel's privacy policy, as well as subscription terms are available at https://parcel.app/privacy-with-terms.html.

bluejetty:00100686:ios.description:
Wazaif application is a collection of Islamic Arabic wazaif. These wazaif are generally prescribed by sufi masters in various sufi traditions to attain spiritual connection with Allah SWT. 
App is designed with sub-continent Arabic script. The translation is available in Urdu.
One can count the number of time each wazifa is being read. There is an individual counter available for TASBEEH. A special counter available in Surah Yasin for counts at MUBEEN.
App will keep the record of each count for each wazifa read for future reference.

bluejetty:00074209:ios.description:
Capture the feeling with Birdy (formerly Pink Papaya), an ad-free photo and video journal for your private, personal thoughts. Save a memorable moment and caption without broadcasting it to the world. Journaling has numerous clinically-backed benefits, and it has been shown to improve both mental health and physical health. Join founder Sarah Nicole Landry of The Birds Papaya in creating your own daily habit to reflect, practice gratitude, and foster personal growth.
• Guided Prompts: Receive prompts, select photos and videos, and flow
• Choose Topics: Begin a journal for gratitude, reflections, goals, venting, or multiple topics
• Thought Starters: Jog your memory and help you start writing
• Daily Affirmations: Gently encourage you toward self-love and self-acceptance
• Scroll What Matters: A better-for-you alternative to social media, no ads or unhealthy comparison
• Complete Editing Suite: Add filters, overlays, customizable presets, text and more. No AI or body and face altering tools
The app has dozens of features FREE to use with no watermark! For even more features, sign up for Birdy+, which includes unlimited access to create multiple journals and unlock every editing feature.
____________________________
MEMBERSHIP PRICING, TERMS, & CONDITIONS
Birdy+ Yearly
The Birdy+ Yearly membership is 29.99 USD per year. Pricing in other countries may vary, and charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country you live in. The Birdy+ Yearly membership starts with a free 3-day trial period. Once the trial is over, you'll be charged $29.99 USD per year. Your Birdy+ Yearly membership will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your membership and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription during free trial.
Birdy+ Monthly
The Birdy+ Monthly membership is $4.99 USD per month. Pricing in other countries may vary, and charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country you live in. The Birdy+ Monthly membership automatically starts upon subscription and you'll be charged $4.99 USD per month. Your Birdy+ Monthly membership will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your membership and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.

bluejetty:00013696:ios.description:
Ookbee แอปปลิเคชันอ่านอีบุ๊ค
8 ความเท่มีสไตล์ เมื่อดาวน์โหลดแอป Oobee ไว้ในเครื่อง
1. CEO หล่อมาก ไม่เชื่อเสิร์ช หมูอุ๊คบี แล้วจะรู้ว่า “อุ๊คบี” เป็นแอปที่ดีต่อใจจริงๆ #CEOหล่อบอกต่อด้วย
2. โชว์สกิลกันหน่อย อีบุ๊ค ผวนเป็นคำว่าอะไร อีบุ๊ค = อุ๊คบี ไง ทีนี้จะเท่มากเวลาโชว์สกิลถามเพื่อนว่า อุ๊คบี ผวนมาจากอะไร ซึ่งผวนมาจากอีบุ๊ค ไงเล่า เพื่อนอึ้งไปเลย
3. ปฏิเสธไม่ได้จริงๆ ว่าการถือแท็ปเล็ทที่มีอีบุ๊คขึ้นมาอ่าน มันเท่ถึงเท่มากๆ ถ้าเป็นผู้หญิงก็ดูสวยฉลาดสุดๆ เหมือนหยิบสมาร์ทโฟนมาอ่านอีบุ๊คกับหยิบมือถือขึ้นมาเล่น Social ความหล่อความสวยมันต่างกัน ถืออุ๊คบีก็เท่เช่นนี้นี่เอง 
4. อุ๊คบี มีอีบุ๊คไทยให้เลือกอ่านเยอะที่สุดในประเทศ มีทุกประเภทหลากหลายให้เลือกอ่าน
5. มีหนังสือที่หาอ่านได้ตามแผงตามร้านหนังสือทั้งหมด แต่เป็นฉบับดิจิตอล มีทั้งอีบุ๊ค, อีแมกกาซีน, หนังสือพิมพ์ฉบับดิจิตอล, หนังสือเสียงและยังมีคลาสสอนออนไลน์อย่าง Skilllane ด้วย
6. มีทั้งซื้อขาดเป็นเล่ม สมัครสมาชิกรายปี หรือเหมาจ่ายรายเดือนรายปี อ่านฟรีทั้งแอพ Buffet กันไปเลย
7. อ่านฟรีได้ง่ายมากๆ แค่ Sign In ผ่าน Facebook ได้อ่าน Buffet ฟรีทันที 7 วัน โดยไม่มีค่าใช้จ่ายแอบแฝงใดๆ ทั้งสิ้น
8. Daily Prophet คือคำนิยามของ อีบุ๊คได้เลย ถ้าอยากอ่านหนังสือแล้วมีวีดีโอสัมสัมภาษณ์เบื้องหลังลับๆ ซ่อนไว้ในหลายๆ หน้า เพลินมาก หาจากนิตยสารเล่มกระดาษที่ไหนไม่ได้น้า
คุณสามารถส่งข้อแนะนำหรือแจ้งปัญหาต่างๆถึงเราได้ที่ member@ookbee.com หรือที่ fb.com/ookbee ขอบคุณที่ใช้ Ookbee ค่ะ! 
อย่าลืมติดตามเราได้ที่ LINE Official Account; OOKBEE เรามีหนังสือฟรีและโปรชั่นดีๆแจกฟรีทุกวันค่ะ 
Ookbee App is the latest bookstore app with wide selection of digital books and magazines across Asia from the creator of largest digital bookstores in Thailand.
There are both free and paid (with big discount from print edition) publications.
Features:
-Search/Browse/Download digital publications including:
---- 300+ digital magazines from the leading names such as MAXIM HELLO! Men's Health etc.
---- 1000+ e-books from renowned authors in the region.
---- 10+ leading daily newspapers.
-Read-on-the-fly, no need to wait for the publication to finish downloading.
-Read offline once publication is completely downloaded. No Internet connection needed.
OOKBEE introduce all popular Thai magazine with auto renewable subscription, offering subscription start from 7 days, 1 month, 6 month and 1 Year. Price range start from only $0.99 to $499.99. This subscription will automatically charge service fee to customer credit card that registered with their Apple ID when reaching next subscription period cycle.
- Prior to the cancellation of this feature, user have to disable auto renewable function at least 24 hours before the period expire.
Please like "facebook.com/ookbee" to receive latest news from our services.

"Brain Out" has brought a new era of puzzle-type hands and has gained a lot of popularity among players. "Brain Out 2" brings you more brand-new experience of mind-bending challenges, filled with unexpected puzzles that only the smartest players can conquer! This free offline puzzle game is designed for those who love pushing their brain's limits and testing their cognitive abilities. With a variety of creative puzzles and unconventional solutions. Get ready for a series of mind-twisting puzzles that will put your brain power to the test and push you to set new records!
This game is packed with innovation and subversive ideas. Unlike typical puzzle games, Brain Out 2 uses tricky and often humorous ways to test players. Each level feels like a unique brain teaser that challenges your reverse thinking and observation skills, putting you in seemingly impossible situations and compelling you to look at problems from different angles.
Key Features:
- Unexpected solutions with endless creativity
Brain Out 2 brings innovative ways to solve puzzles, challenging your thinking ability and making every puzzle feel fresh and intriguing!
- Train your logical thinking and boost your brain's IQ
Through thought-provoking puzzles, the game en-hances your problem-solving skills and helps you reach a higher level of cognitive prowess.
- Expand your thinking capacity with out-of-the-box ideas
Uncover unconventional solutions and tackle every challenge with creativity and innovation.
- Endlessly fun puzzles that are hard to put down
With unique gameplay that's both addictive and rewarding, every puzzle offers a mix of humor and challenge that's sure to captivate you.
- Cute doodle art style with engaging visuals
Every level is designed with charming, humorous visuals that are easy on the eyes and add to the game's light-hearted atmosphere.
- Interesting background music that complements the gameplay
Fun soundtracks make the game even more enjoyable, creating an immersive experience.
- Offline game – play anytime, anywhere
Enjoy this addictive puzzle game on the go without worrying about connectivity!
Whether you're an enthusiast who loves training your brain, improving memory, the moran test, and enhancing your IQ, or a creative thinker who likes breaking the mold with reverse thinking, Brain Out 2 is a must-play puzzle game for you! Come and unleash your imagination, think beyond the box, and become the master who can see through the puzzles' true nature. Only those with extraordinary logical skills, sharp memory, and boundless creativity will be able to conquer all levels and complete this ultimate brainpower challenge!

bluejetty:00161249:ios.name: Dentist Games for Kids: Doctor
bluejetty:00161249:ios.summary: Welcome to Timpy Dentist Doctor Games for Kids, fun dental clinic adventure for kids! Let your child explore the exciting world of dentistry with our interactive and educational dentist games. In this game, your child will become a dentist
bluejetty:00161249:ios.description:
Welcome to Timpy Dentist Doctor Games for Kids, fun dental clinic adventure for kids! Let your child explore the exciting world of dentistry with our interactive and educational dentist games. In this game, your child will become a dentist doctor, learning how to clean teeth, treat cavities, and take care of toothaches. It's a fun way to learn about dental care!
In Timpy Dentist Games, children will play as a dentist doctor in a real dental clinic. Whether its cleaning teeth, fixing cavities, or applying braces, your child will experience all parts of dental care. They can explore different dental procedures, experiencing the thrill of solving dental puzzles while learning the significance of each step in dental care. Through these engaging activities, children learn the importance of brushing, flossing, and maintaining good oral health habits. Embark on a dental adventure which is perfect for kids and toddlers 2-5 Year olds. 
Key Features:
Become a Dentist Doctor: Your child will become a dentist, attending dental appointments and treating different patients. They will love being a teeth doctor and learn how to take care of teeth.
Educational Gameplay: Learn why dental hygiene is important, how to brush teeth properly, This game for kids makes learning about tooth care fun and easy with interactive and educational gameplay
Treat Cavities and Toothaches: Learn how to use real dental tools to clean teeth, fix cavities, and relieve toothaches. Kids will understand how to deal with dental problems.
Interactive Dental Clinic: Experience a real dental clinic with colorful tools and playful gameplay.
Fun Mini-Games: Enjoy mini-games that teach proper tooth care and hygiene in a fun way. Kill germs and bacteria that cause cavities and toothaches. These games show how to take care of teeth and the role of a dental hygienist.
Braces Games: Learn how braces can help make teeth straight and smiles perfect. Kids will learn how to apply braces with easy dental tools
Our Timpy Dentist Games for Kids are designed to make learning about dental care enjoyable. Kids can role-play as a dentist doctor, handling different dental issues and understanding dental hygiene.
Features:
Interactive dental care games for kids and toddlers
Learn about oral hygiene and dental procedures
Enjoyable gameplay teaching dental care practices
It is an educational yet entertaining experience
Timpy Dentist Games for Kids is not just about entertainment; it's a platform that educates and nurtures good oral care habits. Through interactive play, children learn the significance of dental hygiene, setting the stage for a lifetime of healthy smiles. They also learn about common dental problems like cavities and toothaches, and how to prevent and treat them.
Download Timpy Dentist Games today and start a tooth care adventure! Let's make dental hygiene fun and exciting for kids. With its engaging gameplay and educational content. Join us in making dental care fun and educational for children!
Subscription Details:
-Payment will be charged to the Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
-Cancel subscription renewal anytime under Subscriptions in your App Store Settings.
-Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
-No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: https://www.timpygames.com/privacypolicy.php 
Terms of Service: https://www.idzdigital.com/terms_of_service.php

bluejetty:00171482:ios.name: Abyss - Dungeon Action RPG
bluejetty:00171482:ios.summary: Abyss is an action-packed free-to-play fantasy adventure roleplaying game (ARPG) enriched with roguelike elements. Embark on a journey into an endless dungeon, seeking potent equipment while confronting formidable creatures fueled by the ca
bluejetty:00171482:ios.description:
Abyss is an action-packed free-to-play fantasy adventure roleplaying game (ARPG) enriched with roguelike elements. Embark on a journey into an endless dungeon, seeking potent equipment while confronting formidable creatures fueled by the captivating essence of biopunk enchantments. Are you prepared to endure an expedition into the heart of the Abyss?
What's New?
Unlock the path forward in Chapter 8 of the Abyss. Only Adventurer's who have honed their skills and refined their weaponry stand a chance at surviving. But great treasures await those who can brave new frontiers!
Delve into an action roleplaying experience and build up a powerful adventuer by refining your equipment and learning new skills. Team up with other players in Emergency Raids to take down powerful bosses and sythesizee their monster parts.
Abyss – an infinite Dungeon Crawler Adventure
The Abyss an action roleplaying game in an infinite dungeon of monsters and magic. Each floor brings new surprises and new challenges in the form of monsters, traps, and strange biotechnology. Bring loot back from your expeditions, as the valuable resources inside are the only thing that will allow you to delve deeper.
Fight mystical beasts and uncover an expansive dungeon filled with powerful cores of ancient technology. Advance your character's abilities with roleplaying game mechanics to improve your fighting abilities and the quality of your equipment. Each delve brings with it danger, but also the chance of great rewards.
Action Roleplaying Game with Dark and Mysterious Secrets
Fall into the Abyss again and again. A fantasy ARPG game of wonder and dark magic, each run is a brand-new action/roleplaying adventure. You and your friends will need to plan ahead, craft the right equipment, and work together!
An Action-Packed Co-Op RPG Awaits
Abyss is a co-op roguelike action RPG, and you'll need friends of every class to form the right adventuring party to tackle the dungeon's ever-morphing dangers. Team up and battle enormous dungeon bosses to unlock the secrets of the Abyss!
Wield strange magic and unusual weapons
Craft weapons from the items and artifacts you loot from the Abyss. There are hundred of possibilities and countless builds available for you to experiment with. Combine weapons and skills to create distinct combinations for RPG character builds and styles of play. Wield several forms of devastating magic to strike from long range. 
A biopunk RPG steeped in magical fantasy
Dark fantasy and biotechnology come together to create a unique world of danger and wonder. Step into a peculiar world beyond magic and science!
Dungeon crawl online in multiplayer
Tackle dungeons as a crafted team in a co-op roleplaying experience, or find new friends looking for help. Work together using your classes to conquer monstrous bosses and delve ever further into the infinite Abyss. 
＝Abyss＝
Official Website: https://abyss-game.link/en
Official Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/Abyss.ARPG.Global/
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/abyss_global/
Privacy Policy: https://www.titansworld.co/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.titansworld.co/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00033080:ios.description:
Embark on a grand adventure in LEGO® Hill Climb Adventures, where iconic LEGO worlds and Hill Climb Racing collide!
The goal of LEGO Hill Climb Adventures is simple: explore, race, upgrade, and progress forward! Navigate through unlockable diverse locations, from the sunny countryside to the highest mountains and the daunting Great Below, in your quest for adventure. Overcome obstacles and complete quests by customizing and building a diverse set of vehicles, race against others in multiplayer rivals mode and unlock customization options to choose your own style! 
Along the way, you'll collect unique LEGO® Minifigures and gadgets, enhancing your exploration and building experience. LEGO Hill Climb Adventures is all about discovery and progression. Create your own path to success as you explore, build, and race!
Where will your adventure take you?
FEATURES: 
* NEW! Rivals Mode
Challenge players worldwide in Rivals Mode! Race head-to-head in multiplayer races, climb the leaderboards, and earn exclusive seasonal rewards!
* NEW! Customize Your Avatar 
Unlock customization options for your avatar and choose your style!
* NEW! Driver Perks
Unlock perk points and customize your character's unique powers to fit your playstyle.
* Discover Fun Adventures and Amazing Stories
Meet unique LEGO Hill Climb Adventures characters who will have exciting storylines with a variety of missions for you to undertake and complete. 
* Vehicles and Gadgets 
With a variety of vehicles, each equipped with unique active and passive gadgets, the possibilities are endless! Experiment with different combinations to tackle challenges or compete against players from around the world in multiplayer races!
* Upgrade and Improve 
Collect coins and bricks scattered throughout the levels to permanently boost the power of your vehicles!
* Hidden Paths and Secrets
Explore each level as they will have multiple paths for you to traverse, along with sneakily hidden secrets for you to discover! 
* Meet the LEGO Minifigures
LEGO Hill Climb Adventures brings a host of memorable characters from Climb Canyon allowing you to meet a variety of lovable, fun characters!
* Test your Skills
Figure out the best way to complete the missions given to you by the Minifigure residents of the world by selecting your vehicle and equipped gadgets carefully. Some combinations might work better for certain missions! 
If you have any issues please get in touch with our support team by emailing us at support@fingersoft.com We greatly appreciate your feedback and thank you for playing!

bluejetty:00145727:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00145727:ios.description:
The ABB-free@home® Next app is the app for controlling and commissioning
- the free@home system
- the Busch-Watchdog
- the Flex Tronic WL devices
as well as the mobile remote station for accepting door calls from the Welcome door intercom system.
The functions and the appearance of the app of the app scale with the functions of the connected devices. The full range of functions is available when a System Access Point is connected:
The app then offers 3 areas between which you can switch back and forth via the bottom control bar:
**Dashboard**
Here you get a quick overview of what's going on at home:
- The ‘Status’ tiles show you how many lights are on, how many shutters are open and whether windows are open. A short tab on a tile allows you to switch off the light directly, for example.
- The ‘Weather’ window shows you the weather data from your free@home weather station. 
- The ‘Next switching times’ window shows the two functions that will be switched next using the automated time programme. The event can be suspended once using the slider. A tab on the switching times overview displays all switching events for the next 24 hours.
- The ‘Favourites’ are a collection of individually selected functions. The selection is made by setting the ‘star’ symbol. The function can be executed directly by clicking on the small blue symbol at the top right of the favourites tile. By tabbing on the main area of the tile, the function is called up in fullscreen view, which offers even more setting options.
The order of the function areas can be changed using the ‘Edit’ button at the bottom of the home page.
**ROOMS**
Here you can access all the devices in your free@home installation.
**AUTOMATION**
Timer
Existing time programmes can be activated/deactivated (and new time programmes can be created in the future).
Actions
Actions are logical links in if-then style, which allow the creation of complex automation scenarios.
myBuildings Portal
By registering free of charge with the free@home system and the app on the myBuildings portal, the free@home system can also be operated remotely.
CONFIGURATION 
The configuration area of the app can be opened via the menu icon at the top right of the app. Here you can configure new devices, install add-ons or create scenes and groups. Access to this area can be restricted by assigning authorisations.

bluejetty:00119089:ios.name: Delight Games Premium Library
bluejetty:00119089:ios.summary:
12 YEARS. 80+ STORIES. 100% HUMAN-AUTHORED. NOW ON YOUR WRIST.
Dive into 80+ interactive novels where your choices actually matter. No "pay-to-win" decisions. No algorithms. Just deep, hand-crafted storytelling from a lifelong D&D nerd...
bluejetty:00119089:ios.description:
12 YEARS. 80+ STORIES. 100% HUMAN-AUTHORED. NOW ON YOUR WRIST.
Dive into 80+ interactive novels where your choices actually matter. No "pay-to-win" decisions. No algorithms. Just deep, hand-crafted storytelling from a lifelong D&D nerd... now on iPhone AND Apple Watch, because apparently your phone wasn't close enough to your face.
For over a decade, Delight Games has been building a universe. This is a massive collection of 1 million+ words across 80+ volumes. Every branching path, every stat-check, and every secret ending was written and balanced by a human hand to ensure a rewarding RPG experience.
THE DELIGHT GAMES DIFFERENCE:
 • 80+ Interactive Volumes: High Fantasy, Noir Mystery, Gritty Horror, Sci-Fi, and more.
 • 100% Human-Authored: Every twist and every dungeon crawl was written and balanced by a human hand. No AI-generated filler.
 • Choices are ALWAYS Free: Unlike other games, we never charge you gems or diamonds to make a specific choice. Your decisions are based on strategy and character, not your wallet.
 • RPG Mechanics: Manage your Life, Mana, Sanity, and Cool. One wrong decision in a dark dungeon could be your last.
 • Play Anywhere: No wifi? No problem. It's light on your storage and easy on your battery.
 • Fully Accessible: Fully VoiceOver compatible for blind and low-vision players.
YOUR WRIST JUST BECAME A DUNGEON. The full Delight Games experience is now on Apple Watch: Standalone or paired with your iPhone. Either way, your story goes wherever you go.
 • Read & Play Full Stories: The whole experience, miniaturized. Make choices, manage stats, and try not to die... all from your wrist.
 • Built-In Speed Reader: A fully customizable RSVP speed reader delivers words one at a time, right to your eyeballs. No scrolling or squinting, just dial in your words-per-minute and let the story come to you.
 • Quick Decisions, Companion Mode: Let your Watch handle the choices while your phone handles... whatever phones do when you're not looking.
 • Track Your Stats: Life. Mana. Sanity. Cool. Watch them fluctuate in real time as you make increasingly questionable decisions.
 • Never Lose Your Place: Your Watch will remind you that there's a dragon waiting and you left it at a cliffhanger.
TRULY FREE TO PLAY We believe in the "play well, play for free" model.
 • Earn Your Way: Hunt down those achievements, get the high ranks, and choose to watch the rewarded videos as they become available. Not that I don't appreciate your monetary support and I'm confident that you will find it well worth it, but know that you do not have to.
 • The "Luck" System: Use your earned Luck to rewind time and fix fatal mistakes.
 • The Premium Option: Want to skip the grind? A one-time purchase unlocks ALL current and future content forever. No ads, no coins, no gates… just the ultimate library.
ABOUT DELIGHT GAMES If you're new to Delight Games you might say "Interactive novels? But I don't like to read." You might even say this in a whiny voice (although we hope not).
Well, even for you book haters, now reading is addictive because with Delight Games interactive novels you make the choices for the main character, alter the story, alter your stats, and try to stay alive. Can you make it to the end? If so, what kind of score and rank can you get?
If you like interactive fiction or just want to try something different from the typical soul-sucking mobile games, this is the ULTIMATE download for you!

WarFriends Legends is an exhilarating real-time multiplayer portrait shooter packed with diverse heroes, epic abilities, and intense game modes. Engage in battles across various maps using a vast arsenal of weapons, booster cards, and gadgets. Experience thrilling PvP and PvE combat, diving into strategic action anytime, anywhere! If you're a fan of Battle Royale, Survival, or any other action games, don’t hesitate—download this game where every battle is unique. You’ll love it!
FEATURES:
- Over 10 Game Modes: PvP and PvE options, including Battle Royale, Co-op, and more.
- 20+ Unique Heroes: Unlock, upgrade, and master a roster of powerful characters.
- Varied NPC Enemies: Face hideous zombies, sneaky flamethrowers, and dangerous spider-bot bosses.
- Abilities & Perks: Utilize a plethora of active and passive abilities and upgradeable, game-changing perks.
- Arsenal of Weapons: Equip cool-looking weapons like grenade launchers, SMGs, and sniper rifles.
- Lootable Gadgets: Gain an edge in every battle with a variety of gadgets.
- Rogue-like Upgrading: Enhance your strategy with in-battle upgrades.
- Booster Collection: Collect and upgrade boosters for powerful effects.
- Customization Options: Personalize your experience with skins, emotes, drop bots, and trails.
MULTIPLE FUN MODES
With over 10 different game modes, including PvE, PvP, and PvPvE in teams of 2 or 4, WarFriends Legends offers something for every online gaming fan. Whether you prefer cooperative or competitive play, Battle Royale, or Plunder, there’s a mode for you!
POWERFUL ELITE HEROES
Choose from powerful elite heroes, each boasting unique weapons, skills, and abilities. Whether you want to unleash a toxic cloud that poisons enemies or smash them with sharp axes, unlock and collect unique skins as you progress through the game.
FIND MIGHTY WEAPONS
With an endless array of guns to choose from, you’ll find the perfect weapon to suit your playstyle. Boost your weapons, dominate the battlefield, and become the ultimate survivor!
GET PRECIOUS LOOT
But beware—the arena is teeming with ravenous zombies and sneaky mercenaries that threaten your success. Use your shooting and battle skills to defend yourself and secure valuable loot.
EVER-CHANGING BATTLEFIELD
Experience diverse rogue-like elements, various boosters, game modifiers, and a dynamic map that changes every battle, ensuring fresh and original gameplay each time you play.
CREATE BOOSTER COMBINATIONS
Build and upgrade your booster deck with the dynamic booster system. Create mighty combinations that will leave your opponents in awe!
FUN WITH FRIENDS
Invite your friends to play DUOS or QUADROS. Team up with your buddies and take on other teams. Every party is more fun with WarFriends Legends!
BECOME A LEGEND
Master the best tactics and strategies in WarFriends Legends to become the last person standing or the one who collects the most coins. With exciting battles, shooting action, rogue-like elements, and the chance to unlock and collect rewards, heroes, and skills, WarFriends Legends is a must-play for any fan of Battle Royale, Survival, or action games. Download now and become the ultimate legend!

bluejetty:00138421:ios.description:
Welcome Baby helps you log feeding, sleep, growth, and everyday care and share information with caregivers.
COMPREHENSIVE TRACKING TAILORED TO YOUR BABY
Use quick daily logging to build your routine.Welcome Baby helps you:
Monitor feeding patterns and amounts
Track sleep duration and quality
Log diaper changes and health concerns
Record growth and developmental progress
Share data with caregivers and healthcare providers
ROUTINE SUMMARIES
Review your recorded feeding, sleep, and growth information over time. These summaries do not diagnose conditions or predict developmental outcomes.
TRACK EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS
Monitor daily routine effortlessly: 
Feeding: breast, bottle, and solid food logging
Sleep patterns with duration and quality
Diaper changes with health notes
Growth metrics: weight, height, head circumference
Developmental milestones and achievements
Pumping sessions with milk supply tracking
Mood and energy levels Daily activities: playtime and tummy time Health observations in one place
Unlimited customization lets you track any factor relevant to your baby's care.
DEVELOPMENTAL INFORMATION
Explore general developmental information: 
Comprehensive milestone tracking for each age and stage
Developmental activities tailored to your baby's age
General information about developmental milestones; timing varies between babies
Fun bonding exercises for learning together
Age-appropriate stimulation ideas
General information about developmental stages
SMART FEATURES FOR CONFIDENT PARENTING
Customizable notifications and reminders for feeding, sleep, and care General educational information organized by your baby’s age Educational content on baby development and health Milestone alerts to celebrate achievements Health and wellness guidance from trusted sources Memory journal to document special moments Photo diary to capture growth over time Optional AI chat support for personalized support
WELLNESS DISCLAIMER
This app is for informational and wellness support only. It does not replace professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before changing your diet, exercise, or medication routine. Individual needs and results vary.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Welcome Baby offers flexible auto-renewing plans.
PAYMENT & RENEWAL
You can download and use the app for free. Continued access to all features requires a subscription. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in account settings. Prices apply to U.S. customers; international pricing may vary by currency.
PRIVACY AND SUPPORT
See the Privacy Policy for information about data storage, use, service providers, and deletion options.
Contact: help@welcome.baby
Privacy Policy: https://welcome.baby/privacy
Terms of Use: https://welcome.baby/terms
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
SIMPLIFY YOUR BABY’S DAILY ROUTINE TODAY
Download Welcome Baby and discover how simple feeding, sleep, and care logs can help you organize daily routines and share information with caregivers.

- Engage with other Dōse members in the community and share your progress.

- Integrates with Apple Health to keep track of your progress.

bluejetty:00022938:ios.summary:
Instantly extend your corporate purchasing power to those who need it in your organization with U.S. Bank Instant Card™.
Instant Card combines the capabilities of a U.S. Bank virtual credit card with the power of an Apple device to create
bluejetty:00022938:ios.description:
Instantly extend your corporate purchasing power to those who need it in your organization with U.S. Bank Instant Card™.
Instant Card combines the capabilities of a U.S. Bank virtual credit card with the power of an Apple device to create a completely digital payment experience. 
With just a few simple steps, you can easily create and send an Instant Card to anyone in your organization who needs it for business expenses. It eliminates the need to pay for business expenses with a personal credit card and seek reimbursement.
FEATURES:
• Send cards to employees and contractors from a web portal or mobile app in real-time
• Set the card activation period to the exact time needed
• Set the card limit to desired amount (based on available credit limit)
• Push the virtual card to Apple Wallet with a single click
• View the full card number and CVV code securely
• Integrated with U.S. Bank Access® Online for reporting 
• Send multiple cards to a single user
• Deactivate cards immediately when no longer needed
HOW IT WORKS:
An authorized provisioner for your organization will receive an email invitation from U.S. Bank with all the information to download the app and register. Once registered, the provisioner creates a virtual card by:
1. Setting the credit limit and expiration date.
2. Entering basic recipient details.
3. Pushing the virtual credit card to the recipient through the Instant Card app.
The recipient will receive an email notification with instructions to download the app and register. Once the recipient registers, the virtual card is active and can be added directly to their Apple Wallet.
REQUIREMENTS: 
Organizations must be a U.S. Bank Instant Card customer and you must be either entitled by the organization as an authorized provisioner or sent a mobile card by a provisioner. To become an Instant Card customer, interested businesses can contact U.S. Bank at 800.344.5696.

bluejetty:00039685:ios.description:
Meteox is the new and improved international weather app created by Infoplaza. The app provides weather forecasts up to 14 days for over a million locations worldwide using the latest global weather data models available. Personalise your app by creating alerts for your favourite locations to make sure the weather doesn’t ruin your day. The app includes a 'live' rain alarm that works throughout Europe and a lightning alarm that works worldwide.
Why download the Meteox app?
- It's simple and easy to use
- Extensive weather forecasting for over a million locations worldwide
- Weather forecasts for the next 24 hours up to 14 days
- Rain alarm throughout Europe
- Worldwide lightning alarm with 98% accuracy
Meteox uses the best weather data available, which is then analysed by professional meteorologists. This data is also used by major companies and governmental institutions. Our customers rely daily on accurate and reliable weather services so the Meteox app has been created to help their daily activities become a little bit more predictable.
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00043209:ios.description:
itofoo is a charity service designed for day care centers and loving parents.
It consists of two apps, one is “itofoo T” for the staff at day care, the other is “itofoo” for parents. 
With the beautifully designed app, parents are able to see the updates made by staff in real time, or take notes while children are at home, such as diet, body temperature or even photos. A child can have multiple adults taking care of it and they all can share the information firsthand. (You may use itofoo independently in case you aren’t using any day care service. Once you decide to go for child care, historic data will be seamlessly connected with the center, continuing all the information stored in database.
itofoo also does stats assessment besides recording and sharing. For example, when the stats of the child are entered correctly, the app will calculate BMI index and give ranking among the peers according to WHO. Another example is you can jump to any date to check the child’s records for medical reference. 
Still, our services need a lot of field tests and improvements. We therefore pledge to listen to feedbacks, either from parents or staff, as carefully as possible and deliver more features to your hands.

bluejetty:00186116:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00186116:ios.description:
Trace the screen and trains and bullet trains will start running!
It is a fun and simple app that can be played on the train and Shinkansen.
When you press the train mark button on the right side after running the train,
Switch to the train perspective mode with plenty of presence.
You can watch the train running from an angle you can't usually see!
Changing the mode allows you to move freely between maps
You can change the viewpoint and draw the track from various angles.
If you draw a viewpoint and draw a track from a distance, you can play as if you were creating a city!
There are many other devices!
Is there a train that won't be added if you don't play after a while? !
Please play every day!
******** ~~ How to play ~~ ********
・ Tracing the screen will draw a track and a train selection palette will appear. (You can also select automatic selection from the menu)
・ If you choose a train, the train will start running.
・ The train mark button on the right of the screen is the train viewpoint mode. The viewpoint will track the train.
-If you want to stop the train viewpoint mode, you can stop it by pressing the purple X button.
-You can change the viewpoint by tracing the screen in the train viewpoint mode. You can see the running train from various angles.
・ If you want to run multiple trains and change the viewpoint to a different train, try pressing the arrow buttons above and below the x button.
-The trash can button at the top left of the screen can erase the track once drawn.
・ The button at the top right of the screen is the menu button. Various menus can be displayed.
・ Menu contents The train selection screen can be turned on / off, BGM can be turned on / off, and scenes such as buildings and trees can be turned on / off.

bluejetty:00123745:ios.summary:

Match 3 colo
bluejetty:00123745:ios.description:
What do you get when you combine match 3, word puzzles, and inspirational quotes? A match 3 made in heaven! Get your daily dose of positivity with Bold Moves; the positively relaxing (and challenging) match 3 word puzzle game.
Match 3 colors to collect letter tiles, break through obstacles, and solve the phrase to find inspiration from motivational quotes and positive affirmations. Earn rewards and boosters, progress through chapters of puzzles, and win limited-time events.
CHALLENGE YOUR BRAIN AND YOUR MINDSET
Easy to play but tough to master! Triumph over hundreds of fun match 3 puzzle games set in calming, nature-inspired levels.
Earn rewards and achievements with weekly events centered around messages of inner strength, self-reflection, mindfulness, self-care, personal well-being, and life adventures
Put your strategy skills to the test to match, swap, and collect letter tiles 
Make matches of three in a row or more to clear colors, remove blocks, and form words
Solve the phrase to reveal celebrity quotes, win games, reach milestones, and move on to the next level of your journey
RECHARGE YOUR SOUL EVERY DAY 
Match 3 games CAN be self-care, for sure! Enjoy encouragement and relaxation with daily rewards and inspiring affirmations to set you on a path of personal growth and empowerment.
Immerse yourself in tranquil, zen-like landscapes and peaceful environments, perfect for a meditative escape
Casual gameplay with dazzling combos and power-ups provides a much-needed mental escape, whether for 5 minutes or 5 hours
A refreshing spin on a classic game, Bold Moves’ quote cards can even serve as a journal or diary full of inspiration for a rainy day!
SPREAD JOY
Share your favorite quotes with friends and spark joy, hope, and happiness
“Soooo many people have told me how much they love a good game. And, if you didn’t already know, I LOVE a great quote! So we mixed the two together! OWN presents Bold Moves, a brand-new game that challenges you to solve captivating puzzles and unlock hundreds of quotes that you can share with your friends. It’s already one of my Favorite Things… I hope it becomes one of yours, too!” – Oprah Winfrey
Download Bold Moves now and start on your path to a happier, more positive you.

bluejetty:00084537:ios.description:
知源经络穴位（原中济经络穴位APP），一款专为中医从业者、医学生及广大中医养生爱好者量身打造的 3D经络穴位与人体解剖学习平台。我们以业内顶尖的 3D 引擎技术为核心，将晦涩难懂的中医理论与人体经络穴位进行了 3D 可视化呈现。无论您是需要学习探索十二正经、奇经八脉、董氏奇穴的专业人士，还是希望通过推拿、艾灸、食疗来解决日常亚健康问题的养生达人，都能在这里获得直观、专业、高效的实操指导与健康辅助。
一、业内领先的独家 3D 模型与可视化动画
1、3D 经络穴位：在 3D 模型上完整呈现十二正经、奇经八脉、经外奇穴、经别、经筋、皮部与络脉，并收录董氏奇穴、小儿经络及头部、面部、足部、耳部、手部全息反射区。支持 360 度旋转、无极缩放，一键选中全部经络并高亮当前穴位，认穴找穴更直观。
2、高清 3D 解剖（辅助精准取穴）：提供成年男女、小儿等多场景模型，高精度还原骨骼、肌肉、心血管、神经、器官与淋巴系统。肌肉层次可增可减，经络与解剖透视叠加，帮您核对穴位的真实深度与周边组织关系。
3、穴位进针透视动画：自研 3D 进针模拟，呈现每个穴位的入针角度、安全深度与针尖经过的肌肉、神经、血管等组织，并标注风险区域与禁忌部位。
4、分步定位取穴动画：结合骨度分寸与体表标志，分步演示取穴流程，看图即懂。
5、经脉循行动态演示：还原《黄帝内经》所述经脉走向，展现经络联络脏腑、外络肢节的完整路径；开启内络透视后，器官遮挡处也清晰可见。
6、姿势切换与模型模板：站立、侧身、侧平举自由切换，选穴时自动换到最佳体位；常用的显示设置与视角可存为模板，下次一键还原。
7、国家标准经穴挂图：内置国家标准经穴部位挂图与小儿标准穴位图，可缩放、可点按查看穴位详情。
二、智能 AI 诊断与养生调理系统—您的贴身健康管家
1、AI 舌诊、面诊、手诊与体质检测：上传照片或回答问题，结合中医“望、闻、问、切”分析体质与健康状态。
2、中医问诊模拟测算：还原专业中医师的辨证逻辑。写下主述、上传舌象、勾选当下不适，系统便如医师坐诊般逐层问诊，辨病位、辨病因、辨病性，推演出证型与核心病机，并列出可供查阅的辨证依据。
3、定制专属调理方案：针对失眠、疲劳、肩颈酸痛、脱发、肠胃不适等亚健康问题，生成涵盖茶饮、食疗药膳、艾灸、推拿按摩、针灸、气功运动与作息情绪管理的综合方案，配图文与真人视频指导。
4、结果可追溯：检测与搜索结果均附数据来源说明，并提示仅供学习参考、不能替代医生面诊。
三、海量权威中医百科大全—装在口袋里的中医智库
1、经络穴位图解大辞典：覆盖十四正经、经外奇穴与董氏奇穴，解析五腧穴、原络穴等特定属性与主治配穴，配高清解剖图与真人实操视频，并呈现历代定位演变。
2、临床疾病百科：收录 700+ 常见内外妇儿病症，源自“十四五”权威教材，提供病因辨证、经典医案与针灸、拔罐、刮痧、推拿等外治方案。
3、中草药与药膳：数千种中草药的性味归经、功效主治与配伍禁忌；上千种药膳结合二十四节气与个人体质，指导日常食疗。
4、千本正版古籍：收录《黄帝内经》《伤寒杂病论》《金匮要略》《针灸甲乙经》等上千本人民卫生出版社正版典籍，支持在线阅读与进度续读，针灸歌赋配白话注释与语音朗读。
5、医家、术语与知识图谱：历代医家的学术思想、中医术语速查与中医基础理论；知识图谱以关系网络串联穴位、经络、病症、中药与典籍。
6、沉浸式阅读：支持全文朗读、阅读模式、深色模式与字号调节，古籍原文可对照白话解析。
四、沉浸式互动模拟中医小游戏
1、辨证入门演练：古风背景模拟真实临床场景，通过互动对话收集症状，引导您建立正确的辨证思路。
2、归经宝典闯关：以趣味闯关记忆穴位与经络，告别死记硬背。
3、舌象辨析模拟：对比不同舌色、舌苔的真实案例，快速掌握基础舌诊。
4、奇遇中医探索：以休闲解谜的方式探索中医基础，内容涵盖中草药识别、针灸推拿、阴阳五行，以及太极拳、八段锦、气功等传统养生功法的图文科普。
五、高阶实用辅助工具库
1、子午流注与经络时钟：结合纳甲法、纳子法、灵龟八法与飞腾八法，按当前时辰推荐当令经络与最佳穴位。
2、五运六气推衍：传统中医历法与运气学说计算工具，辅助时令病因分析。
3、真太阳时与桌面小组件：按当地真太阳时运行，经络循行、养生时钟与灵龟、飞腾八法开穴更精准；桌面小组件让时辰开穴一眼可见。
4、执业题库与学习：面向医学考研与执业中医师考试的题库，可按艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线生成学习计划，并支持错题本与专项复习；模型端可记忆上次学习视点。
5、一键分享：经络图谱、动画演示与百科内容可生成高清长图或网页链接，快速分享至微信、小红书、快手等平台。
知源经络穴位，让博大精深的中医智慧，成为您触手可及的健康生活指南。海量高阶功能持续上新中，立即下载，开启您的 3D 中医探索之旅！

listings.name: 知源经络穴位-中医经络穴位针灸艾灸按摩养生舌诊中草药识别大全
listings.description:
知源经络穴位（原中济经络穴位APP），一款专为中医从业者、医学生及广大中医养生爱好者量身打造的 3D经络穴位与人体解剖学习平台。我们以业内顶尖的 3D 引擎技术为核心，将晦涩难懂的中医理论与人体经络穴位进行了 3D 可视化呈现。无论您是需要学习探索十二正经、奇经八脉、董氏奇穴的专业人士，还是希望通过推拿、艾灸、食疗来解决日常亚健康问题的养生达人，都能在这里获得直观、专业、高效的实操指导与健康辅助。

一、业内领先的独家 3D 模型与可视化动画
1、3D 经络穴位：在 3D 模型上完整呈现十二正经、奇经八脉、经外奇穴、经别、经筋、皮部与络脉，并收录董氏奇穴、小儿经络及头部、面部、足部、耳部、手部全息反射区。支持 360 度旋转、无极缩放，一键选中全部经络并高亮当前穴位，认穴找穴更直观。
2、高清 3D 解剖（辅助精准取穴）：提供成年男女、小儿等多场景模型，高精度还原骨骼、肌肉、心血管、神经、器官与淋巴系统。肌肉层次可增可减，经络与解剖透视叠加，帮您核对穴位的真实深度与周边组织关系。
3、穴位进针透视动画：自研 3D 进针模拟，呈现每个穴位的入针角度、安全深度与针尖经过的肌肉、神经、血管等组织，并标注风险区域与禁忌部位。
4、分步定位取穴动画：结合骨度分寸与体表标志，分步演示取穴流程，看图即懂。
5、经脉循行动态演示：还原《黄帝内经》所述经脉走向，展现经络联络脏腑、外络肢节的完整路径；开启内络透视后，器官遮挡处也清晰可见。
6、姿势切换与模型模板：站立、侧身、侧平举自由切换，选穴时自动换到最佳体位；常用的显示设置与视角可存为模板，下次一键还原。
7、国家标准经穴挂图：内置国家标准经穴部位挂图与小儿标准穴位图，可缩放、可点按查看穴位详情。

二、智能 AI 诊断与养生调理系统—您的贴身健康管家
1、AI 舌诊、面诊、手诊与体质检测：上传照片或回答问题，结合中医“望、闻、问、切”分析体质与健康状态。
2、中医问诊模拟测算：还原专业中医师的辨证逻辑。写下主述、上传舌象、勾选当下不适，系统便如医师坐诊般逐层问诊，辨病位、辨病因、辨病性，推演出证型与核心病机，并列出可供查阅的辨证依据。
3、定制专属调理方案：针对失眠、疲劳、肩颈酸痛、脱发、肠胃不适等亚健康问题，生成涵盖茶饮、食疗药膳、艾灸、推拿按摩、针灸、气功运动与作息情绪管理的综合方案，配图文与真人视频指导。
4、结果可追溯：检测与搜索结果均附数据来源说明，并提示仅供学习参考、不能替代医生面诊。

三、海量权威中医百科大全—装在口袋里的中医智库
1、经络穴位图解大辞典：覆盖十四正经、经外奇穴与董氏奇穴，解析五腧穴、原络穴等特定属性与主治配穴，配高清解剖图与真人实操视频，并呈现历代定位演变。
2、临床疾病百科：收录 700+ 常见内外妇儿病症，源自“十四五”权威教材，提供病因辨证、经典医案与针灸、拔罐、刮痧、推拿等外治方案。
3、中草药与药膳：数千种中草药的性味归经、功效主治与配伍禁忌；上千种药膳结合二十四节气与个人体质，指导日常食疗。
4、千本正版古籍：收录《黄帝内经》《伤寒杂病论》《金匮要略》《针灸甲乙经》等上千本人民卫生出版社正版典籍，支持在线阅读与进度续读，针灸歌赋配白话注释与语音朗读。
5、医家、术语与知识图谱：历代医家的学术思想、中医术语速查与中医基础理论；知识图谱以关系网络串联穴位、经络、病症、中药与典籍。
6、沉浸式阅读：支持全文朗读、阅读模式、深色模式与字号调节，古籍原文可对照白话解析。

四、沉浸式互动模拟中医小游戏
1、辨证入门演练：古风背景模拟真实临床场景，通过互动对话收集症状，引导您建立正确的辨证思路。
2、归经宝典闯关：以趣味闯关记忆穴位与经络，告别死记硬背。
3、舌象辨析模拟：对比不同舌色、舌苔的真实案例，快速掌握基础舌诊。
4、奇遇中医探索：以休闲解谜的方式探索中医基础，内容涵盖中草药识别、针灸推拿、阴阳五行，以及太极拳、八段锦、气功等传统养生功法的图文科普。

五、高阶实用辅助工具库
1、子午流注与经络时钟：结合纳甲法、纳子法、灵龟八法与飞腾八法，按当前时辰推荐当令经络与最佳穴位。
2、五运六气推衍：传统中医历法与运气学说计算工具，辅助时令病因分析。
3、真太阳时与桌面小组件：按当地真太阳时运行，经络循行、养生时钟与灵龟、飞腾八法开穴更精准；桌面小组件让时辰开穴一眼可见。
4、执业题库与学习：面向医学考研与执业中医师考试的题库，可按艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线生成学习计划，并支持错题本与专项复习；模型端可记忆上次学习视点。
5、一键分享：经络图谱、动画演示与百科内容可生成高清长图或网页链接，快速分享至微信、小红书、快手等平台。
知源经络穴位，让博大精深的中医智慧，成为您触手可及的健康生活指南。海量高阶功能持续上新中，立即下载，开启您的 3D 中医探索之旅！

* DEDICATED SUPPORT - Get dedicated help and community for your healthy lifestyle! Maya and other experts on her team will personally answer every question.
* DISCOUNTS ON HEALTHY INGREDIENTS - Get 15% off zero sugar sweeteners, flours, syrups, baking mixes, and more.
* MONTHLY GIVEAWAY - Get automatically entered for a chance to win ingredients, cookbooks, gift cards and more.

* AUTOMATIC GROCERY LIST - The biggest time saver! Your healthy shopping list will update as you customize your meal plan.
* CUSTOMIZE RECIPES - Add, remove, or replace ingredients to what you like or have on hand! The nutrition info, your macro tracker, and grocery list will auto update to match.
* LEFTOVERS - Save time and money by incorporating leftovers into your plan, with just a couple taps.
* MEAL PREP IDEAS - I'll give ideas for EVERY recipe, but you choose how much you prep ahead.
* FOR YOU OR YOUR FAMILY - Choose individual or family right away, and scale recipes to any number of people!
* SYNC ACROSS ALL DEVICES - Your meal plan syncs across all your phones and tablets, and your computer.
* SAVE PDF OR PRINT - Auto generate a PDF of your healthy meal plan or grocery list, which you can save or print.
Sticking to a healthy lifestyle doesn't have to be complicated. Whether you struggle with what to eat, how to calculate and stick to your macros, what recipes to make, how to plan your meals, or just love delicious food... the Wholesome Yum app takes care of it all -- in a custom way for YOU.
