bluejetty:00153991:ios.description:
Need a free flight tracker and detailed flight information in one place? AirHelp – the app built to support your flights!
Why choose AirHelp flight tracker? Flight tracker live access global free tracking for flights.
・Free flight tracker to show real-time data for flights on an interactive map
・Flight manager to organise and manage journeys
・Instant alerts on flight status, gate changes, and schedule updates
・Simplified claim process for flight disruptions
・Airplane tracker to view detailed flight information
・Flight sharing to keep friends and family updated about the journey in real-time
・Auto-import flights via calendar or Gmail
・Flight stats to view a summary of your past flights and travel history
・24/7 customer support and travel insurance assistance
・Premium travel insurance and airport lounge access with TravelPass by Airhelp upgrade
・App is completely free and ad-free
Free Flight Tracker
AirHelp plane tracker is a travel assistant app designed for passengers. The airplane tracker displays the current location of each flight on a detailed live map and updates automatically in case of delays or cancellations. All data is synced instantly to ensure accurate flight status at all times.
Flight Status & Delays
Flight tracker provides real-time status updates for all scheduled flights. The system detects delays, cancellations, and gate changes, delivering instant notifications as flight information changes. It ensures continuous monitoring to keep travel plans accurate and up to date.
Boarding Pass Scanner
AirHelp scans and stores boarding passes to centralise travel information in one place. The app automatically extracts check-in times, gate and terminal details, and baggage claim information. It streamlines the travel process by keeping all essential flight data easily accessible. AirHelp simplifies the travel experience from take-off to landing.
Flight Summary
Flight stats provide users with a detailed overview of their travel history, including the number of flights taken, total distance traveled, time spent in the air, and visited countries or airports. All data is automatically compiled from tracked flights, offering a personalized summary that updates with each new journey.
Claim Compensation
AirHelp airplane tracker app checks eligibility for flight compensation in cases of delays, cancellations, or overbooking. It allows users to submit a claim directly through the app in a few simple steps. AirHelp handles the entire process without requiring paperwork, providing a streamlined way to claim up to $650.
Comprehensive Travel Insurance with TravelPass by Airhelp
TravelPass by Airhelp provides premium travel insurance for complete trip protection. It covers flight disruptions, lost or delayed baggage, and grants access to airport lounges during delays. Includes 24/7 support to assist with any travel issues. Designed to ensure a smoother journey from departure to arrival.
AirHelp is the world’s leading flight compensation company, helping millions of passengers get the money they deserve. Whether users are at the airport or in the sky, AirHelp flight tracking tools give you confidence and control. Use our trip assistant, monitor your flight status, and track every airplane with ease.
AirHelp is more than a flight tracker – it’s a trusted travel assistant that helps you take charge of your journey. From a missing airplane to a cancelled flight, it provides support, updates, and travel insurance cover.
AirHelp is here to help:
・Reliable airplane tracker
・Updates on every flight status and airport change
・Way to claim for any delayed flight or cancelled flight
・Fast, simple access to real travel insurance and disruption support
・Full-featured flight assistant to simplify every trip
Download AirHelp now and turn flight disruptions into compensation. Flight tracker, trip assistant, and instant claim support – all backed by robust travel insurance – you are always in control, no matter what happens in the sky.

bluejetty:00139908:ios.name: Legions of Rome 2
bluejetty:00139908:ios.summary:
Legions of Rome 2: Forge Your Empire and Conquer History
Step into the sandals of a Roman general in "Legions of Rome 2," the ultimate strategic experience set in the heart of the ancient Roman Empire. This game offers an immersive journey
bluejetty:00139908:ios.description:
Legions of Rome 2: Forge Your Empire and Conquer History
Step into the sandals of a Roman general in "Legions of Rome 2," the ultimate strategic experience set in the heart of the ancient Roman Empire. This game offers an immersive journey through history, where you will lead your legion to glory, expand your empire, and outsmart your enemies in intense, tactical battles.
Unleash the Power of Rome
In "Legions of Rome 2," you have the power to shape the destiny of the greatest empire the world has ever known. Start as a young, ambitious commander and rise through the ranks to become a legendary general. Your journey will take you through lush landscapes, treacherous mountains, and sprawling cities, each rendered in stunning, realistic graphics.
Historical Accuracy Meets Tactical Depth
Immerse yourself in a game world that prides itself on historical accuracy. "Legions of Rome 2" meticulously recreates the units, weapons, and tactics used by Roman armies, allowing you to experience warfare as it was meant to be. Deploy legions of infantry and archers, each with their own unique strengths and weaknesses.
SANDBOX MODE : Build and Manage Your Empire
Create your own custom maps and save them! Edit terrain, place buildings, trees and units. Edit weather, change daytime, make your level rainy, foggy and much more!
Epic Battles and Campaigns
Experience a wide range of thrilling campaigns that span the entire Roman era. Whether you're defending Rome from barbarian invasions or leading a campaign to conquer distant lands, each mission offers unique challenges and objectives. Engage in massive battles with hundreds of units on screen, each one vying for dominance. The dynamic weather and terrain will test your strategic flexibility, forcing you to adapt your tactics on the fly.
Customize Your Legion
In "Legions of Rome 2," no two armies are the same. Customize your legion with a wide array of units, each with customizable equipment and abilities. Tailor your army to suit your playstyle and adapt to different battlefield conditions.
Stunning Visuals and Sound
Our game features breathtaking graphics that bring the ancient world to life. Every battlefield, city, and unit is rendered with incredible detail, creating an immersive experience that draws you into the world of ancient Rome. The epic soundtrack and realistic sound effects further enhance the atmosphere!
Key Features:
Strategic Depth: Plan and execute complex strategies on and off the battlefield.
RTS mode: Oversee your army and lead it from a bird's-eye view.
FPS mode: Tap to embody any of your units and play as them!
SANDBOX mode: Make your own highly-customizable levels!
Epic Campaigns: Engage in a variety of missions that challenge your strategic skills and adapt to dynamic conditions playing as Roman Empire or Barbarians.
Customization: Personalize your legions with unique units to create an army that matches your strategic vision.
Stunning Visuals: Enjoy high-quality graphics and sound that bring the ancient world to life.
Join the Legion, Conquer the ancient Rome
Are you ready to write your own chapter in the annals of history? Join the ranks of "Legions of Rome 2" and embark on an epic journey of conquest, strategy, and glory. The fate of the Roman Empire is in your hands. Will you rise to the challenge and become the greatest general Rome has ever known? Download "Legions of Rome 2" today and start building your legacy!

bluejetty:00044132:ios.name: QuickDrop - Share from Android
bluejetty:00044132:ios.summary: With QuickDrop, you can seamlessly send and receive photos, videos, text files, and more between your Android phone and your iPhone, iPad or Mac using Quick Share on the same Wi-Fi network. Received files are stored in the Files app and tra
bluejetty:00044132:ios.description:
With QuickDrop, you can seamlessly send and receive photos, videos, text files, and more between your Android phone and your iPhone, iPad or Mac using Quick Share on the same Wi-Fi network. Received files are stored in the Files app and transmitted with end-to-end encryption over Wi-Fi, so no cloud is involved in the process.
To send files from your iPhone or iPad to your Mac or Android device, just select "Share" or tap the share icon for a file you want to transfer and choose "QuickDrop". If you don't see QuickDrop in the list, scroll right until you see "More", then choose "Edit" and enable the toggle for QuickDrop.
Other devices on the same network with QuickDrop installed and running will appear automatically. You can also open QuickDrop, tap a device and choose one or more files from the Files app, choose one or more photos and videos, or send the contents of your clipboard.
After that, you will see a notification on your other device, which allows you to accept or decline the file transfer. To receive files, you simply need to open the QuickDrop app.
You can also download the optional QuickDrop Android app for additional features. Transfer files without a shared Wi-Fi network and mark devices as trusted to automatically accept incoming transfers.
QuickDrop lets you send and receive files for free. Upgrade to QuickDrop+ for unrestricted transfer speeds and access to all current and future features. QuickDrop+ is available as a one-time purchase or a flexible subscription that you can cancel at any time.
QuickDrop is an improved version of NearDrop. Nearby Share and Quick Share are trademarks of Google, LLC and Samsung Electronics. Android is a trademark of Google, LLC. This application is not affiliated with Google, LLC or Samsung Electronics.
This application is governed by Apple’s standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement (EULA), available at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00041458:ios.name: Magical Maintenance Mystery
bluejetty:00041458:ios.summary: At first it seems like an ordinary apartment maintenance job. Meet the residents, help them with their problems, and definitely don't search their apartments while they're not home (but it's just so tempting, and no one will ever know, righ
bluejetty:00041458:ios.description:
At first it seems like an ordinary apartment maintenance job. Meet the residents, help them with their problems, and definitely don't search their apartments while they're not home (but it's just so tempting, and no one will ever know, right?). But you'll quickly realize something else is going on. Lights flicker, toilets attack you, and there are plenty of secret rooms and lost histories to discover. This apartment is much bigger on the inside than on the outside...
Magical Maintenance Mystery is a half cozy, half spooky incremental text adventure from the developer of Nano Empire, Evelyn's Farm, Pocket Reality, and more.
Features:
-Explore a big open world at your own pace.
-Customize your character with four skills: Combat, Empathy, Engineering, and Investigation.
-Get to know four residents: Helen the young genius, Simon the artist, Willa the minister, and Bruce the entrepreneur; plus more characters you'll discover later.
-Fight bed bugs and roaches, but these will soon be the least of your worries...
-Solve puzzles, with a hint system if you get stuck.
-Fully accessible with VoiceOver.
-Play the complete game for free with no ads. An in-app purchase is available to permanently double your progress and unlock optional content.

This apartment is much bigger on the inside than on the outside...

Magical Maintenance Mystery is a half cozy, half spooky incremental text adventure from the developer of Nano Empire, Evelyn's Farm, Pocket Reality, and more.

Features:

-Explore a big open world at your own pace.
-Customize your character with four skills: Combat, Empathy, Engineering, and Investigation.
-Get to know four residents: Helen the young genius, Simon the artist, Willa the minister, and Bruce the entrepreneur; plus more characters you'll discover later.
-Fight bed bugs and roaches, but these will soon be the least of your worries...
-Solve puzzles, with a hint system if you get stuck.
-Fully accessible with VoiceOver.
-Play the complete game for free with no ads. An in-app purchase is available to permanently double your progress and unlock optional content.

bluejetty:00116085:ios.name: Canadian Rockies GyPSy Guide
bluejetty:00116085:ios.summary:
Plays commentary automatically as you drive, so you don't miss any of the best places to visit—plus stories, tips, and directions.
There are 530+ audio points that play automatically along the scenic drive, featuring the best things to see
bluejetty:00116085:ios.description:
Plays commentary automatically as you drive, so you don't miss any of the best places to visit—plus stories, tips, and directions.
There are 530+ audio points that play automatically along the scenic drive, featuring the best things to see and do, complete with stories, tips, and driving directions.
Tours work offline using free GPS signal and location services, so no data roaming, network, or Wi-Fi is required while touring.
Visit www.gypsyguide.com for route maps, sample commentary, and tips & advice.
WHAT TO EXPECT:
It's so simple! All you have to do is start driving towards wherever you want to go. The commentary will play automatically. This includes all the instructions you need for places where you have to make important turns or decisions about which route to take. Once you have launched “Start Driving,” the commentary will play automatically as you pass through the activation points. The narration seamlessly transitions from each area and park to the next.
As you tour, you're going to see giant, classic Rocky Mountains with their sheer faces and distinctive ridging. There are many opportunities to see glaciers, especially around Lake Louise and along the Icefields Parkway.
Always watch for wildlife, frequently seen enjoying grassy meadows. Grizzly bears and black bears aren't always guaranteed, but the tour will give you tips about places where your chances are better.
There are many gorgeous lakes with colors too good to be true. Don't miss Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, Emerald Lake, and Peyto Lake, which is at Bow Summit on the Icefields Parkway. And if you love waterfalls, the Rockies have many—each one demonstrating amazing power.
The tour is filled with entertaining stories about characters from the region, the forces of nature, and other tales that will give you a personal connection to this incredible location.
WHAT YOU’LL SEE:
Commentary will play automatically as you pass from one area to the next through Banff, Yoho, and Jasper National Parks.
• Icefields Parkway – Voted the World's Most Beautiful Mountain Drive
• Lake Louise & Moraine Lake – Famously beautiful lakes with mountains and glaciers
• Yoho National Park – Spiral Tunnels, Emerald Lake, Takakkaw Falls
• Jasper National Park – Maligne Lake and Canyon, Miette Hot Springs, Pyramid Lake
• Banff townsite and area – Banff Gondola, Bow Falls, Lake Minnewanka
• Bow Valley Parkway – Johnston Canyon
• And many more scenic lookouts and photo opportunities
CHARGING:
++ Continued use of GPS/location services in the background increases battery usage. We strongly recommend using a cigarette-style (DC outlet) car charger to keep your phone charged, and avoid charging through the USB port.
AUDIO:
Listen directly from your phone or connect to the car stereo via Bluetooth. Avoid using a direct USB connection in rental vehicles, as this can cause audio issues. The audio can play through your car’s Apple CarPlay and Android Auto display; however, the map will display only on your phone.
iPADS:
iPad models must include a GPS chip. Please note: only the iPad Wi-Fi + Cellular models contain a GPS chip. Wi-Fi-only iPad models have limited location capabilities and are unable to play commentary automatically.
DOWNLOADING:
The apps are larger in size to function offline. You must download the app ahead of time using Wi-Fi (recommended) or cellular data. Once downloaded, you can tour offline without cell service.
ABOUT US:
GyPSy Guide™ produces award-winning narrated audio tours along scenic drives and road trips around the world.
Our tours are enjoyed by travelers who prefer to set their own pace and itinerary on vacation but enjoy a fun, informative, and educational guided experience while driving themselves. Our goal is to provide a great introduction to the region and inspire you to learn more and return.
None of our apps include paid advertising or placements for benefit.

bluejetty:00118763:ios.description:
Atto is the GPS time tracking app for businesses with teams in the field. Join 15,000+ businesses already using Atto to track hours, verify locations, and get payroll done in minutes — saving 4+ hours every week.
Track time with GPS verification, manage timesheets, build schedules, and run payroll — all from one simple app. Your team clocks in from the job site, and you see exactly where and when, with location proof on every entry. No more guesswork. No more chasing down hours.
Atto timesheets are built automatically from clock in data. Hours, breaks, and overtime, all calculated and ready for review. Approve with one tap and payday goes from a headache to a few clicks.
Need schedules too? Build and share them in minutes. Manage shift trades, send reminders, and track availability so your team always knows where to be and when.
TRUSTED BY BUSINESSES EVERYWHERE
"Atto is so easy to use, and my team actually likes it. That’s not something I could say before."
– Jenna M, Operations Manager, 23 employees
"I love knowing everyone’s hours are tracked correctly without having to double-check everything."
– Justin E., Business Owner, 52 employees
BUILT FOR TEAMS THAT WORK IN THE FIELD
Construction, landscaping, cleaning, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, painting, roofing, property management, security, home services — if your people don't sit at desks, Atto was built for you. The app is simple enough that anyone can use it on day one, no training required.
All-In-One Toolkit for Your Business:
TIME TRACKING & TIMESHEETS
- GPS Time Clock: Mobile time tracking with breaks, notes, and overtime.
- Automated Timesheets: Simplify timesheet management for accurate payroll.
- Job Codes: Track labor by project, task, or cost center.
- Timesheet Approvals: Review, edit, and approve in minutes — export-ready for payroll.
- Time Off Tracking: Manage leave efficiently, ensuring uninterrupted operations.
EMPLOYEE SHIFT SCHEDULING
- Build Shifts in Minutes: Create, copy, and edit employee schedules quickly.
- Trades & Covers: Facilitate shift trades & covers without managerial oversight.
- Easy Coordination: Keep everyone on the know with instant shift updates.
- Smart Reminders: Reduce missed clock ins with helpful nudges.
GPS LOCATION & MILEAGE TRACKING
- Mileage Tracking: Track drives automatically for accurate reimbursements.
- Real-Time GPS Tracking: See who’s on the clock and where they’re working.
- Location History Report: Review routes and visit times to optimize operations.
PAYROLL PROCESSING
- One-Click Payroll Processing: Run seamless payroll in minutes, not hours.
- Perfect Paydays, Every Time: Empower every employee with fast, transparent payouts.
- Simplified Tax Filing: Instantly file taxes without the dread of miscalculations.
- Accuracy & Compliance: 100+ government agencies? One click. Always compliant.
INVOICING
- Instant Invoicing: Create and send professional invoices in 30 seconds flat.
- Invoice Tracking: See what's paid, pending, or overdue at a glance.
- Automated Reminders: Chase late payments automatically — no follow-up needed.
TEAM COLLABORATION
- Team Chat: Whether it’s 1-on-1 or group chats, keep your team communication in one place.
- Activity Feed: See clock-ins, locations, jobs, and status changes.
- Reports: Timesheet, overtime, projects, and mileage — export and share.
Atto offers two subscription options:
• $9.95/month
• $94.90/year
(Price may vary by location)
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase

bluejetty:00124194:ios.description:
Rummy Palace – Your community for the popular card game on your smartphone and tablet.
Enjoy the classic card combination fun online and with real opponents! Comparable to games such as Phase 10, Bridge, or Kalooki, Rummy requires above all brains and tactical skill. You can now experience it online and for free in one of the largest card game communities online.
Whether you are a hardcore fan or a casual player, with us, you will always find an opponent at eye level. The joy of playing cards is our priority, and we invite you over to our Rummy tables.
LIVE CARD GAME EXPERIENCE
- Play live against real opponents at any time.
- Experience an active community of players.
- Chat with other card game fans.
EASY TO PLAY
- No need to register; just start playing.
- Enjoy direct play thanks to automatic player search. 
- Sort cards at the touch of a button.
RUMMY, AS YOU KNOW IT
- Use original Rummy playing cards or house cards with optimized legibility.
- Choose your card deck: French, Tournament, German … 
- Discover various special rules: Knocking, 40 Points for First Meld, Short Deck, and more.
- Play according to your personal preferences with your own rules.
FAIR-PLAY COMES FIRST
- We provide constant support by our customer service team.
- Our card shuffling is independently tested and reliable.
- The privacy settings at the Rummy Palace are flexibly adjustable.
HOBBY CARD GAME
- Gain experience and level up.
- Rummy is stress relief and memory training in one.
- Make your way through the league up to the top 10.
- In tournaments and at long-lasting tables, you can boost your endurance.
HOW TO PLAY RUMMY
Rummy is a card game for at least two players with a double card deck, including Jokers. You aim to get rid of your hand cards before your opponents do. To do so, you can play your cards as groups or rows and swap them for Jokers later on. The round ends once a player discards their last card onto the discard pile. Then, it is time to count the points. And here goes the next round!
Like Rummy Palace on Facebook
https://www.facebook.com/rummypalace/
Learn more about us and our games:
https://www.palace-of-cards.com/
NOTE:
You can download this app for free. It is permanently completely free to play. However, you can purchase optional game enhancements such as game chips, premium membership, and special playing cards within the game.
The game requires an active internet connection.
By downloading the app, you agree to our terms and conditions and our privacy policy.
TERMS & CONDITIONS:
https://www.rummy-palace.com/terms-conditions/
PRIVACY POLICY:
https://www.rummy-palace.com/privacy-policy-apps/
CUSTOMER SERVICE:
If you ever need help, feel free to contact our friendly customer service:
support@rummy-palace.com
Rummy is mainly intended for an adult audience. According to German law, Rummy is not a gambling game. In our app, there is no real money and no real prizes to win. Practice or success in casino games without real winnings ("Social Casino Games") does not imply future success in games for real money.
Rummy Palace is a product by Spiele-Palast GmbH (Palace of Cards). Playing with family, friends, or dedicated groups is one of the favorite pastimes for many people! Our mission is to give this joy of playing a digital home at the Palace of Cards and build a lively community of players through high-quality implementations of online card games.
We wish you a good hand
Your Rummy Palace Team

bluejetty:00135218:ios.name: Basketball Stats Assistant
bluejetty:00135218:ios.summary: You're on the bench. Game is live. Your assistant is scribbling stats on paper and you're about to miss a possession. Basketball Stats Assistant fixes that: one-tap live tracking (or drag and drop, if you prefer) so you never lose a stat, m
bluejetty:00135218:ios.description:
You're on the bench. Game is live. Your assistant is scribbling stats on paper and you're about to miss a possession. Basketball Stats Assistant fixes that: one-tap live tracking (or drag and drop, if you prefer) so you never lose a stat, miss a play, or enter a game blind again.
Basketball Stats Assistant will help you track and analyze your team basketball statistics easily. The best basketball stats keeper app in the market.
Discover the new season reports per team and player where you will be able to analyze basketball advanced statistics that will help your team improve their game.
REALLY INTUITIVE TRACKING SYSTEM ( DRAG AND DROP )
- By dragging and dropping any basketball action to the selected player on court the system will record the stats so that you do not lose a second of the game.
- Track second plays with just a tap thanks to the continuation dialogs that will appear on the screen after any field goal is missed or scored, fouls are committed or drawn, steals or turnovers.
- Track the remaining time of the game and the current quarter. Also edit them easily by clicking on the scoreboard directly in case the time differs from the real one.
- Check team stats and player stats whilst the game is on
- Fix any mistakes quickly by dropping the red cross icon on the player that needs to be fixed. Also edit any shot position even after the game is finished.
STATISTICS
- Shot charts ( Scored and missed shots as well as percentages)
- Free throws
- Points
- Assists
- Rebounds
- Fouls committed and drawn
- Steals
- Turnovers
- Blocks
- Time outs
- Minutes per player
REPORTS
Reports per game
- Stats per player and his/hers shot chart
- Team stats comparison chart
- Lead tracker chart
- Play to play
- Box score per team
- Efficiency
- Plus minus ( +/ - )
Season reports per player
- Shot charts and percentages per season
- Stats per opponent and date
- Season highs per stats
Season reports per team
- Shot charts and percentages per season
- Stats per opponent and date
- Overall team statistics
- Team season highs
- Individual season highs
- Advanced statistics ( Shooting, Ball handling, Rebounding and scoring - eFG%, TSA, TS%, FTR)
SCOREBOARD AND TIME TRACKING
- Track the time easily with the center court play/pause button. In case any mistake happens whilst tracking the time or quarters, you can edit it easily by clicking on the scoreboard and updating it accordingly.
- Check the game score and fouls per quarter with a quick look
SHARE YOUR STATS
- Share your team unique link with your player or other coaches so that they can also analyze the statistics. They will need to log in to the app and click on the unique link you shared with them. They will start receiving notifications as soon as your game is backed up and will see the same stats that you tracked.
TIPS
- Drag any player to the center of the court to see their live stats whilst the game is on.
- Drag any action to the center of the court or click on the interrogation mark on the right menu to see the icons meaning.
- Cancel the last action that you tracked on any player by dragging the cancellation icon ( Red circular icon with a white plus symbol ).

bluejetty:00023054:ios.name: Legends of Runeterra
bluejetty:00023054:ios.summary:
A LEAGUE OF LEGENDS™ ROGUELITE ADVENTURE
Runeterra calls! Choose your champion and pick your path to power: a single-player roguelite romp through the world of League of Legends and Arcane, or a ranked card battler where strategy reigns sup
bluejetty:00023054:ios.description:
A LEAGUE OF LEGENDS™ ROGUELITE ADVENTURE
Runeterra calls! Choose your champion and pick your path to power: a single-player roguelite romp through the world of League of Legends and Arcane, or a ranked card battler where strategy reigns supreme. Unlock and level up dozens of characters in a hand-crafted love letter to fans of hero collectors and card games alike. 
THE STORY SO FAR
From the back alleys of Zaun to celestial Mt. Targon, forces small and large threaten to forever shift the balance of power—if not unravel the world itself! Star-forging dragon Aurelion Sol plots his cataclysmic revenge, while Lissandra, an even greater menace, lurks in the frozen north.
Only champions of Runeterra can follow the path that has been set—alone or as one—with YOU at the helm.
CHOOSE YOUR CHAMPION
Play as Jinx, Warwick, Caitlyn, Vi, Ambessa, or any of a growing cast of 65+ champions. The many legends of League are yours to collect, evolve, and master as you traverse the map of Runeterra.
Each champion brings unique, awe-inspiring powers and loyal followers to the fray. Whether you freeze your opponents where they stand (Ashe), plant fungal surprises for sneaky victories (Teemo), build an elaborate combo engine for a spectacular finish (Heimerdinger), no two champions play the same.
ADAPT & EVOLVE 
Every run is a canvas for your creativity, offering new cards, powers, and relics to augment your strategy and topple menacing foes. But choose wisely! Challenges increase in difficulty over the course of a run, and from one World Adventure to the next.
Each champion can be upgraded with Star Powers—permanent augments you can unlock between runs. Completing a champion’s Constellation yields immense power—and all new strategies—for you to command.
TOPPLE MIGHTY FOES
Test your mettle against iconic villains in World Adventures and Weekly Nightmares that set the stage for your spectacular displays of strategy and skill.
Beating the odds against the likes of Lissandra and Aurelion Sol will take experimentation, ingenuity, and maybe a touch of luck. Of course, the tougher the opponent, the sweeter the victory—and the richer the rewards!
UNCOVER NEW LEGENDS
Delve into the deep lore and rich, ever-expanding universe treasured by players of League of Legends and fans of the Emmy-winning series Arcane. With exclusive characters, story-driven adventures, breathtaking card art, and a staggering cast of new and familiar faces, there’s no better way to experience the breadth and depth of Runeterra.

bluejetty:00127637:ios.description:
Com o aplicativo Bradesco Saúde, você acessa informações e serviços que facilitam o seu dia a dia. A nova atualização proporciona um acesso ainda mais intuitivo e rápido às vantagens do app e do plano contratado, além de um novo visual, garantindo melhor experiência a você.
Um app ainda mais completo: você tem à disposição um chat para tirar dúvidas diretamente com profissionais da saúde prontos para ajudar.
Aproveite, ainda, os benefícios da carteirinha digital. Ela conta com QR Code que substitui a tarja magnética do cartão físico e permite que você valide seu atendimento de forma rápida, segura e inteligente.
Você tem também acesso à nossa rede referenciada, com médicos, hospitais, clínicas e laboratórios do plano contratado. E mais: o app consegue traçar rotas do seu endereço até o destino do profissional ou serviço que você precisa.
Marque consultas em uma das clínicas Meu Doutor Novamed em apenas alguns cliques! Além do agendamento on-line de consultas presenciais, é possível visualizar o histórico dos atendimentos já agendados pelo app e realizar o cancelamento em caso de imprevisto. Há unidades em São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Bahia e Pernambuco. Veja mais em novamedsaude.com.br.
Mas, caso precise se consultar com um profissional que não esteja em sua rede referenciada, você pode realizar a solicitação de prévia do reembolso ou mesmo acompanhar os pedidos já realizados até sua finalização pelo aplicativo. Por lá você também confere quais documentações são necessárias, prazos e formas de pagamento. Tudo 100% digital e na palma da sua mão. Demais, não é?
Outra vantagem de ser beneficiário Bradesco Saúde é fazer parte do programa Desconto Farmácia e poder encontrar no app: consulta de medicamentos com desconto, farmácias credenciadas, extrato de utilização dos últimos seis meses, total economizado e mais.
Ah, e oferecemos ainda mais para que você esteja em dia com sua saúde e de sua família com o acompanhamento do calendário de vacinas.
Conte sempre com a gente. Bradesco Saúde #comvocesempre.
---------------------------------------------------
Só mais uma coisinha:
Se houver dificuldades no uso do app Bradesco Saúde, fale com a gente pelo email digital@bradescoseguros.com.br - vamos adorar ouvir você e facilitar sua experiência!

bluejetty:00096094:ios.description:
Playing Final Fantasy Tactics? Keep every job tree, treasure chest, and missable recruit at your fingertips. Available for PSX, War of the Lions, and The Ivalice Chronicles.
Whether it's your first time through Ivalice or your tenth, FFT Companion is the only reference you'll need open next to the game.
NEVER MISS ANYTHING
- User-submitted unit build guides
- Playthrough checklist that tracks missable characters, items, and events as you go
- Full errand list, so you know what's worth sending your units on
- Spoiler-conscious: see what's ahead only when you choose to
WIN THE FIGHT BEFORE IT STARTS
- Detailed 3D maps of every story battle, side quest, and location, including treasure spots and deployment tiles
- Monster stats, poach items, and where to find them
- Complete ability data: effects, damage and success formulas, range, and area of effect
- Status effect reference you can check mid-battle
BUILD THE PERFECT PARTY
- Character planner to map out a unit's job path before you commit JP
- Team builder for your five-slot squad
- Every job in a list or a full tree, with stats, requirements, and equippables
- Zodiac compatibility chart: find out which allies boost each other and which enemies will hurt more than they should
FIND ANY PIECE OF GEAR
- Complete equipment database with filters, sorting, and search
- See exactly how and where to obtain any item
ONE APP, EVERY VERSION
Switch between PSX, War of the Lions, and The Ivalice Chronicles data with a single toggle. Stats, names, and abilities update to match the version you're actually playing.
Make your next playthrough your best one.
FFT Companion is an unofficial fan-made reference app. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix.

bluejetty:00200162:ios.name: Pocket Mac Lab
bluejetty:00200162:ios.summary:
Your Mac. A whole new way to carry it.
Pocket Mac Lab brings your own Mac desktop to your iPhone, with a touch trackpad, an on-screen keyboard and seven original shells. Connect with the Mac companion to control your apps and hear your Mac
bluejetty:00200162:ios.description:
Your Mac. A whole new way to carry it.
Pocket Mac Lab brings your own Mac desktop to your iPhone, with a touch trackpad, an on-screen keyboard and seven original shells. Connect with the Mac companion to control your apps and hear your Mac audio.
YOUR DESKTOP, WHEREVER YOU ARE
Pair your iPhone with your Mac, then reconnect from home or another network. Your Mac must remain awake, online and running Pocket Mac Connector. Approved pairing is preserved across ordinary companion restarts; after restarting your Mac, you may need to sign in locally before remote access is available.
ROOM TO MOVE
Point, click, drag and two-finger scroll. Switch between the themed keyboard and a spacious trackpad, or pinch the Mac display to zoom. Fit the whole desktop again whenever you need every edge. Three-finger gestures switch Mac Spaces and open Mission Control when the corresponding Mac shortcuts are enabled.
BRING YOUR OWN SETUP
Use a compatible physical keyboard and mouse connected to your iPhone. Type, click, drag and scroll your connected Mac in folded and full-screen layouts. An additional large keyboard supports the languages enabled on your iPhone.
SEVEN ERAS. ONE LITTLE DESKTOP.
Choose Studio, Daybreak, Circuit, Midnight, Tide, Ember or Slate. Sculpted keys, worn finishes, playful switches and matching pear covers give each shell its own character. On iPhone Duo, fold into a little laptop or close it to show the matching cover.
A LITTLE DESKTOP, BUILT IN
Explore the local launcher, gallery, calculator, games and Photo Room without connecting a Mac. Photo Room offers a nine-filter grid and saves pictures in the app's gallery. These local mini apps do not run macOS; your connected Mac provides the real desktop.
PRIVATE PAIRING
First-time connection requires your Mac login and approval of a matching code on your Mac. Reconnecting an approved device does not require another QR scan each time. Optional remembered passwords are stored in device-only Keychain on your iPhone. You can forget the saved Mac or revoke sharing from the companion.
GETTING CONNECTED
Live Mac access requires the free signed and notarized Pocket Mac Connector on a compatible Mac running macOS 15 or later, macOS Screen Sharing and screen-recording permission. Additional Mac control permission enables brightness and media keys. Both devices need a working internet connection. Performance depends on the devices and both networks. Setup instructions and companion downloads are available at the support link below.
Pocket Mac Lab is a paid upfront app with no subscriptions or in-app purchases. It is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.

bluejetty:00073743:ios.name: LeadNav GPS
bluejetty:00073743:ios.summary: LEADNAV GPS is the professional off-road GPS for iPhone and iPad. Plan the route at home, run it with turn-by-turn voice guidance where there are no roads, and put your whole team on one map. Built for teams that work and travel off the gri
bluejetty:00073743:ios.description:
LEADNAV GPS is the professional off-road GPS for iPhone and iPad. Plan the route at home, run it with turn-by-turn voice guidance where there are no roads, and put your whole team on one map. Built for teams that work and travel off the grid: search and rescue, security details, expeditions, hunting camps, work crews, race teams and their chase crews.
NAVIGATE WHERE THERE ARE NO ROADS
• Turn-by-turn voice guidance from routes you build or import. Waypoints speak by name as you approach them.
• Red warning rings and blue proximity rings that adjust to your speed, so the call comes when you need it.
• Any ring you cross alerts, on the route or off it. Serpentine points keep you on the line without a word.
• Works with no signal at all. Navigation never needs a connection.
• Record tracks, convert them to routes, reverse a route to come back the way you went.
• Drop markers for anything you want to find again. Recon, Aviation and Hunting marker sets are included for everyone.
• Compatible with Bluetooth headsets, helmet intercoms and speakers for eyes-free navigation.
TRIP PACKAGES
• One file per trip, event or property: routes, tracks and markers together, with categories and Recently Deleted.
• Built on the GPX standard. Import from and export to any GPS device or planning software.
• Share a whole Trip Package with your team by AirDrop, Messages or email.
• Route Editor with Undo, Join Multiple Routes, Convert Markers to Audio Waypoints, Export to GPS Unit for Garmin, Lowrance and other units.
YOUR WHOLE TEAM ON ONE MAP
• Group tracking is included with the app. One Team Code, a QR or an invite link builds the team. Teammates join in seconds and see each other live.
• Runs over any internet connection: cellular, Wi-Fi at camp, or vehicle-mounted satellite internet such as Starlink.
• Keeps sharing with the screen locked when you turn on background tracking.
• No account, no login, nothing to sign up for. Your team identity is a random code you can reset any time.
COMMS (PRO LICENSE)
• Hold to talk with your teams from the pad on the map or from a wireless button. Release to send.
• Every message is written out as text in the team thread, so a call you missed at speed is still there when you look down.

bluejetty:00042036:ios.name: Vendetta Online
bluejetty:00042036:ios.summary: Explore the galaxy and carve out your own destiny in a 3D MMORPG. This truly cross-platform game enables thousands of players to interact as the pilots of spaceships in a vast online universe. Players may build their characters in any direc
bluejetty:00042036:ios.description:
Explore the galaxy and carve out your own destiny in a 3D MMORPG. This truly cross-platform game enables thousands of players to interact as the pilots of spaceships in a vast online universe. Players may build their characters in any direction they desire, becoming rich captains of industry, military heroes, or outlaws. A fast-paced, realtime "twitch" style combat model gives intense action, coupled with the backdrop of RPG gameplay in a massive online galaxy. Three major player factions form a delicate balance of power, with several NPC sub-factions creating situations of economic struggle, political intrigue and conflict. The completely persistent universe and detailed storyline add to the depth of immersion, resulting in a unique online experience.
Support for multiple platforms across desktop and mobile, all of which play together in a single unified game world. Pilots may seamlessly switch from one platform to another.
The game supports Xbox, PS4 and MFi game controllers, and features cross-platform voice chat, as well as voice-recognition text chat for hands-free typing, text-to-speech for reading mission and other game updates, and many other features.
Although the game can be played quite casually, this is a "real" PC-grade MMORPG, and is not a watered-down "mobile" game experience. Our native iOS version has exactly the same capabilities as the PC versions, with a different interface.
The game is updated frequently, usually every week or two, with the developers and userbase actively discussing the future of the game on the Vendetta Online forums. Many frequent updates are server-side and will not result in a visible "iOS app" update.
Vendetta Online offers three distinct access tiers:
1) Free, where you pay no money at all, and may earn "Crystal" currency through your gameplay, and spend it on certain higher-end ships and equipment. There are no level caps, and you may use your account to play on any other platform (like the Mac). Some high-level content is not available to the Freemium tier, like assembly of player-constructed Capital Ships. It takes many months to build these endgame assets, and Freemium players may work towards those goals, but not complete them.
2) Lite, where you basically subscribe for $1/month, gain the ability to earn 50% more crystal per day, and may build and own the Goliath-class Capital Ship. This ship may also be made "Enduring", causing it to store a permanent record of the ship's usage and history in the game, and making it into a trade-able part of the world.
3) Premium, where you no longer require "Crystal" currency, or even see it, and you only play the game itself the way it was originally intended. Trident-class Capital Ships are available.
Lite and Premium levels are available via In App Purchase, as well as blocks of Crystal.
If you have any problems or concerns, please contact us via email, or (preferred) by creating a Support Ticket on the game website (more secure, and it proves the account in question is yours). We are a small indie developer, but we respond quickly. Leaving reviews is not a very effective way to reach us about problems.
If you are looking to try out your game iOS account on another platform, be sure to "Convert" your account with email verification. You can do this in the Options area, after logging into the game.
-- LEGAL --
Duration and price of each subscription is displayed inside Vendetta Online's storefront, updated at the time of purchase. 1, 3, 6, and 12 month subscription lengths are available for both Premium and Lite modes. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions and auto-renewal can be managed/turned off in your App Store Account Settings.
End User Licensing Agreement:
https://www.vendetta-online.com/h/eula.html

bluejetty:00084721:ios.description:
InkAI: Your Personal AI Tattoo Studio & Artist Gallery
Transform your ideas into professional-grade ink with InkAI. Whether you’re dreaming of your first tattoo or you're an artist looking for a powerful design tool, InkAI combines advanced AI technology with a massive curated gallery of real-world inspiration.
GENERATE & REFINE WITH AI INPAINTING
Don’t settle for a "random" result. InkAI gives you total control:
Text-to-Tattoo: Describe your vision and watch the AI create a custom masterpiece in seconds.
Precision Inpainting: Need to change just one detail? Use our AI Inpainting tool to select any part of your design and redraw it. Swap a rose for a skull or change a sleeve pattern without losing the rest of your design.
3,000+ REAL ARTIST DESIGNS
Explore an ever-growing library of over 3,000 tattoos from professional artists worldwide.
Discover Styles: From Fine Line and Minimalism to Traditional.
Social Inspiration: Like your favorites, follow specific artist styles, and sort by popularity to see what’s trending in the community.
Smart Filters: Easily find exactly what you need by filtering through styles and artists.
PRO-GRADE EXPORTS & UPSCALING
We bridge the gap between digital design and real skin:
HD Upscaling: Turn your concepts into high-resolution files with a single tap. No more blurry references for your tattoo artist.
Vector & Image Formats: Export in PNG or high-quality SVG (vector), perfect for printing stencils or further professional editing.
Stencil Ready: Create clean, crisp designs that are ready to be used by any tattoo shop.
KEY FEATURES AT A GLANCE:
• AI Tattoo Generator: Create unique art from text.
• Magic Inpainting: Modify and edit specific areas of your tattoo using AI.
• 3,000+ Artist Gallery: Browse, like, and sort real designs.
• High-Res Exports: Download in SVG and PNG.
• HD Enhancer: Upscale your designs for maximum clarity.
• Advanced Filtering: Sort by likes or filter by artist.
Why InkAI?
While other apps just give you a static image, InkAI offers a professional workflow. From the first spark of an idea to the final SVG stencil, we provide the tools to make your tattoo journey perfect.
Download InkAI today and design the art you’ll be proud to wear forever.

bluejetty:00140435:ios.description:
Shotsy is the all-in-one GLP-1 medication tracker for weight loss injections and pills. Track doses of Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Wegovy™ Pill, Mounjaro®, Zepbound®, Foundayo®, Rybelsus®, Saxenda®, Victoza®, and Trulicity® — all in one app. Whether you take semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide, or dulaglutide, Shotsy helps you stay on schedule and reach your goals.
DOSE TRACKING
Log injections or daily pills with a single tap. Track your full medication history, side effects, weight, calories, protein, and water intake. Supports multiple simultaneous medications with separate schedules for each.
SMART SCHEDULING & REMINDERS
Set precise schedules for weekly injections or daily oral doses. Get countdowns, reminders, and next-dose notifications so you never miss a dose.
ESTIMATED MEDICATION LEVELS
See how your medication levels change over time with charts based on peer-reviewed clinical data. Available for semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy, Wegovy Pill, Rybelsus), tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound), liraglutide (Saxenda, Victoza), and dulaglutide (Trulicity).
DETAILED ANALYTICS
Gain insights into your progress with interactive charts and visualizations. Track weight trends, side effects, nutrition, and more.
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Automatically import weight, calories, protein, and water intake from Apple Health for a complete picture of your health journey.
PRIVACY FIRST
Your personal data is securely stored on your device and synced across your devices using Apple's private iCloud technology. We never sell your data.
Shotsy supports GLP-1 receptor agonists used for weight management and type 2 diabetes, including both weekly injections and daily oral formulations.
Health Disclaimer
Shotsy is designed for tracking and educational purposes only. It is not intended to provide any medical guidance or advice. Always consult with your healthcare provider for any medical decisions or health concerns.
Privacy Policy: https://shotsyapp.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://shotsyapp.com/terms/

Track doses of Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Wegovy™ Pill, Mounjaro®, Zepbound®, Foundayo®, Rybelsus®, Saxenda®, Victoza®, and Trulicity® — all in one app. Whether you take semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide, or dulaglutide, Shotsy helps you stay on schedule and reach your goals.

DOSE TRACKING
Log injections or daily pills with a single tap. Track your full medication history, side effects, weight, calories, protein, and water intake. Supports multiple simultaneous medications with separate schedules for each.

SMART SCHEDULING & REMINDERS
Set precise schedules for weekly injections or daily oral doses. Get countdowns, reminders, and next-dose notifications so you never miss a dose.

ESTIMATED MEDICATION LEVELS
See how your medication levels change over time with charts based on peer-reviewed clinical data. Available for semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy, Wegovy Pill, Rybelsus), tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound), liraglutide (Saxenda, Victoza), and dulaglutide (Trulicity).

DETAILED ANALYTICS
Gain insights into your progress with interactive charts and visualizations. Track weight trends, side effects, nutrition, and more.

APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Automatically import weight, calories, protein, and water intake from Apple Health for a complete picture of your health journey.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your personal data is securely stored on your device and synced across your devices using Apple's private iCloud technology. We never sell your data.

Shotsy supports GLP-1 receptor agonists used for weight management and type 2 diabetes, including both weekly injections and daily oral formulations.

Health Disclaimer
Shotsy is designed for tracking and educational purposes only. It is not intended to provide any medical guidance or advice. Always consult with your healthcare provider for any medical decisions or health concerns.

bluejetty:00168999:ios.description:
My Sushi Story is a restaurant business simulation game that brings happiness to players. It features a wide variety of decor, appetizing Japanese dishes, and lovely characters.
The customers are upset? The staff is slacking off? The restaurant is too small? The food is bad?
You will go through the story of the restaurant in the game. It all begins when my grandma went to travel the world, leaving behind a slightly run-down sushi restaurant and a clumsy employee—Ono Ryota.
Running a sushi restaurant of my own has always been my dream, but I have no prior experience in doing so. For the sake of my dream and to fulfill my grandma's instructions, Ono and I embark on a journey of running a restaurant that is soothing, hilarious, and filled with ups and downs!
In this game, you will play as the boss of the sushi restaurant. You will create an assortment of Japanese dishes, make the daily purchasing plan, serve the customers, train the chefs and waiters, purchase items in the restaurants, and open a chain store.
The game features hundreds of facilities, thousands of dishes, a dozen employees, and dozens of characters. Everything is free to play. In the game, you can create dishes like pork katsu, sushi, ramen, tempura, wagyu beef, sashimi, udon, foie gras, desserts, grilled seafood, steak, and many others. Enjoy delicacies from all over the world!
[Your Goal]
Serve the customers, upgrade the facilities, create Japanese dishes, and collect good customer reviews!
Create more Japanese dishes and make the restaurant famous!
Earn gold to upgrade, decorate, and expand the restaurant!
Unlock new private rooms, the second floor, the theater, and the conveyor belt sushi hall to make the restaurant larger and livelier.
[Game Features]
1. High level of freedom: You can enjoy different business models and try out various management methods.
2. Renovation: You are free to combine the furniture of different styles and design the interior of different private rooms.
3. Making interesting friends: Meet people who are also fighting for their dreams, just like you. Enjoy the fun interaction with customers with different personalities.
4. Dealing with all kinds of customer requests: How would you handle customers with different personalities?
5. Enjoy a variety of cuisines.
Never play a game of this genre?
Don't worry! My Sushi Story is very easy to play. With just a few taps, you can complete actions such as taking orders, serving customers, and settling bills to earn income effortlessly. You can play the game anytime, anywhere.
Whether you are a master or a newbie of simulation games, you'll be crazy about this warm and fun restaurant business simulation game!
Download My Sushi Story for free now and embark on a delightful journey of running the restaurant!
Follow our fan page here:
facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SushiSimulator/
discord: https://discord.gg/C62VQk7pYK

bluejetty:00021175:ios.description:
ปิ่นโต อีบุ๊ก by Fictionlog – ร้านหนังสือหิ้วได้ที่ให้นักอ่านได้ อ่านนิยาย และ อีบุ๊กออนไลน์ แบบจัดเต็ม ครบทั้ง นิยายวายนิยายรัก นิยายแฟนตาซี นิยายแปล นิยายจีน มังงะ การ์ตูน และหนังสือทั่วไป บรรยากาศอบอุ่นเหมือนได้เข้าร้านหนังสือจริงๆ ที่ทุกคนรัก
ฟีเจอร์ดีต่อใจสำหรับนักอ่าน
- ร้านหนังสือออนไลน์ที่รวม อีบุ๊ก จากสำนักพิมพ์ดัง นักเขียนปัง มีครบทุกแนว ไม่ว่าจะเป็น แฟนตาซี วาย โรแมนซ์ กำลังภายใน ย้อนยุค
- แบ่งหมวดหมู่ละเอียดสุดใจ ค้นหา นิยายแปลจีน หรือ การ์ตูนมังงะ ได้ง่ายขึ้น
- มีทีมงานแนะนำหนังสือใหม่ให้อ่านทุกสัปดาห์ ไม่ต้องเลือกเองก็เจอเล่มที่ใช่
- ตั้งค่าการอ่านได้ตามใจ ทั้งขนาดตัวอักษร ความสว่าง สีพื้นหลัง และการปัดหน้าแบบแนวนอนหรือแนวตั้ง
- รองรับการอ่านแบบ ออฟไลน์ ไม่ต้องมีเน็ตก็อ่านได้ทุกที่
ปิ่นโต อยากให้การอ่าน อีบุ๊กออนไลน์ เป็นเรื่องง่ายและสบายใจที่สุด เพราะเรารู้ว่า “ร้านหนังสือที่คุณรัก” ต้องไม่ได้มีแค่หนังสือดี แต่ต้อง ได้ฟีล เหมือนอยู่บ้านนักอ่านด้วย

bluejetty:00071663:ios.description:
Ready or not... the ultimate hide and seek mystery begins now!
A scary monster is on the loose - and it's hunting you. But in this scary survival game, staying hidden just isn’t enough! You’ll need to think fast as you transform yourself into anything in the room - a chair, a lamp, even a toilet! Be careful! Blend in, stay still, and fool the beast before it hunts you down. 
Or how about you flip the script and take the reins? It’s your time to become the hunter! Seek out tricky players hiding in plain sight. Sharpen your senses and keep your eyes wide open- can you find them all before time runs out?
Whether you’re running from the beast and its fury or taking the hunt into your own hands, this hide and seek prop hunt adventure is loaded with suspense, scares and thrilling surprises. Every round is a new battle. Every room is a creepy playground. Are you clever enough to outlast the creature's attack?
With heart-pounding survival gameplay and a fun twist on the classic game we all know and love, it’s time to dive into the creepiest seek and find challenge ever!
Your next spooky adventure awaits.
Hunt & Seek Features:
- Transform into well known objects and hide anywhere!
- Hunt hidden players before they get away!
- Fast-paced, fun seek and find gameplay
- A true test of quick thinking, stealth, and strategy!
- Escape terrifying monsters and creepy creatures.

bluejetty:00144631:ios.description:
With myHelsana you can deal with all your insurance matters digitally. 
The myHelsana app is a quick, easy and accessible way to deal with all of your important health insurance matters, such as your questions, invoices and contact details.
Why it pays to use myHelsana:
• One less pile of paper at home: myHelsana is the digital folder for your health insurance. You can continue to receive documents by post if you prefer, though.
• Scan, send and view invoices.
• If you have any questions, simply communicate with us using the same channel in the myHelsana app.
• Easy admin: you can find your benefit statements and policies at any time and keep track of your deductible and excess amounts.
• Quickly done: Change your address, accident coverage or annual deductible yourself and manage your payment data instantly and easily.
• Prepared for emergencies: your insurance card is also available via the myHelsana app.
• Quick searches: find doctors, therapists or Helsana-recognised fitness centres near you.
Security:
You’re in safe hands with myHelsana. Encrypted communication keeps your data secure at all times.
Requirements:
A myHelsana account
More about myHelsana:
Are you interested in myHelsana? Would you like to open an account? You can find more information at www.myhelsana.ch/about
Do you have any questions?
Our support team would be happy to help you: 058 340 93 70

bluejetty:00066090:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00066090:ios.description:
A POINT-AND-CLICK ESCAPE ROOM
- Remastered version with better graphics and hint system!
- Try for free before deciding if you want to purchase it or not!
This is a classic point-and-click game inspired by the 90s classics that defined the genre for so long. Think of it as my attempt to honor those old games that meant so much to me as I grew up.
In this game, you’ll explore a newly discovered temple that has been forgotten for thousands of years. It contains many rooms packed with puzzles and riddles, waiting for you to uncover its secrets.
Your old friend has been living in the temple for the past few months, investigating and trying to solve its mysteries. Then suddenly, no one hears from him anymore. The only person brave enough to enter the temple and search for him is, of course, you.
Will you find him? The temple is working against you, with each room filled to the brim with puzzles and riddles trying to stop you from uncovering all its secrets.
Some puzzles are like mini-games that you can solve right away; others require you to pause and observe your surroundings for clues. Some are easy, while others are much more difficult. The game features a built-in hint system that will nudge you in the right direction or completely reveal the solution if you choose. There’s no need to get stuck, as the next room awaits with new puzzles to solve and items to discover!
The rooms in Legacy 3 are filled with items and clues that are there to help you on your quest. Interact with amazing touch controls to inspect your newly found keys and tools. If you see something that looks interesting you can use your camera and take a photo - of whatever you like! Trying to remember that instruction you saw ten rooms before? No problem - just use the camera and you don't have to!
This game is in 3D, with smooth controls and a camera that allows you to take photos of anything in the game. No need to memorize difficult hints or notes!
So what are you waiting for? The adventure awaits! Can you solve all the puzzles and find your friend?
Features:
• Hint system to help when you’re stuck on a puzzle
• Auto-save feature that tracks your progress throughout the game
• So many puzzles to solve
• Even more hidden objects to discover
• Available in English, French, German, Portuguese, Spanish, and Swedish
• Over 25 rooms to explore!
I really hope you enjoy this game. If you do, there’s another one waiting for you: Legacy 4: Tomb of Secrets.
Follow development of next game here: 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nosignalproductionss/

bluejetty:00126583:ios.name: Shopping List - Grocery & Todo
bluejetty:00126583:ios.summary:
Shopping List is a simple shopping list app that leaves out multiple lists, categories, and due dates, letting you jot down what you need to buy in one list on one screen, with Home Screen widgets.
Write down items before you go shopping,
bluejetty:00126583:ios.description:
Shopping List is a simple shopping list app that leaves out multiple lists, categories, and due dates, letting you jot down what you need to buy in one list on one screen, with Home Screen widgets.
Write down items before you go shopping, then check them off at the store. The app works offline, needs no account or sign-up, and is useful for everyday grocery runs, household essentials, and anything you do not want to forget to buy.
[Main Features]
* Simple one-screen design
* Home Screen widget — view your list and check off items directly from the widget
* Checked items appear with a strikethrough
* Clear all checked items at once with the trash button
* Color-code items with 6 colors by swiping right
* Touch and hold an item, then drag to reorder it
* Swipe left on an item to delete it
* Share your list as text with the share button
* Enter items with the keyboard or iOS Dictation (voice input)
* Saves automatically, works offline, no account required
* Supports Dark Mode
[One List for All Your Shopping]
Shopping List is made for people who find most shopping apps too complicated, and for anyone who prefers to keep things simple. There is no support for multiple lists, product categories, due dates, quantities, or prices.
Multiple lists can seem convenient at first, but jumping between them soon makes managing your shopping feel like a chore. This app puts quick, everyday use first: open it, write down what you need, and go.
[Check Your List from the Home Screen]
Place the widget on your Home Screen to see your shopping list at a glance — like a sticky note that is always in view. You can also check off items right on the widget, so you can shop without opening the app.
Tapping the widget opens the app. When you notice that milk, bread, or shampoo is running low, you can jot it down the moment it comes to mind.
[Check Off Items as You Shop]
Tap an item to check it off — a strikethrough shows what is already in your cart, so you can see at a glance what is left to buy.
Swipe right on an item to give it one of 6 colors. Use colors to mark urgent items, distinguish food from household goods, or highlight things your family asked for. When you’re done shopping, tap the trash button to clear all checked items at once — anything you did not buy stays on the list for your next trip.
[Send Your List to Family]
With the share button, you can export your list as text and paste it into a text message, email, or chat app. This lets you send a shopping list to your partner or family — no account or sync setup required.
[For Everyday Shopping and More]

bluejetty:00100298:ios.summary: Welcome to WoodSense: Craft & Identifier — your intelligent woodworking companion for identifying, restoring, and creating beautiful wooden furniture. Whether you’re a restorer, designer, or curious hobbyist, WoodSense helps you understand
bluejetty:00100298:ios.description:
Welcome to WoodSense: Craft & Identifier — your intelligent woodworking companion for identifying, restoring, and creating beautiful wooden furniture. Whether you’re a restorer, designer, or curious hobbyist, WoodSense helps you understand the story and structure behind every piece of wood.
With a single photo, WoodSense reveals the wood species, joinery techniques, and historical style of any wooden object — from antiques to modern designs. Dive deeper with expert-level repair guides, cut lists, and restoration tips built into the app.
What WoodSense Can Do
1. Identify Wood Instantly
Snap a photo of any wooden furniture or material. WoodSense identifies the wood species, grain pattern, and probable period — oak, cherry, mahogany, walnut, pine, and more.
2. Discover Furniture History
See where your piece fits in — from Queen Anne revival to mid-century minimalism. Learn about construction methods, typical joinery, and design influences.
3. Get Restoration Guidance
Planning a repair? WoodSense provides detailed, step-by-step repair and refinishing instructions — including tools, adhesives, and safety notes, so you can work like a craftsman.
4. Create and Replicate Designs
Turn inspiration into plans. Generate custom cut lists, joinery dimensions, and finish guides for your own woodworking projects.
5. Learn from Every Grain
WoodSense helps you recognize patterns of craftsmanship — from mortise-and-tenon joints to dovetail artistry — so you can elevate your restoration or build.
Who Is WoodSense For?
Collectors & Restorers
Reveal the history, materials, and care methods of your vintage or antique furniture.
Woodworkers & DIY Makers
Gain accurate design references, joinery techniques, and building guides for your own workshop.
Design Enthusiasts
Understand the artistry behind furniture and woodcraft — from traditional detailing to modern precision.
Why Use WoodSense?
• Smart Identification: AI-powered recognition for wood species and craftsmanship details.
• Professional Guidance: Authentic restoration and build techniques used by experts.
• Creative Tools: Generate scaled plans and personalized project templates.
• Accessible Learning: Whether you’re a hobbyist or master craftsman, every step is clear and visual.
Start Your Crafting Journey
Download WoodSense today and discover the intelligence inside every grain. Build smarter, restore better, and bring craftsmanship to life — one piece at a time.
About WoodSense Premium
Unlock expert tools and unlimited identifications with WoodSense Premium:
• Unlimited wood and furniture analyses
• Access to full restoration workflows and cut-list exports
• Early access to new style recognition updates
Subscription Details:
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off in iTunes Subscriptions after purchase.

bluejetty:00149165:ios.summary:
My QuitBuddy helps you get, and stay, smoke- and vape-free.
Whether you’re thinking about quitting, working up to your quit date or ready to quit now, My QuitBuddy can be customised to suit whatever stage you’re at on your quit journey and
bluejetty:00149165:ios.description:
My QuitBuddy helps you get, and stay, smoke- and vape-free.
Whether you’re thinking about quitting, working up to your quit date or ready to quit now, My QuitBuddy can be customised to suit whatever stage you’re at on your quit journey and help you stay smoke- and vape-free.
My QuitBuddy can help you through the hardest times with helpful tips and distractions to overcome cravings; tracking systems to chart your progress; and all the facts you need to understand the impacts smoking and vaping have on your health.
There is an entire community of buddies there to help you out, with success stories, experiences and handy tips.
Feel good about how much money you’re saving and how much nasty stuff your lungs are avoiding. Over time, watch the savings and results begin to pile up.
All quit journeys are full of ups and downs, depending on how you’re feeling on any given day. On days when your cravings are strong, distractions and soothing imagery are available to help you get through. 
Quitting can be hard and most people try a number of times before they finally quit for good. 
My QuitBuddy is with you every step of the way.
Key Features:
- 'Quit Now', prepare to 'Quit Later' or 'Continue Quitting'.
- Set your goals and understand your motivations to quit.
- Nominate friends or family who you can call in the tough times.
- View your progress, including a count of every day, hour and minute you stay smoke- and vape-free and how much money you've saved.
- For the first 30 days of your journey, you'll receive a helpful tip when you open the app.
- You can nominate any Danger Times and My QuitBuddy will get in touch to keep you on track.
- My QuitBuddy helps with a range of distractions to occupy your mind and your hands through any moments of craving. 
- Read helpful messages from other people who are quitting with My QuitBuddy and leave your own for others to read.
- If you need additional backup, you can call the Quitline directly on 13 7848 (13 QUIT) from the app.

•【精准输入】超大词库，精准联想，整句纠错，打造超高准确率

【Tip 1】如何使用单手模式在大屏iPhone上进行输入？
百度输入法允许用户根据手型和握姿任意调节键盘的大小、高度甚至位置，让您单手也能轻松输入！在输入面板的工具条上点击键盘调节icon进入编辑页面，自定义您的个性键盘，更可快捷切换。
【Tip 2】 如何启用百度输入法？
第一步：安装后，进入系统设置—>通用—>键盘—>添加键盘—>第三方键盘 选择 百度-百度输入法 —> 百度-百度输入法 —> 开启完全访问（同步开启云输入、百度输入法设置同步）—>完成
第二步：打开任何输入框—>长按地球键 选择 中文-百度输入法 （默认拼音9键）
【Tip 3】 如何开启滑行输入、键盘手写等高级功能？
第一步：进入系统设置—>通用—>键盘—> 中文-百度输入法 —> 开启完全访问
第二步：打开任何输入框—>点击输入面板左上角熊头—>在下拉菜单中使用高级功能
【Tip 4】 如何用百度账号备份用户词库和设置项？
第一步：进入系统设置—>通用—>键盘—> 中文-百度输入法 —> 开启完全访问
第二步：点击桌面APP图标—>点击“输入设置”—>点击“云备份”并登录百度账号—>点击“备份设置项/用户词”。
＝＝＝自动订阅服务说明＝＝＝
1. 订阅服务：输入法特权包（连续包月）、输入法特权包（连续包年）
2. 订阅价格：
a) 输入法特权包（连续包月）产品为首月优惠1元/月，非首月为8元/月
b) 输入法特权包（连续包年）产品为优惠价10元/年，原价为88元/年
3. 付款：用户确认购买并付款后计入iTunes账户
4. 自动续费：苹果iTunes账户会在到期前24小时内扣费，扣费成功后订阅周期顺延一个订阅周期
5. 关闭服务：您可以在苹果手机“设置”-->进入“iTunes Store与App Store”-->点击“Apple ID”，选择“查看Apple ID”，进入“账户设置”页面，点击“订阅”，管理自动订阅服务，如需取消，每个计费周期结束前24小时关闭即可，到期前24小时内则不再扣费
6.服务协议：
a) 百度输入法会员服务协议：https://srf.baidu.com/site/automember/index.html
b) 百度输入法自动续费协议：https://srf.baidu.com/site/autofee/index.html

bluejetty:00015756:ios.description:
The StudentVUE Mobile application helps students stay informed and connected by providing day-to-day insight into their own academic experience. StudentVUE Mobile works with the Synergy™ student information system in much the same way as the StudentVUE web portal, allowing students to stay on top of upcoming school events, classroom happenings, assignments, tests, and academic performance. Students can view their classroom assignments and scores, attendance and more. 
How to find District URL and Login Information:
The StudentVUE Mobile for the iPhone/iPod Touch app uses the same user login as the web-based StudentVUE portal.  If you need help please contact your School District’s Administration office for access URL and StudentVUE login information.
Requirements:
• Only school districts using the Synergy™ student information system version 6.5 and higher can support the StudentVUE for the iPhone application. 
• Requires wireless or 3G Internet connection.
• The StudentVUE Mobile for the iPhone/iPod Touch app uses same user login as the web-based StudentVUE portal. Please contact your School District’s Administration office to verify Synergy™ version and StudentVUE login information.

TURN YOUR iPHONE INTO A GIANT SCROLLING MESSAGE
Need to get someone's attention in a crowded place? Text Banner creates giant, animated text that's impossible to miss.
PERFECT FOR
• Calling a taxi or Uber in busy streets
• Airport pickups ("WELCOME HOME!")
• Concerts, sports events, festivals
• Birthday surprises and celebrations
• Store promotions and announcements
• Emergency situations
FEATURES
• Giant full-screen scrolling text
• Adjustable speed - slow to super fast
• Rainbow color picker
• Visual effects: Flash, Mirror, Mix colors
• High contrast mode for bright environments
• Message history - save and reuse texts

Type your message → Choose your colors → Rotate to landscape → Done!
Your text scrolls automatically in beautiful, smooth animation. It's that simple.
WHY TEXT BANNER?
Sometimes the best way to communicate is with a message so big it can't be ignored. No yelling, no waving - just clear, visible text that everyone can read from far away.
Download now and make your next message impossible to miss!
Privacy: All messages stay on your device. We never collect or transmit your data.

bluejetty:00115723:ios.description:
Welcome to Gamfa, your personal and private command center for everything related to your gaming life. Designed as a dedicated digital notebook, media library, and memo pad for gamers, Gamfa helps you capture, organize, and remember what matters most.
This is not a social network. This is your private space to enhance your own gameplay.
CAPTURE AND COLLECT HIGHLIGHTS
Create a dedicated vault for all your gaming screenshots and video clips.
Easily import moments from your photo library and keep them separate from personal photos.
Never again struggle to find that one perfect victory screen or hilarious glitch.
A DEDICATED GAMING NOTEBOOK
Jot down strategies, character builds, puzzle solutions, or crafting recipes.
Keep detailed logs for quests, in-game discoveries, or tactical plans.
Say goodbye to paper notes or generic memo apps that weren't built for gaming.
ORGANIZE EVERYTHING EFFORTLESSLY
Sort all your content by game. Create specific albums for different characters, missions, or moments.
Use custom tags to categorize your notes and media for instant searching. Find exactly what you need in seconds.
MANAGE YOUR GAMING WORLD
Use Gamfa as a personal database to track your in-game item collections, wishlists, or progress.
Keep a memo of server addresses, friend codes, or important settings.
Everything you need for your favorite games is now in one, easy-to-access location.
Gamfa is the essential utility for the organized gamer. It's your personal archive, your strategy guide, and your memory bank, all in one sleek app.
Download Gamfa today and bring order to your gaming universe!

bluejetty:00119435:ios.description:
Thinking about travelling? Are you looking for a cheap flight? Download our app and make the trip of your dreams! 
We'll take care of everything: Finding cheap flights, showing you the best hotels and other accommodations for your stay, negotiating great deals on your rental car or arranging your ride from the airport to your destination. We've got you covered! 
Cheap flights
Find cheap flights among our more than 600 airlines, for one way, return or multi-city!
Our wide variety of flights offers you from long distance flights to cheap low cost flights with airlines such as Ryanair, Easyjet, British Airways, United Airlines, Air Europa and more. Book your flights with us and you will be able to download your boarding passes directly from the app, in addition to tracking the status of any flight in real time. You will find the ideal flight and tickets at the cheapest price in our travel app.
Hotels
Take a look at our more than 2 million hotels and other accommodations for all budgets and types of trips. Search, book and compare hotel offers very easily.
You can book hotels like Melià Hotels and Resorts, Marriott, Eurostars, NH, Catalonia Hotels & Resorts and much more. Cancellation is free if you change your plans. We also offer discounts of up to 40% less in hotels if you book a flight with us.
Car rental
Do you want to complete your booking with a car rental? We offer cars from companies such as Hertz, Avis, Europcar, Alamo, Budget and up to 800 car rental agencies. Rent a car anytime, anywhere and travel at your own pace.
Sounds good, right? And that's not all!
Our travel app not only offers you cheap flights, hotel deals, and car rentals for your trips ... download the app and:
- Order your boarding passes for all your flights, and we will check-in as soon as it is available
- follow the status of any flight in real time with our new flight tracker feature
- Create an account and receive real time flight status notifications: gate numbers, baggage belts, delays or cancellations and more
-Check your flight itineraries, booking references or baggage allowances in the My Trips section, even without an internet connection!
- download our free travel guides and discover what to do at your destination, even if you don't have an internet connection
Opodo helps you to find the best deals on flights, hotels and car rentals. Search, compare and book flight + hotel tickets in our travel app to enjoy a 40% discount.
We strive every day to make your travel dreams come true. If you had a positive experience with our app, would you mind rating us with 5 stars in the App Store? Thank you!

bluejetty:00174905:ios.description:
KickMap NYC. It’s an all-in-one app for stress-free rides to your destinations. Our user-friendly design and clear maps take the guesswork out of your commute, helping you get anywhere in the city quickly and confidently.
Here's what makes KickMap NYC your go-to subway app:
Effortless trip planning: Calculate routes between any two locations, including stations and street addresses.
Know before you go: Get real-time service advisories with push notifications for delays and disruptions, to help plan your travel schedule.
Day or night, no problem: Unlike most subway apps, the 24-hour KickMap NYC switches automatically to show which lines run during night hours, ensuring a confident journey at any time.
Real-time station information : Tap and hold any station on the map to see live train arrival times and a detailed street map showing exits and entrances.
Simple and clear: Our intuitive interface makes planning your trip a breeze, so you can spend less time navigating and more time exploring NYC!
Download KickMap NYC today and experience the easiest way to ride the NYC subway!
Features:
NYC subway map and directions work underground without an internet connection.
Directions without an internet connection displayed right on the map.
Very easy to use - All lines and connections shown clearly.
24-hour Day/Night maps - Automatically switches maps at 11pm and 6 am.
Pop-up street map - Press any station for 3 seconds to see station entrances and the local area.
Built-in Compass - Keeps you oriented at street level.
GPS Locator - Shows subway stations closest to you.
Official MTA Transit Alerts - Customize push notifications of delays for the lines you choose.
Identifies stations with no free cross-over to go in opposite direction.
Shows over 350 NYC Neighborhoods and Parks and over 1000 points of interest.
“One of the top ten New York City-based apps" - Huffington Post
“Easier to read" - The New York Times
“One of the best apps for navigating NYC’s subway lines" - CNET
“Easy, detailed, and clear" - Apple Gazette
“Navigating the NY subway has never been easier" - Appolicious.com
“Easier to see all the lines" - Treehugger.com
“You’ll know how to get where you’re going whether it’s 3PM or 3AM" - SmarterTravel.com
“Encourages people to take advantage of the subway" - Transitmy.org
